episodes.name: Chang Family Fortress Suffers Sudden Massacre
episodes.overview: Two centuries ago, Patriarch Bei Chen died sealing demons, leading to the formation of the Six Sects. Fifteen years ago, Demon Sect leader Nie Heng Cheng was killed when Cai Ping Shu sacrificed herself, restoring peace. Her niece Cai Zhao, unruly by nature, is sent to Qingque Sect to train. On the journey, she survives the Chang family massacre and saves the poisoned boy Chang Ning. At Qingque, Cai Zhao grows suspicious of Chang Ning’s strange behavior. Though respected due to her aunt’s legacy, she repeatedly clashes with the sect leader’s spoiled daughter Qi Ling Bo, while her skills attract Song Yu Zhi’s attention. Cai Zhao secretly investigates Chang Ning and senses hidden suffering behind his restraint. One night, assassins attack, and the two are incapacitated by smoke, falling into danger.

episodes.name: Chang Ning Accidentally Falls Off a Cliff
episodes.overview: Cai Zhao and Chang Ning are ambushed on a chain bridge and trapped over a cliff. Cai Zhao nearly dies saving him and is rescued by Song Yu Zhi. Chang Ning’s poison flares up, revealing an older toxin. He publicly exposes Madam Su Lian’s hypocrisy, causing unrest. Seeking protection, Chang Ning moves closer to Cai Zhao. She later uncovers his self-harm poisoning tactic but is shocked by his true appearance. Under Truth Incense, he mutters about “protecting father", deepening her doubts. He hints that Yin Dai framed Cai Ping Shu, prompting Cai Zhao to investigate the library. Together, they discover Yin Dai’s notebook is missing, just as enemies approach and the secret chamber seals shut.

episodes.name: The Change in the Relationship between Cai Zhao and Chang Ning
episodes.overview: Chang Ning reveals the notebook records the forbidden Heavenly Demon Disintegration Technique, used by Cai Ping Shu to kill Nie Heng Cheng at the cost of her life. During Mid-Autumn chaos, they retrieve the notebook and confirm Yin Dai forced her to learn the technique to protect the Six Sects. Qi Yun Ke destroys the notebook to prevent turmoil, but Chang Ning secretly memorizes the method for revenge. Cai Zhao, haunted by her aunt’s suffering, makes him swear never to use it. Their bond deepens, and they dream of leaving together. Suddenly, another youth claiming to be “Chang Ning” appears, bearing a striking resemblance to Chang Hao Sheng.

episodes.name: Chang Ning Confronts
episodes.overview: Chang Ning’s identity is publicly challenged using the newcomer Jiang Ning. He calmly answers family secrets and turns the interrogation against his accusers. A forced test triggers his poison, ending the trial. That night, Chang Ning escapes with Cai Zhao, but they are pursued and surrounded in Qingque Town. Chang Ning accuses Pei Yuan Feng, linking him to the Chang family massacre. The truth emerges: the Demon Sect slaughtered the Chang clan, and Jiang Ning admits he swapped identities to protect Chang Ning. Though temporarily sheltered, suspicion remains. Cai Zhao later follows Chang Ning and witnesses him secretly meeting a mysterious old woman in the wine cellar.

episodes.name: Wu Gang and the Demonic Sect Massacre the Qingque Sect
episodes.overview: Before the ancestral ceremony, Cai Zhao notices missing wine jars and grows wary. During the ceremony, she exposes the old woman as Luo Yuan Rong, a long-missing Taichu Sect disciple. Luo reveals that Pei Yuan Feng framed his senior brother Wu Yuan Ying with the help of the demon sect and presents the crippled Wu as proof. When Pei denies it, Luo kills him and leaps to her death with Wu Yuan Ying. The revelation shakes the Six Sects. Cai Zhao confronts Chang Ning for hiding the truth, and their beliefs clash. As suspicion tightens, Chang Ning leaves the sect and disappears after a brutal demon sect ambush. Cai Zhao, recalling her aunt’s teachings, resolves to face the brutal truths of the jianghu.

episodes.name: Yin Dai Kills Cai Ping Shu
episodes.overview: After the night raid on Qingque Sect, Cai Zhao and Chang Ning uncover that demon cult assassins have infiltrated the sect from within. The Wu brothers reveal themselves as traitors during a staged memorial, severely injuring Qi Yun Kuo and crippling Song Yu Zhi with Nether Cold Qi. Before dying, Wu Gang accuses Yin Dai of causing Cai Ping Shu’s death, only to be silenced, leaving Cai Zhao suspicious. Tracing the clues, Cai Zhao learns the demon cult used advanced disguise techniques to impersonate sect members, including Fan Xing Jia. The real Fan is rescued in Qingque Town, but the infiltrator escapes. Back at the sect, Cai Zhao senses her master acting strangely and suspects a replacement. With unrest growing, she realizes the cult is plotting to bring down Qingque from within and begins a deeper investigation.

episodes.name: The Giant Python in the Ice Cave
episodes.overview: In snow-covered Qingque Town, Cai Zhao encounters Qian Xue Shen and Mu Qing Yan. Mu sparks chaos at an inn by revealing a Snow Dragon Scale, exposing hidden dangers among the crowd. The group later enters the mountains and is trapped in a deadly illusion array, where Qian Xue Shen manipulates the terrain and disappears after faking her death. A frozen corpse exposes long-hidden conspiracies, including Duan Jiu Xiu’s ambition and his faked death years earlier. Qian Xue Shen reveals how her family was massacred after saving him. As disaster strikes, Duan is dragged into the abyss by a giant serpent, with Qinuo following. An avalanche engulfs the area, and Mu Qing Yan shields Cai Zhao as she falls from a cliff.

episodes.name: Qian Xue Shen Recalls the Tragic Deaths of Her Parents
episodes.overview: The trio is rescued from a hot spring cave by Xue Gu and Old Ning, who reveals himself as Cai Zhao’s reclusive uncle. Xue Gu unveils a portrait of Gu Qing Kong, the Luoying Valley Witch who vanished with her spirit beast centuries ago. Qian Xue Shen recalls witnessing his family’s massacre as a child and surviving in silence before being taken in by Qian Mian Sou. To break the forbidden technique, they try hatching a dragon beast egg using Cai Zhao’s blood. When enemies close in, Qian Xue Shen summons an ice crystal python with his jade flute, declaring years of vengeance. After the mountain collapses again, he vows to guard the snow mountains forever and entrusts the dragon beast to Cai Zhao before vanishing into the storm.

episodes.name: Cai Zhao Returns to Qingque Sect with the Saliva
episodes.overview: Mu Qing Yan admits his infiltration was for the Ziwei Heart Manual, with the saliva as its catalyst, leaving Cai Zhao questioning their mutual use of each other. He departs after giving her the saliva and an Extreme Bliss Palace token to settle old grudges. Cai Zhao disguises herself as Demon Sect deputy Qi Nong to infiltrate a coffin shop, while Fan Xing Jia exposes the fake sect master. The real Qi Yun Kuo is rescued, and the supposedly dead Li Wen Xun is revealed as the hidden mastermind. As bells ring across the mountain, the impostor’s plot finally collapses.

episodes.name: The Joint Attack on Qingque Sect Ends in Failure
episodes.overview: Cai Zhao disguises herself as the demon sect’s deputy envoy and infiltrates the cellar to rescue the poisoned Qi Yun Ke, only to be intercepted by Li Wen Xun, a disguised enemy strategist. As they fight back together, the Qingque Sect hall descends into chaos when the fake sect leader is exposed as Yu Hui Yin, a close aide of Nie Zhe, who triggers traps and causes the hall to collapse, seriously injuring Dai Feng Chi. In Bliss Palace, Mu Qing Yan confronts Nie Zhe and discovers his mother died after years of secret imprisonment. Overwhelmed by grief, he unleashes forbidden power and slaughters the Nether Hall. Among the ruins of Qingque Sect, Qi Yun Ke reveals Nie Zhe’s plan before passing out, while Cai Zhao looks north at the blood-red sky, sensing an approaching storm of vengeance.

episodes.name: Mu Qing Yan Successfully Takes Control of the Azure Dragon Altar
episodes.overview: Cai Zhao strikes at Yu Hui Yin but is repelled until Qi Yun Ke steps in, allowing Qingque disciples to force the demon sect to retreat. Cai Zhao breaks a body-swapping technique, exposing hidden infiltrators and plunging the sect into disorder. In Muwei Palace, the impostor Qiu Ren Jie is unmasked and admits to past betrayals before taking his own life. Afterward, Song Yu Zhi is weighed down by shame, but Cai Zhao urges him to separate right from wrong. Meanwhile, Mu Qing Yan gathers his former followers, controls them with poison, and announces his return to reclaim the demon sect. Learning of the growing turmoil, Cai Zhao grows uneasy, especially when news hints that a cure for Nether Cold Aura may lie within the demon sect’s treasury.

episodes.name: Song Yu Zhi Conceals the News of His Departure from the Sect from Qi Yun Ke
episodes.overview: Qi Ling Bo catches Song Yu Zhi and Cai Zhao in a private discussion and, in a jealous outburst, accidentally injures Song Shi Jun. Sensing his son’s feelings for Cai Zhao, Song Shi Jun hints at calling off the engagement, but Song Yu Zhi deflects, citing the sect’s instability. Madam Su Lian tries to pressure Song Shi Jun during a tea gathering, which backfires and ignites a bitter mother-daughter clash, ending with Qi Ling Bo storming off. At the same time, Mu Qing Yan secretly brings Qingong Altar Master You Guan Yue under his control using poison and spreads rumors to turn the demon sect against Nie Zhe. His trap frames Yu Hui Yin as colluding with him, forcing Nie Zhe and Hu Feng Ge to plot a response. Back at Qingque Sect, Cai Zhao learns Mu Qing Yan’s remaining poison is incurable, leaving her shaken. Though she flawlessly breaks the Beidou Formation during training, her worry grows, and that night she quietly decides to act on her feelings.

episodes.name: Cai Zhao and Song Yu Zhi's Chance Encounter with Xing Er
episodes.overview: After confirming Mu Qing Yan’s poison is fatal, Cai Zhao immediately leaves the mountain to seek help, with Song Yu Zhi insisting on accompanying her. Disguised, they slip away as misunderstandings erupt back at the sect. Their journey turns dangerous in the Hanhai Mountains when their guide abandons them, Song Yu Zhi nearly drowns, and both are trapped by illusion-inducing butterflies until a protective charm saves them. Meanwhile, Mu Qing Yan is hunted down but escapes with help, then sends You Guan Yue back undercover and releases his golden roc to search for Cai Zhao. At Qingque Sect, Qi Yun Ke exposes Cai Zhao’s disguise and learns of her departure. Deep in the forest, Cai Zhao and Song Yu Zhi press on, only for Song Yu Zhi to trigger a trap while protecting her, sending them both plunging into a hidden pit.

episodes.name: Yan Xu Tells His Story
episodes.overview: After escaping the Li Sect, Cai Zhao and Song Yu return with the villagers, who learn that the sect has been secretly creating corpse puppets. Seeking a way to stop them, the group goes to the Jiuzhou Archive, where they encounter Yan Xu, a former Li Sect elder imprisoned and forced to falsify history. Yan Xu reveals that the corpse puppets can be temporarily neutralized with a rare herb. As the Li Sect moves to strengthen its forces, Mu Qing Yan leads an attack, and You Guan Yue fights desperately to save Xing Er, only to face her after she is turned into a corpse puppet. Cai Zhao arrives in time with the herb, disabling the puppets and turning the battle, but Mu Qing Yan collapses from poison. It is later revealed that Cai Zhao is also infected, and a new lead points the group toward a mysterious herb garden.

episodes.name: Sun Ruo Shui Deliberately Destroys the Herb Garden
episodes.overview: Tensions flare between Mu Qing Yan and Song Yu Zhi over Cai Zhao, while Xing Er reunites with You Guan Yue. Rumors about Cai Zhao’s ties to Cai Ping Shu spread, but Mu Qing Yan publicly defends her, forcing Yan Xu to back down as the situation grows increasingly volatile. Cai Zhao soon discovers that Sun Ruo Shui has deliberately destroyed the herb garden needed to treat the corpse poison. Although an alternative herb eases Cai Zhao’s condition, Mu Qing Yan refuses to use it himself. As Song Yu Zhi openly challenges him and Sun Ruo Shui deepens her schemes, hidden conflicts begin to surface.

episodes.name: Five Years in Endless Darkness
episodes.overview: Cai Zhao learns the truth about Mu Qing Yan’s past and Sun Ruo Shui’s deception, including how she manipulated rumors and claimed the role of his “mother”. When Sun Ruo Shui appears again and attempts to poison Cai Zhao, Cai Zhao turns the tables, only for Mu Qing Yan to suddenly fall ill. Sun Ruo Shui accuses Cai Zhao, but the situation is revealed to be part of a deliberate trap set by Cai Zhao and Mu Qing Yan to expose a larger scheme. Mu Qing Yan later brings Cai Zhao to the hut where he was imprisoned as a child, recounting the five years he spent crippled and abandoned after Nie Zhe severed his tendons. While Sun Ruo Shui falsely believes Mu Qing Yan is dying, he and Cai Zhao infiltrate Bliss Palace to confront Nie Zhe. The plan unravels when Mu Qing Yan is poisoned with Suzi Incense, and both are captured in a trap, leaving them imprisoned as the power struggle reaches a dangerous turning point.

episodes.name: Cai Zhao and Mu Qing Yan Are Imprisoned in the Underground Palace
episodes.overview: Cai Zhao and Mu Qing Yan are trapped in an iron cage and attacked by poisonous insects, revealing Han Yi Su’s involvement. Although Mu Qing Yan kills him in time, the mechanism is triggered, sealing them inside the underground palace. While allies seize Bliss Palace above ground, Cai Zhao and Mu Qing Yan explore the ruins below and uncover traces of the Li Sect’s hidden history, including memorials linked to Mu Qing Yan’s lineage. Following secret markings left behind, they piece together the tragic past of Luo Shi Yun and Sect Leader Mu Dong Lie and discover a hidden escape route. After fighting off an ambush at the exit, Cai Zhao and Mu Qing Yan track down Nie Zhe. Sun Ruo Shui attempts to shift blame and beg for mercy, but Nie Zhe exposes her crimes, turning the two against each other as deeper conspiracies continue to unfold.

episodes.name: The Purple Jade Golden Sunflower Goes Missing
episodes.overview: Sun Ruo Shui recalls witnessing Nie Zhe secretly taking orders from a mysterious masked figure years ago. After Nie Zhe is imprisoned, Cai Zhao waits for the hidden mastermind to make a move, but the Purple Jade Golden Sunflower is discovered missing from the treasury. With no clear suspect, Mu Qing Yan gives Song Yu Zhi a substitute treasure to ease his condition, while insisting Cai Zhao remain at the Li Sect for her safety. As Mu Qing Yan’s illness worsens, Cai Zhao stays behind to care for him, only to discover he has been faking his condition to draw out the masked figure. When the real culprit rescues Nie Zhe and kills Sun Ruo Shui during the chaos, Cai Zhao is forced to leave with Song Yu Zhi. Back at Qingque Sect, she is torn between her loyalty to her master and her unresolved feelings for Mu Qing Yan, determined to uncover the truth behind the masked figure while protecting him from afar.

episodes.name: Cai Zhao Inquires about the Skin-Walker Demon
episodes.overview: Back at Qingque Sect, Cai Zhao and Mu Qing Yan are both weighed down by longing. While You Guan Yue awkwardly tries to cheer Mu Qing Yan up, Cai Zhao clashes with Song Yu Zhi for speaking ill of the Li Sect. Sect leader Qi Yun Que warns her about the terrifying legend of the Skin-Walker Demon, hinting that appearances can be deceiving and urging her not to repeat past mistakes. Seeking answers, Cai Zhao investigates the Skin-Walker Demon’s past and learns it was once connected to Cai Ping Shu. Meanwhile, marriage tensions intensify as proposals, rumors, and jealousy swirl around her. Cai Zhao proves her resolve by silencing gossip through action, even as Zhou Yu Qi openly pushes for marriage. As alliances shift and hidden feelings surface, emotional and political pressures continue to tighten around her.

episodes.name: Mu Qing Yan Looks for Lu Cheng Nan
episodes.overview: At Qingque Sect, marriage tensions resurface, while Mu Qing Yan fails to suppress the poison in his body and begins searching for the missing Purple Jade Golden Sunflower. From Ru Xin, he learns that Lu Cheng Nan disappeared after his master’s death. A secret note soon points Cai Zhao and Song Yu Zhi toward the Chang family, possibly linking Lu Cheng Nan to an old massacre. Under the pretense of paying respects, the group travels to the Chang residence. Mu Qing Yan arrives separately and narrowly avoids confrontation with Cai Zhao’s help. That night, he secretly meets her to share his suspicions. As emotions shift, Cai Zhao puts her engagement on hold, while Song Yu Zhi moves to end his own, leaving relationships increasingly strained.

episodes.name: Qi Ling Bo Resents the Broken Engagement
episodes.overview: After Song Yu Zhi abruptly cancels his engagement to Qi Ling Bo, tensions rise within the group. While searching the Chang family tomb for the missing Ziyu Jin Kui, Cai Zhao, Mu Qing Yan, and Song Yu Zhi discover hidden passages but fail to find the treasure. Outside, Nie Zhe ambushes them, forcing Cai Zhao to trick him with a fake explosive disguised as the artifact so everyone can escape. Humiliated by the broken engagement, Qi Ling Bo lashes out at Cai Zhao, accusing her of entangling both Mu Qing Yan and Song Yu Zhi. Meanwhile, Mu Qing Yan secretly reveals that Cai Zhao’s aunt’s lover may have been someone within the Li Sect, and possibly the mysterious “Painted Skin Demon.”

episodes.name: From Now On, Strangers
episodes.overview: Mu Qing Yan secretly manipulates events to break off Cai Zhao’s arranged marriage to Zhou Yu Qi. Under the influence of a trap set by fortune-tellers and rumors, Zhou Yu Qi finally delivers a divorce letter, cutting ties with Cai Zhao and declaring they will go their separate ways. Suspecting Mu Qing Yan’s involvement, Cai Zhao confronts him in anger. Though tension grows between them, the two are forced to cooperate again when Nie Zhe’s men attack, leading to another dangerous escape while the mystery of the hidden enemy deepens.

episodes.name: The Tragedy of Chang Family Fortress
episodes.overview: After escaping pursuit, Cai Zhao realizes Mu Qing Yan may have orchestrated recent events to obtain the Ziyu Jin Kui needed for his cultivation. Their argument is interrupted by Nie Zhe’s pursuers, but they are rescued by Shi Tie Qiao, one of the Shi brothers. Shi Tie Qiao reveals the past of Cai Ping Zhu and the secret surrounding the treasure. As they learn more about the tragedy that destroyed the Chang family, Mu Qing Yan’s illness worsens, and Cai Zhao begins to see how much he has been hiding about his condition.

episodes.name: Cai Zhao Suspects the Painted Skin Demon
episodes.overview: Following Guo Zi Gui’s funeral, Cai Zhao pieces together clues about the mysterious black-clothed figure. She begins to suspect that the legendary “Painted Skin Demon” may be the true mastermind behind many past tragedies. Returning to Qingque Sect, Cai Zhao and Mu Qing Yan expose Wang Yuan Jing’s crimes connected to the massacre of Chang Family Fortress. Before revealing the identity of the black-clothed figure, Wang Yuan Jing is assassinated, plunging the sect into chaos and leaving Cai Zhao entangled in growing suspicion and rumors.

episodes.name: Cai Zhao Rejects Song Yu Zhi
episodes.overview: Cai Zhao’s parents fear she may repeat Cai Ping Zhu’s tragic fate if she trusts Mu Qing Yan, believing he could deceive her like the mysterious Painted Skin Demon once did. Though Cai Zhao admits she likes Mu Qing Yan, she refuses to meet him after receiving his letter about a new clue regarding the black-clothed figure. Meanwhile, Song Yu Zhi prepares a romantic lakeside proposal and asks Cai Zhao to marry him. She gratefully acknowledges his support after her broken engagement but gently refuses his confession. That night, Mu Qing Yan secretly visits her room and promises to abandon everything to be with her, but Qi Yun Ke discovers him. Seeing a wrist guard connected to the Painted Skin Demon, Qi Yun Ke suspects Mu Qing Yan’s father and confronts him, forcing Mu Qing Yan to escape.

episodes.name: Mu Qing Yan Is Captured
episodes.overview: Determined to clear his father’s name, Mu Qing Yan secretly enters Qingque Sect and presents evidence revealing that Cai Ping Zhu was once engaged to his uncle Mu Zheng Yang. Although the evidence weakens the accusation against his father, the sect leaders still distrust Mu Qing Yan because of his identity as a member of Li Sect. He is imprisoned, and Qi Yun Ke decides to cripple his martial arts and keep him locked away for life. Unwilling to accept this, Cai Zhao secretly plans a rescue with the help of friends and sneaks into the prison, only to discover Mu Qing Yan has already been transferred elsewhere.

episodes.name: Cai Zhao Saves Mu Qing Yan
episodes.overview: When the sects prepare to carry out Mu Qing Yan’s punishment, Cai Zhao intervenes and threatens to die with him if they proceed. Taking advantage of the chaos, she secretly drugs the crowd and escapes with him. The pair is chased and seriously injured during their escape. While hiding, Cai Zhao struggles to treat Mu Qing Yan’s wounds and searches desperately for medicine, even pawning her cherished necklace to buy healing herbs.

episodes.name: A Rift between Them
episodes.overview: While hiding in a remote village, Cai Zhao and Mu Qing Yan hear stories about the past relationship between Mu Zheng Yang and Cai Ping Zhu, revealing more about the tragic history connecting their families. However, Cai Zhao later discovers that Mu Qing Yan secretly captured the families of the six sects to force them into allowing their escape. Shocked by his ruthless methods and feeling used as part of his plan, she becomes deeply hurt and decides to leave him.

episodes.name: Cai Zhao Accepts Punishment
episodes.overview: Before leaving, Cai Zhao paints a picture of her childhood and shares it with Mu Qing Yan, encouraging him to move forward with his life. She then returns to Qingque Sect to take responsibility for helping him escape. Accused of colluding with Li Sect, Cai Zhao willingly accepts severe punishment. She is publicly whipped and then confined to the back mountain for a year as penance.

episodes.name: A Year of Separation
episodes.overview: During Cai Zhao’s confinement, Song Yu Zhi regularly visits to bring her food and quietly care for her. Meanwhile, Mu Qing Yan forbids his followers from mentioning Cai Zhao, though he still secretly thinks about her. At the same time, rumors begin spreading about corpse puppets appearing again, creating suspicion among the martial sects and hinting at a deeper conspiracy.

episodes.name: Poison and Pursuit
episodes.overview: Chaos erupts when Song Shi Jun loses control and attacks those around him. In the conflict that follows, he is killed, and Song Yu Zhi is poisoned. Cai Zhao and her companions flee into Blood Marsh Forest in search of a cure. Mu Qing Yan arrives just in time to save them from pursuers. Together they search for the rare herb Night Orchid, the only medicine capable of saving Song Yu Zhi’s life.

episodes.name: Night Orchid and New Conflicts
episodes.overview: With Cai Zhao’s help, Song Yu Zhi is finally cured using the Night Orchid. However, she realizes the herb is also essential for Mu Qing Yan’s dangerous cultivation technique. To prevent further harm, she burns the remaining plants, and Mu Qing Yan ultimately decides to abandon the technique. Meanwhile, the conspiracy involving Yang He Ying is gradually exposed, causing turmoil within Guangtian Gate. As tensions rise and the Song brothers compete for leadership, Mu Qing Yan unexpectedly appears in Luo Ying Valley and publicly proposes marriage to Cai Zhao.

episodes.name: Mu Qing Yan Brings Betrothal Gifts
episodes.overview: Mu Qing Yan arrives in Luoying Valley with lavish betrothal gifts, proposing to Cai Zhao. While Song Yu Zhi worries his identity will bring trouble, Mu Qing Yan reveals his true plan, using the Purple Jade Golden Sunflower as bait to lure out the mysterious black-clothed enemies. As they track the artifact to a Daoist temple, they recover it, but are soon ambushed. Forced to hand it over, Cai Zhao and Mu Qing Yan barely escape, gravely injured, deepening both the danger and their bond.

episodes.name: Truth Beneath the Past
episodes.overview: Mu Qing Yan uncovers records revealing Mu Zheng Yang’s past, his role in manipulating Nie Hengcheng and the tragic chain of events that led to Cai Ping Zhu’s downfall. The truth shakes Cai Zhao, especially as suspicion begins to fall on Qi Yun Ke. When they return, they discover Qi Yun Ke’s dark secret: he is the true mastermind and plans to use his own daughter’s blood to complete the forbidden technique. The sect falls into chaos as Cai Zhao attempts to intervene.

episodes.name: Cai Zhao Is Wounded
episodes.overview: Qi Yun Ke’s madness escalates as he sacrifices everything, even his family, for power. After killing Yin Su Lian, he hunts down Cai Zhao and Qi Ling Bo. Cai Zhao protects Ling Bo and escapes while severely injured. With help from Lei Xiu Ming, she learns the full scope of Qi Yun Ke’s plan and sets out to save the imprisoned disciples and stop him.

episodes.name: The Six Sects Attack
episodes.overview: The six sects unite and storm Qingque Sect to stop Qi Yun Ke. As battles erupt across the mountain, multiple conflicts unfold, Song Yu Zhi defeats Song Xiu Zhi, Yang Xiao Lan kills her father, and allies turn against each other. At the climax, Cai Zhao confronts Qi Yun Ke. As he loses control, she delivers the final blow, and in his last moment of clarity, he accepts his fate, bringing the chaos to an end.

episodes.name: Mu Qing Yan Returns
episodes.overview: With Qi Yun Ke dead, peace gradually returns. Believed to be dying, Mu Qing Yan entrusts his legacy to others and appears to pass away in Cai Zhao’s arms, leaving her heartbroken. However, it is later revealed that he faked his death to escape his past identity. Months later, he returns, and the two prepare for a new life together. As friends gather and old wounds begin to heal, Cai Zhao and Mu Qing Yan finally move toward a peaceful future.

series.name: The Early Spring
aka: ฤดูใหม่นี้มีเพียงสองเรา
series.overview: Shang Zhitao, une jeune diplômée ordinaire, décroche contre toute attente un poste dans une prestigieuse agence de publicité à Pékin. Dès son premier jour, son patron exigeant au verbe acéré, Luan Nian, lui conseille sèchement de démissionner.  Sans se laisser décourager, elle s'accroche, surmonte la pression de l'entreprise et fait ses preuves. Au fil des défis professionnels, une jalousie mutuelle et une romance secrète complexe s'installent entre la jeune recrue et son supérieur. Après plusieurs années de vie commune, une série de malentendus pousse Zhitao à tout quitter du jour au lendemain pour retourner vivre dans sa ville natale. Ce n'est que six ans plus tard que leurs chemins se croisent à nouveau, alors qu'elle a mûri et dirige sa propre entreprise.

episodes.name: Tu N'Es Pas Adaptée
episodes.overview: Après avoir raté un entretien d'embauche dans une agence réputée, Shang Zhitao se démène pour trouver ses marques à Pékin tout en se liant d'amitié avec sa nouvelle colocataire.

episodes.name: Le Monde Du Travail N'Est Pas Un Jeu D'Enfant
episodes.overview: Lors d'un dîner organisé pour fêter la signature d'un nouveau projet, Nian intervient pour aider Zhitao. Pendant ce temps, une erreur d'identité menace la paix chez Sun Yu.

episodes.name: Rendre Une Faveur Au Prix De Sa Vie
episodes.overview: Après avoir échappé à un agresseur lors d'un tournage sous la pluie en montagne, Zhitao et Nian ne peuvent compter que sur eux-mêmes lorsqu'un glissement de terrain les isole.

episodes.name: Suis-Moi À La Maison
episodes.overview: Une femme appartenant au passé de Nian vient perturber son dîner avec Zhitao, tandis qu'une rencontre fortuite dans un bar fait remonter à la surface sa jalousie grandissante.

episodes.name: Peux-Tu Contrôler L'Amour?
episodes.overview: Après une nuit non préméditée avec Nian, Zhitao insiste pour que leur relation reste strictement professionnelle, malgré les efforts de ce dernier pour la séduire.

episodes.name: Le Premier Verre De Lait D'Osmanthus
episodes.overview: Déterminée à prendre ses distances avec Nian, Zhitao demande une mutation, mais il refuse de la laisser partir et met à l'épreuve les limites qu'ils s'étaient fixées.

episodes.name: La Vie Ne Vaincra Jamais Une Personne Ambitieuse
episodes.overview: Zhitao tente de se concentrer sur son travail et d'éviter Nian, mais un nouveau projet l'oblige à solliciter son aide alors que la jalousie commence à brouiller leur jugement.

episodes.name: Le Premier Qui Tombe Amoureux Finit Par Tout Perdre
episodes.overview: Alors que Zhitao est félicitée pour sa base de données, Nian est suspendu à la suite d'une plainte malveillante. Ils décident alors de profiter d'une retraite à la montagne.

episodes.name: L'Amour Est Un Bonbon Volé
episodes.overview: Malgré un budget limité, Zhitao parvient à obtenir un parrainage pour le tournoi de basket, impressionnant ainsi ses collègues, tandis que Nian fait une proposition surprenante.

episodes.name: Être Avec Toi, C'Est Sauter Dans L'Inconnu
episodes.overview: Une histoire d'amour secrète naît entre Zhitao et Nian, mais une erreur commise au travail menace le fragile équilibre qu'ils se sont efforcés de maintenir.

episodes.name: La Douce Amertume Des Débuts De L'Amour
episodes.overview: Lorsque Zang Yao accepte les fleurs envoyées au bureau, Zhitao se fait de fausses idées et décide de prendre quelques jours de congé et de les passer avec ses colocataires.

episodes.name: Chutes De Neige Avec Toi À Mes Côtés
episodes.overview: La tension monte entre Nian et Zhitao lorsqu'il tente de prendre soin d'elle pendant les vacances. Pendant ce temps, Yao décide de faire le premier pas auprès de son béguin.

episodes.name: A-T-On Un Avenir ?
episodes.overview: Zhitao reçoit une offre d'emploi inattendue lors d'un séminaire d'entreprise à Phuket, mais une conversation au bord de la mer met en lumière les divergences qui l'opposent à Nian.

episodes.name: L'Amour, C'Est Faire Des Exceptions
episodes.overview: Alors que ses colocataires Yu et Yuanzhu sont retenus à l'hôpital, Zhitao est harcelée par une agence de location peu scrupuleuse, incitant Nian à intervenir.

episodes.name: Deux personnes, un cœur
episodes.overview: Alors que Zhitao est en proie à des doutes quant à son avenir avec Nian, un nouveau directeur général s'efforce de saper son autorité au bureau.

episodes.name: Je pense à toi en ce moment, je te verrai dans le prochain
episodes.overview: Dony tente de rallier Zhitao à sa cause alors que Nian se méfie de plus en plus de son nouveau patron. Pendant ce temps, Zang Yao s'apprête à retourner au Royaume-Uni.

episodes.name: Le courage, c'est agir malgré la peur
episodes.overview: Après avoir appris le comportement inapproprié de Dony au travail, Zhitao prend les choses en main, provoquant un tollé au bureau et inquiétant Nian.

episodes.name: Liste de choses à faire dans la vie
episodes.overview: La jalousie de Nian s'enflamme après un malentendu lors d'un speed-dating, et une rencontre fortuite avec l'ex de Zhitao creuse encore davantage le fossé entre eux.

episodes.name: Un Nouveau Saut Dans L'Inconnu
episodes.overview: Nian devient méfiant lorsque Zhitao envisage de travailler en dehors de la ville. Un problème de santé oblige enfin le couple à se pencher sur son avenir.

episodes.name: Je Veillerai Sur Toi De Là-Haut, Jusqu'à Ce Que Ta Vie Soit Complète
episodes.overview: Yuanzhu avoue enfin ses sentiments à Zhitao, mais lorsqu'une nouvelle dévastatrice tombe, Nian confond la compassion de cette dernière avec un sentiment d'une autre nature.

episodes.name: Un Grand Départ
episodes.overview: Un scandale au bureau réduit les chances de Zhitao de remporter un prix décerné par l'entreprise, la poussant à reconsidérer sa carrière - et son avenir avec Nian.

episodes.name: Le Numéro Composé N'Est Pas Attribué
episodes.overview: Nian découvre la vérité derrière le départ soudain de Zhitao, tandis que celle-ci retourne à Harbin pour s'occuper de son père et prendre un nouveau départ.

episodes.name: Luke Est Aussi Mon Chien
episodes.overview: Nian tente de se faire pardonner par Zhitao après l'avoir retrouvée à Harbin, profitant de ses visites chez Luke pour regagner peu à peu sa place dans sa vie.

episodes.name: Shang Zhitao, Bon Retour À Pékin
episodes.overview: Une crise financière ramène Nian à Harbin où il se démène pour aider Zhitao. L'ancien couple a ainsi la possibilité de faire le point sur sa relation brisée.

series.name: Pull Strings
aka: ศิษย์พี่อย่าเคร่งนักเลย
Shi Xiong Zai Tai Wen Jian
Wo Shi Xiong Shi Zai Tai Wen Jian Le
series.overview: Dans l'ère perfide qui précède la Grande Guerre de l'Investiture des Dieux, Li Chang Shou (Ao Rui Peng) est un petit cultivateur spirituel dont l'ambition modeste est d'atteindre l'immortalité sans faire de vagues. Guidé par une philosophie de prudence extrême, il évite la confrontation à tout prix, agissant avec un comportement calculé et posé. Cependant, sa vie de solitude soigneusement construite est bouleversée lorsque son maître accueille un nouveau disciple. Malgré tous ses efforts pour rester un acteur de second plan discret, son talent inné et son éclat tactique font que chacun de ses mouvements laisse un impact bouleversant. Alors qu'il équilibre son désir de sécurité avec le chaos qui l'entoure, Li Chang Shou deve naviguer à travers de nouvelles complications sans y perdre la vie. Ce drame est adapté du roman en ligne "My Senior Brother Is Too Steady" de Yan Gui Zheng Zhuan.

series.name: Archives: The Nanyang Mystery
aka: บันทึกคดีแดนใต้
series.overview: Au tout début de la République de Chine, un mystérieux meurtre en mer entraîne Zhang Haiyan et son partenaire dans une enquête qui dégénère rapidement en une dangereuse conspiration. Ce qui commence comme une quête de vérité à bord de l'imposant navire Nan'an se transforme rapidement en une lutte pour la survie dans un monde d'intrigues et de trahisons.

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: The mystery began in Balai, Nanyang, during what was supposed to be a joyous wedding ceremony. Amidst the celebrations, a putrid, sickening stench suddenly filled the air, originating from a bizarre wedding gift presented by the clan. The bride and groom were urged to abandon their mortal bodies in exchange for everything a human could ever desire. Not long after, the mutilated corpses of the groom's family were discovered in a salt marsh deep in Nanyang.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: Zhang Hailou and Zhang Haixia smuggled themselves into Xucheng by playing dead to avoid paying the steep head tax. Upon entering, they found the city in ruins, littered with lifeless bodies despite no reports of plagues or bandit attacks. Upon closer inspection of the corpses, Zhang Haixia noted a bluish-purple coloration on one victim's face and an angle of compression on the neck, indicating death by suffocation. Another body nearby had slit wrists.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: Following their decision to venture into the depths of the reef cave to resolve the crisis, Zhang Hailou and Zhang Haixia made their way inside despite the desperate warnings of onlookers to stay away. Inside, they discovered a calcified Ming Dynasty shipwreck that had merged completely with the surrounding reef, filling the damp air with a heavy stench of rotting flesh. Deep within the ship's hold, they found decayed corpses suspended in bags.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: Deep in the rainforest, an archaeological expedition team led by Professor Warner had been excavating for months in search of ancient treasures. Suddenly, a mysterious, disguised woman carrying severed arms breached their camp. Recognizing a dark black magic curse, she sought out Warner to make a deal. The woman was actually Zhang Haiqi in disguise.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: Determined to uncover the truth and save Zhang Haixia as quickly as possible, Zhang Hailou began his investigation on the Nan'an. To gather clues, he played cards with three crew members, deliberately losing money to get them to talk. Once Steven grew tired of watching him lose and stepped outside after lending him some money, Zhang Hailou distributed the cash among the crew.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: In a deep shaft in the ship's hold, Zhang Hailou discovered a body trapped by a living Evil God. Seeing flies swarming around it, he deduced the person had died recently and decided to climb down to investigate. He instructed Steven to stay above as a lookout. If any danger arose or if the creature reanimated, Steven was supposed to break the head off a small hostage statue they had; otherwise, they would both be doomed.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: Zhang Haixia was not trapped in a fantasy. He knew he had been poisoned because he smelled the distinct stench of cured meat when he first met Chen Xifeng—a foul odor that went entirely unnoticed by the others on the ship. Realizing his perception was altered, he knew his mind was playing tricks on him. Despite his paralyzed legs, his intellect remained fully functional, allowing him to set a series of traps in his room to capture his assailant.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: He Jianxi slowly regained consciousness after being in a coma for an entire day, only to find himself confronted by a startling truth. He asked the man before him if he was truly the infamous Plague. Zhang Hailou merely smiled, praising Jianxi’s incredibly sharp sense of smell, which allowed him to detect even the faintest trace of turmeric. The talent strongly reminded Hailou of his close friend, Zhang Haixia. Hailou had already packed up almost all of Jianxi’s belongings.

episodes.name: Épisode 9
episodes.overview: Fleeing the pursuing assassins, Zhang Hailou used his exceptional martial arts skills to carry He Jianxi up to the third floor, slipping into Steven's private bathroom while the killers searched the lower decks. Exhausted and weak, Zhang Hailou revealed to He Jianxi that he had been poisoned. He Jianxi sarcastically remarked that as the dreaded Plague, Zhang Hailou should have planned for such a setback. Ignoring the banter, Zhang Hailou focused on their immediate survival.

episodes.name: Épisode 10
episodes.overview: During the chaotic struggle in the cargo hold, Zhang Hailou fought desperately against the onslaught of assassins. He Jianxi remained in the shadows, using his keen senses to monitor the surroundings and warn Zhang Hailou of incoming threats, shouting that the attackers were trying to wear him down. However, the killers eventually noticed He Jianxi and charged at him. Zhang Haiqi suddenly intervened from the darkness, effortlessly dispatching the threat and saving He Jianxi's life.

episodes.name: Épisode 11
episodes.overview: Zhang Hailou and He Jianxi finally arrived in Xiacheng, exhausted from their long journey. As they stepped ashore, Zhang Hailou looked around, his mind drifting back to a memory of Zhang Haixia. He recalled how he had promised to take him to Balongzhou to make a name for themselves, so they could eventually return to Xiacheng in glory to see their mentor.

episodes.name: Épisode 12
episodes.overview: In the Dong Residence, Zhang Hailou is devastated by the revelation of his past mistakes. He demands to know who the woman posing as Miss Dong really is and where his master, Zhang Haiqi, is. She coldly lies to him, claiming his master is dead along with everyone else except the two of them.

episodes.name: Épisode 13
episodes.overview: Zhang Haiqi returned to the Dong Mansion, heavily wounded from her previous encounter at the military base. Recognizing the imminent danger, she urged Mr. Dong to take his family and flee Xiacheng immediately, suggesting they go out to sea. However, Mr. Dong refused to leave her behind. He reasoned that because they were in the foreign concession and she was widely known as the daughter of the influential Ship King, no one would dare to make a move against them.

episodes.name: Épisode 14
episodes.overview: Zhang Hailou finally steps into the Southern Archives, a moment he has anticipated for ten years. His companion, who is posing as He Jianxi, marvels at the spectacular sight and asks what the Archives actually does. Zhang Hailou explains that it was a secret organization under the Maritime Supervisory Office, dedicated to investigating and cataloging all the bizarre anomalies of the southern lands.

episodes.name: Épisode 15
episodes.overview: Lu Junxiang cornered Zhang Haiqi, confidently declaring that she had run out of places to escape. However, Zhang Haiqi remained unfazed, having already prepared a way out. Just as Lu Junxiang's men rushed into the chamber, the ocean water that had begun pouring into the underground ruins suddenly breached the walls, violently flooding the area and sweeping the henchmen away. Seizing the opportunity, Zhang Haiqi pinned Lu Junxiang down by trapping his leg under a massive boulder.

episodes.name: Épisode 16
episodes.overview: Continuing from their long separation, the two brothers finally reunite. Overjoyed to see his brother awake, Zhang Hailou eagerly moves in for a warm embrace. However, their mentor, Zhang Haiqi, interrupts the emotional moment by tossing an object that strikes and lightly injures Zhang Hailou. Though Zhang Haixia is happy to be awake, he secretly senses a strange, inexplicable sensation stirring deep within himself.

episodes.name: Épisode 17
episodes.overview: Zhang Haixia and Zhang Hailou spent the evening drinking together at home. After Hailou drank too much and lamented that things might have been different if he had been the one crippled, he fell asleep at the table. Seeking some fresh air, Haixia went out into the streets. There, he came across a group of drunk thugs viciously tormenting a helpless beggar.

episodes.name: Épisode 18
episodes.overview: Zhang Haixia did not want his mentor, Zhang Haiqi, to carry the heavy burden of guilt, so he expressed his desire to handle their enemy, Mo Yungao, himself. Although Zhang Haiqi was deeply concerned about his physical state and the consequences, she ultimately respected his decision. Having spent three agonizing years paralyzed in Nanyang under the selfless care of Zhang Hailou, Haixia desperately wanted to prove he was no longer a burden to anyone.

episodes.name: Épisode 19
episodes.overview: During the confrontation with Zhang Changlin's men, the situation takes a bizarre turn. As Changlin attacks Zhang Haixia, a strange, crazed persona seems to take hold of Haixia. Muttering violently, he pulls out a grenade, prepared to blow up his attacker and himself. Zhang Hailou watches in utter disbelief, barely recognizing his brother. Fortunately, Changlin manages to dive away just before the explosion.

episodes.name: Épisode 20
episodes.overview: Adjutant Zhang Changlin escorted Zhang Haiqi and Zhang Hailou into Zhang Qishan’s residence. Zhang Qishan invited them to sit, dryly noting that while he rarely welcomed members of the Zhang family, he could not simply throw them out since they had already arrived. Zhang Haiqi skipped the pleasantries and prompted Zhang Hailou to state their business.

episodes.name: Épisode 21
episodes.overview: Zhang Haiqi and Zhang Hailou carry out their daring plan to infiltrate Mo Yungao's special train as it speeds through a dark mountain tunnel. Waiting in the shadows, they have a mere twenty seconds to make their move. They successfully leap onto the moving carriage, swiftly neutralizing two unsuspecting guards who were casually discussing their post-trip drinking plans.

episodes.name: Épisode 22
episodes.overview: Following the destruction of the secret base, Zhang Haixia made a phone call to Mo Yungao, coldly informing him that his men had been completely wiped out. Identifying himself as an agent of the Southern Archives, Haixia noted that Mo Yungao once possessed a conscience and questioned why he had fallen so low, asking where people like them would ultimately end up.

episodes.name: Épisode 23
episodes.overview: Zhang Hailou woke up aboard a train heading deep into the vast mountains of Nanqiang. Sitting across from him, his mentor Zhang Haiqi handed him the research files on Bailejing, a legendary paradise hidden within the wilderness. Zhang Hailou noted the reports of rampant bandits, poisonous pests, and a fierce populace, which made entry almost impossible for ordinary people. When asked, Zhang Haiqi recalled investigating an unsolved case there years ago.

episodes.name: Épisode 24
episodes.overview: Following Mo Yungao's instructions, Zhang Haixia led an advance party of four warlord soldiers to scout a roadside inn, which served as the primary gateway to Bailejing. Unbeknownst to them, the inn was run by the local bandits of Phoenix Fortress. Spotting the heavily armed soldiers arriving late at night, the proprietor and his son, Xiao'er, quickly hid their guests and prepared for a potential confrontation.

episodes.name: Épisode 25
episodes.overview: After kneeling and calling Zhang Haiqi his "mentor's wife," Zhang Qianjunwanma points to a portrait of a woman from behind, explaining that she was the woman his mentor, Zhang Qianzhang, loved most in his life. Decades ago, Zhang Haiqi had been severely injured in the mountains and fired a flare to summon help from the Zhang family. It was Zhang Qianzhang who answered the call, falling in love with her at first sight.

episodes.name: Épisode 26
episodes.overview: As Zhang Haixia traveled by raft toward Bailejing, he was accompanied by three soldiers assigned by Mo Yungao. One of the soldiers tried to ease the tension, hoping Zhang Haixia would not hold their past conflicts against them. Deeming the man far too noisy, Zhang Haixia swiftly executed all three soldiers, leaving their bodies behind as he continued his journey alone. Inside Bailejing, High Priest Su Ya was receiving a local family whose young boy he had recently saved.

episodes.name: Épisode 27
episodes.overview: Zhang Hailou is furious when Zhang Haiqi abruptly calls him back, as he had been on the verge of waiting for Zhang Haixia. When Hailou confronts her about hiding the truth, she warns him against seeking his adoptive brother out. Hailou points out that Haixia slaughtered everyone in Priest Su Ya's mansion and hung the priest's corpse on a water cart just to avenge them, proving he has lost his mind.

episodes.name: Épisode 28
episodes.overview: In the quiet of the woods, Zhang Haixia crossed paths with two local men who were searching for the tattooed outsider (Zhang Hailou). Unaware of Zhang Haixia's true identity, the men vulgarized the outsider who had allegedly run off with the Mountain God's bride, suggesting they would castrate him once caught. One man even boasted about taking the beautiful bride as his own concubine.

episodes.name: Épisode 29
episodes.overview: Following his mentor's disappearance into the secret passage, Zhang Hailou was forced to disguise himself as the bride to keep up appearances. He was soon brought to the altar at the Feikun Balu Temple, where the locals gathered for the wedding ceremony. The auspicious hour arrived, and the crowd called for the great Feikun Balu to accept his bride. However, the ruse did not last long. The locals quickly realized the bride was actually a man.

episodes.name: Épisode 30
episodes.overview: Zhang Hailou’s rage boils over as he faces the unrecognizable version of his brother, Zhang Haixia. The two clash with equal fury and skill, trading blows in a tense stalemate where neither can bring themselves to deliver a lethal strike. Their duel is cut short when the sky begins to rain the ominous pollen of the Twilight Grass. Realizing Mo Yungao’s devastating plan has succeeded, Zhang Haixia points out that their commander has finally achieved his goal.

episodes.name: Épisode 31
episodes.overview: Zhang Haixia, operating under his masked persona, Heixia, confronted Mo Yungao. Holding him at gunpoint, Zhang Haixia cold-bloodedly questioned if even immortals could withstand bullets. Mo Yungao, realizing his defeat, admitted he had not misjudged the young man's formidable nature. Addressing him as Adjutant Mo, Zhang Haixia declared that he would personally fulfill his dying wish. In his final moments, Mo Yungao recalled an old prophecy concerning three adjutants meeting their ends to realize a grand plan.

episodes.name: Épisode 32
episodes.overview: Zhang Hailou dragged Zhang Qianjun through the subterranean passages. Recovering from his near-death experience, Zhang Qianjun suddenly remembered a vital piece of information. Years ago, his mentor, Zhang Qianzhang, had sent a confidential file to the Archives. The document detailed how the ancestors of the Zhang family had once explored Nanqiang and encountered an ancient, mysterious tribe called the Wupi Tribe deep in the mountain forests.

episodes.name: Épisode 33
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of his injuries, Zhang Hailou regained consciousness and shared a startling realization with Feng Huang. He explained that Zhang Haixia’s body was host to two completely separate minds. While they shared physical senses like sight, hearing, and touch, they remained entirely blind to each other's memories and thoughts. Trapped within his own mind like a prisoner, the true Haixia was powerless while the malicious entity Hailou named Heixia (the dark consciousness) controlled his actions.

series.name: Love Has Fireworks
aka: O Amor Tem Fogos de Artifício
เมื่อรักส่องประกาย
series.overview: La banquière d'investissement Qian Fei (Wang Chu Ran) est prête à franchir une nouvelle étape dans sa relation et à emménager dans l'appartement qu'elle a choisi avec son fiancé. Mais lorsqu'il la quitte pour une autre femme, elle se retrouve le cœur brisé, avec un lourd prêt à rembourser. Pour alléger son fardeau financier, Qian Fei décide de louer une chambre de son appartement. Li Yi Fei (Tan Jian Ci), héritier d'une puissante famille d'affaires et étoile montante d'une banque d'investissement, s'y installe avec sa petite amie. Cependant, leur relation prend rapidement fin et Yi Fei choisit malgré tout de rester. Contre toute attente, Qian Fei et lui se sentent attirés l'un par l'autre : en travaillant ensemble sur une introduction en bourse, ils apprennent à se soutenir et à affronter les épreuves de la vie. Cette série est adaptée du roman "We Live Together" de Hong Jiu.

episodes.name: First Impression
episodes.overview: Investment banker Qian Fei is having a meal at a noodle shop when she happens to cross paths with an investment banking elite, Li Yifei, leaving her with an exaggeratedly negative impression of him. Qian Fei is taken by her director, Fang Yun, to a bidding venue, where Li Yifei rushes in through the back entrance to save time, crashes into Qian Fei, and breaks her phone.

episodes.name: Flatmates
episodes.overview: After Qian Fei breaks up with Wang Ruohai, she packs her things and moves to her new place, only to find that her new flatmate is Li Yifei.

episodes.name: Qian Fei Gets Fired
episodes.overview: After learning that Qian Fei has been fired, Li Yifei suspects his father is behind it and returns to the family mansion to confront him.

episodes.name: Li Yifei's Breakup
episodes.overview: After breaking up, Li Yifei throws himself into work. He focuses on discovering the reason Shanlifang chooses to have a joint sponsorship.

episodes.name: Differences in Views on Money
episodes.overview: Li Yifei calls an electrician to fix the circuit. Qian Fei thinks it's a waste of money, but Li Yifei argues that time is more valuable than money.

episodes.name: Growing Closer
episodes.overview: With Li Yifei's help, Qian Fei works through the night to revise her research report and feels deeply grateful to him. Da Jun tells Li Yifei that he's fallen for Dang Yu, and also suspects that Li Yifei has feelings for Qian Fei. However, Li Yifei remains completely oblivious to it himself.

episodes.name: Working Together
episodes.overview: Qian Fei goes to Chengdu to find Shanlifang's ex employee and meets Li Yifei at the airport. Both people think there's something wrong about Shanlifang's financial report and decide to work together.

episodes.name: Reinstated
episodes.overview: Li Yifei pleads for Qian Fei and suggests that Fang Yun lay their cards down with him. Qian Fei is reinstated as she wished.

episodes.name: Realizing His Feelings
episodes.overview: After Da Jun points out the changes in his behavior lately, Li Yifei finally realizes that he's fallen for Qian Fei.

episodes.name: Seeing Her Ex Again
episodes.overview: After learning that Wang Ruohai has joined Shanlifang, Qian Fei finds herself reminiscing about their time together when they were deeply in love. Li Yifei comes to comfort her. Qian Fei thanks him for his help.

episodes.name: Keeping Up With Him
episodes.overview: In the company, Qian Fei deliberately keeps a distance from Li Yifei. However, she admires his capabilities. She plans to work hard and follow in his footsteps.

episodes.name: Decision
episodes.overview: Li Yifei tells Da Jun that liking someone doesn't necessarily mean they need to court them. Qian Fei intends to focus on her career. Li Yifei intends to respect her decision.

episodes.name: Understanding
episodes.overview: Li Yifei asks Qian Fei why she's suddenly gone cold toward him. Qian Fei tells him she doesn't want to be used again. Li Yifei patiently explains his actions and intentions, and eventually earns Qian Fei's understanding.

episodes.name: The Little Things in Life
episodes.overview: On their way to work, Qian Fei buys a pancake. Li Yifei, who never intends to eat, snatches her pancake and starts eating. His obsession with cleanliness and OCD has completely disappeared.

episodes.name: Confrontation
episodes.overview: Wang Ruohai goes to Qian Fei's house and asks her to return the 500,000 loan she owes him. He even advises her to quit the Shanlifang project team.

episodes.name: Rejected Again
episodes.overview: Da Jun presses Dang Yu to explain why she thinks he's not good enough. Dang Yu tells him that he blindly follows his mother's wishes and lacks the ability to think independently. She rejects his confession once again.

episodes.name: Standing Her Ground
episodes.overview: Fang Yun asks Qian Fei to apologize to Liao Shiyu for the sake of the company, but Qian Fei refuses. She insists that she did nothing wrong in her personal affairs.

episodes.name: Changing Oneself
episodes.overview: Li Yifei realizes that he has been changing for Qian Fei through his habits. He encourages Da Jun to go after Tang Yu. Li Yifei and Da Jun both cheer for each other.

episodes.name: Winning Her Favor
episodes.overview: To calm the public backlash, Dang Yu goes live and publicly apologizes, but she ends up being targeted by online trolls. Determined to stand by her, Da Jun reveals his identity during a livestream and openly speaks up in her defense, In doing so, he finally wins her favor.

episodes.name: Garage Video
episodes.overview: A video suddenly surfaces online, showing Liao Shiyu violently assaulting Qian Fei, who had come to apologize, in a garage. Wang Ruohai seizes the opportunity to have Liao Shiyu kick Qian Fei off the project team.

episodes.name: Stand-Up Comedy
episodes.overview: Qian Fei and Li Yifei go to a stand-up comedy show together. Their playful banter brings them even closer.

episodes.name: Not Moving On
episodes.overview: Qian Fei asks Jingjing why she broke up with Lu Ze. Lu Ze still can't let go of Jingjing and calls Qian Fei to try to reconcile with Jingjing.

episodes.name: Just Friends
episodes.overview: To get Qian Fei to cook for him, Li Yifei offers to tutor her for the sponsor representative exam in exchange. They grow increasingly at ease with each other.

episodes.name: Watching Over Silently
episodes.overview: Qian Fei's father calls her and asks her whether the guy she brought with her to the blind date was her boyfriend. Lifei appears and pretends to be Qian Fei's boyfriend voluntarily.

episodes.name: Growth
episodes.overview: Lu Ze goes for various job interviews but to no avail. Yao Jingjing encourages him. They cherish each other.

episodes.name: Charity Gala
episodes.overview: The Charity Gala goes on as planned. Qian Fei blends into the venue as a waiter and hopes Liao Shiyu can read the apology speech she wrote.

episodes.name: Meeting Expectations
episodes.overview: Li Yifei insists on driving Qian Fei to the airport despite her objection. He also tells her that Jin Zi isn't his girlfriend. It causes Qian Fei to think that he just has something to hide.

episodes.name: Confession
episodes.overview: Li Yifei is selecting flowers at a florist. He calls Qian Fei on Valentine's Day. Qian Fei exposes him and asks him whether he's trying to wish her a happy Valentine's Day.

episodes.name: Qian Fei Gets Fired
episodes.overview: Qian Fei is designated as the culprit who leaked the company's info to Dian Sansan. Qian Fei wants to prove her innocence but to no avail. In the end, she gets fired.

episodes.name: Birthday
episodes.overview: Li Yifei goes out of his way to prepare a birthday meal for Qian Fei himself. They enjoy a wonderful birthday together. Just as Li Yifei is about to confess his feelings, a call from Qian Fei's father interrupts the moment.

episodes.name: The One Behind It
episodes.overview: While buried in work, Li Yifei also tries to sort out his feelings for Qian Fei and make sense of where they stand.

episodes.name: Helping Out
episodes.overview: Qian Fei takes the opportunity to attend the interview and successfully lands her ideal job.

episodes.name: Leads
episodes.overview: Li Yifei is involved in a legal case due to work negligence. To help Li Yifei acquire key evidence of his innocence, Qian Fei rushes to Taoyuanxi alone to retrieve her old computer.

episodes.name: Sweet Trouble
episodes.overview: Qian Fei starts her new job. When she leaves the office, she finds Li Yifei waiting outside with a bouquet of flowers. Feeling embarrassed, she pretends not to know him.

episodes.name: Status
episodes.overview: Qian Fei receives a text from Wang Ruohai and decides to sell her house to help Wang's mother with her kidney transplant.

episodes.name: Forgiveness
episodes.overview: Li Qiansheng sees that his son is now capable of standing on his own and finally acknowledges him. Qian Fei discovers Li Yifei's true identity.

series.name: Mouse
aka: ไซโคพาธ ยีนฆาตกรรมอำมหิต
マウス  ～ある殺人者の系譜～
พันธุ์นักฆ่า
series.overview: Jung Ba Reum (Lee Seung Gi) est un jeune policier dévoué à la justice et à son travail. Alors qu'il est satisfait de sa vie, tout bascule quand un tueur en série psychopathe se met à terroriser le pays. Avec l'aide de son partenaire, Go Mu Chi (Lee Hee Joon), Ba Reum tente d'arrêter le meurtrier. Mais sa vie change pour toujours lorsqu'il survit à une rencontre mortelle avec le criminel. Bouleversé par cette expérience, Ba Reum développe une obsession pour comprendre l'esprit des psychopathes, et plonge dans une quête sombre et dangereuse pour obtenir des réponses. Alors que la limite entre le bien et le mal commence à s'estomper, Ba Reum doit faire face aux horribles vérités qui pourraient balayer tout ce qu'il pensait savoir. Ce thriller sud-coréen a été réalisé en 2021 par Choi Joon Bae et Kang Cheol Woo.
