episodes.name: The Head Hunter
episodes.overview: Terrifying news of an unsolved serial killing case strikes the country, putting everyone in fear. One day, a family of four visits a camp site just to face a horrible death by this very serial killer, Head Hunter. A boy survives the ambush and later on pinpoints the prime suspect as the killer. Meanwhile, a gene test to verify an unborn fetus for its potential psychopathic characteristics is carried out on Head Hunter’s baby, and the baby’s mother has to make a choice.

episodes.name: Eye for an Eye
episodes.overview: Moo Chi visits the Head Hunter at the prison and tells him that he’ll not only kill the Head Hunter but find his son and make him suffer as he did. Meanwhile, more murder victims are found in a row and the culprit is leaving leads, asking to be noticed. When Ba Reum visits Moojin Prison, he sees the Head Hunter and also witnesses another murder case.

episodes.name: Resurfacing Murder Cases
episodes.overview: Chi Kook has been found at the prison with multiple stab marks all over his body along with a message written in blood. Not long after that, Chi Kook’s watch, a present gifted by Ba Reum and Dong Koo, was retrieved at the grape farm murder site, leading Ba Reum to join Moo Chi for the investigation. Meanwhile, Bong Yi’s grandmother stumbles upon something she should’ve never found out while working as a cleaning lady for Bong Yi’s settlement money.

episodes.name: Who Are You?
episodes.overview: After Bong Yi’s grandmother is murdered and a mysterious finger is found at a church, Moo Chi and his team start investigating more thoroughly. Moo Chi feels that something is suspicious about Doctor Sung Yo Han, but he can’t find any evidence yet. A boy suddenly gets kidnapped and Moo Chi gets a call from the kidnapper. He demands Moo Chi to find out the reason why the boy had to be kidnapped before a certain time. Will Moo Chi be able to save the kid?

episodes.name: The Live Broadcast
episodes.overview: An hour-long live broadcast goes on air in hopes to save Han Kook. But Ba Reum sets off to a discreet journey as the rest struggle hard to find out the predator’s motive of murder. During the live broadcast, endless tip-offs and reports from former victims of the predator flood into the broadcast station. The investigation seems to progress in a positive outlook as Moo Chi narrows down the suspects. Will they be able find the murderer in time?

episodes.name: The Donkey and the Goat
episodes.overview: After Moo Won is brutally murdered, Moo Chi gives up on everything and only keeps drinking. While Han Kook is still missing and his life is under threat, the police haven’t found any clues on the culprit. When Moo Chi gets back on his feet and starts investigating Bong Yi’s grandmother’s case, he finds out about Yo Han and his mother.

episodes.name: Memory Loss
episodes.overview: After getting a gunshot wound, Yo Han is in critical condition. Ba Reum gets brain surgery. But after receiving the brain surgery, he suffers from memory loss. After a year, Moo Chi is assigned to a new team that collects and organizes criminal evidence. Ba Reum starts to work for a small precinct. On his first day at work, he accidentally finds a dead body.

episodes.name: Ba-reum's Memories
episodes.overview: Ba Reum’s instinctive intuition helps Moo Chi get closer to the bottom of the mystery behind the knots. But he suffers from the random flashbacks that seem very unfamiliar. While investigating the suspects, Moo Chi and Ba Reum spot a man who stands out from the rest. On the other hand, Kang Duk Soo, who has been released from prison keeps trying to find out where Bong Yi lives.

episodes.name: Ba-reum's Brain
episodes.overview: Ba Reum finds out about a shocking story behind his brain surgery a year ago. He’s tormented by unwanted memories that keep haunting him. Detective Ko is furious at Han Seo Joon’s remark of being saved and being at peace after accepting Christ and decides to kill him himself.

episodes.name: Sung Yo-han in Me
episodes.overview: Ba Reum finds himself acting a lot more violent than before and realizes that it’s getting harder to control himself. He even gets the urge to kill someone. While Ba Reum is terrified that the Yo Han inside him might take him over completely, another murder case occurs that shows the MO of the previous murder cases. If Yo Han wasn’t the culprit of the serial murders, then is the piece of brain transplanted into Ba Reum’s head not of a psychopath?

episodes.name: Kill Him! Kill Her!
episodes.overview: Ba Reum keeps hearing Yo Han’s voice in his head telling him to kill people. The hallucination eventually made him murder Woo Hyung Chul. When he goes to the station to turn himself in, he finds out all the evidence related to his murder is gone, including Woo Hyung Chul’s body. Bong Yi runs into Kang Duk Soo, which makes her anxious. On a rainy day, Kang Duk Soo starts making a move again.

episodes.name: The Yo-han in Ba-reum
episodes.overview: After killing Kang Duk Soo, Ba Reum keeps a close eye on how the investigation rolls out. He tries to keep a foot ahead so his murder stays unveiled. Bong Yi on the other hand, thinks Moo Chi was the killer of Kang and keeps her mouth shut even when she’s being speculated as a suspect.

episodes.name: DNA on the Weapon
episodes.overview: The DNA result found on the weapon that was used to kill Kang Duk Soo confuses Moo Chi. Bong Yi joins Hong Ju’s team and starts investigating the Suseong serial murder case. With Ba Reum, Bong Yi begins to find the link between the Suseong serial murder cases and the Guryeong attempted murder case. At the same time, Moo Chi also looks into one of the inmates’ cases from Moojin Penitentiary.

episodes.name: The Cat Killer
episodes.overview: Ko Nam, a bright and insightful kid finds out about a cat killer around his neighborhood. One day, he promises to share his personal investigation with Bong Yi but unexpectedly goes through an accident. Ba Reum and Moo Chi dig deeper to find out who would’ve done such a heinous act to a little kid.

episodes.name: It Was All Me!
episodes.overview: Ba Reum starts to remember everything and is filled with guilt. When Ba Reum sees Han Kook’s mother desperately looking for her child even after a year, he decides to confess his crimes and clear Yo Han’s name. Meanwhile, Moo Chi notices that Chi Kook is lying and that he reacts strangely sensitive towards Ba Reum.

episodes.name: Was It Really Sung Yo-han?
episodes.overview: Chi Kook’s sudden death shocks everyone and Ba Reum tries to convince Chi Kook’s mom in requesting an autopsy. Meanwhile, Detective Ko starts to doubt that Sung Yo Han was the real killer. He starts to dig deeper into Song Soo Ho’s past.

episodes.name: The Guryeong Family Massacre
episodes.overview: Ba Reum finally remembers what exactly happened to his family. He tries to set a trap to catch the mysterious OZ, and he finds out a secret about Dr. Daniel Lee in the process. Meanwhile, Moo Chi finds the unregistered car the OZ, the murderer who killed Chi Kook, used.

episodes.name: Please, Give Me Some Time
episodes.overview: Moo Chi finds out that Ba Reum was the killer and ferociously charges after him at the station. Moo Chi also suspects Detective Lee being part of the OZ organization and tries to carry out an investigation on the two, but it’s not easy. As flustered as he is, Ba Reum tries to remain calm to buy time until he figures out the killer of Chi Kook.

episodes.name: Kim Joon-sung's Laptop
episodes.overview: Moo Chi and Bong Yi get closer to the truth. In the meantime, Ba Reum tries to find his aunt, the last missing puzzle piece. Sang, who tries to confirm Ba Reum’s alibi, finds something suspicious at Ba Reum’s house.

episodes.name: Ba-reum's Final Call
episodes.overview: Ba Reum makes the final decision to turn himself in and finish one last mission that only he can do. Hong Ju also shares her big secret that’s been tormenting her for years on her last show with Hee Jin, a woman who in fact was a secret agent working for Choi Young Shin under a massive private organization.

series.name: In My Prime
aka: ช่วงชีวิตที่ผลิบาน
series.overview:
Au début des années 90, dans la petite ville de Qingwu au nord, les familles Qi et Cao ont pour seul point commun d'être voisins et d'avoir vu leurs plus jeunes enfants, Qi Shi et Cao Xin naître exactement le même jour.
Cao Dong Fang, veuf depuis la mort de son épouse, élève seul ses enfants avec l'aide de son père.
Quand à Huo Qing Lian et sa femme Qi Ai Hua, tous les deux tiennent beaucoup l'un à l'autre mais ne cessent de se chamailler.

series.name: Genius Girlfriend
aka: แฟนสาวอัจฉริยะ
series.overview:
Lin Zhi Xia, jeune lycéenne, est un véritable petit génie mais a aussi du mal à se faire des amis à cause de sa nature asociale.
Mais tout change quand elle rencontre Jiang Yu Bai, son nouveau voisin de table et camarade de classe qui est tout aussi brillant qu'elle mais bien plus extraverti. Tous les deux se lient d'amitié après une compétition de mathématiques et il va aider Zhi Xia à sortir de sa coquille.

videos.name: Trailer: The Best Of Youth Is Standing Together! 👫| Genius Girlfriend 天才女友 | iQ

series.name: Fate Chooses You
aka: คู่สรรสวรรค์สร้าง
series.overview: Lu Qian Qiao est issu de la tribu des Fantômes de Guerre qui est presque entièrement éteinte depuis qu'ils ont fait face au châtiment divin. Aujourd'hui, Lu Qian Qiao espère raviver et restaurer son clan. Il noue alors un contrat spirituel avec Xin Mei, une disciple de la secte Tianyuan à la personnalité originale : ayant été victime d'une prophétie qui annoncerait la mort de son futur époux, elle cherche à s'acheter un mari !

videos.name: Allen Ren Breaking The Chains!🔥Fighting Against Fate for Freedom⚖️ | Fate Choos

series.name: Dazzling
aka: เปล่งรักประกายฝัน
series.overview:
Quand la famille de Ye Qing perd tout leur argent, ils sont obligés de quitter la capitale pour aller s'installer à la campagne.
Ye Qing, bien déterminée à partir d'ici un jour, se retrouve notamment à partager une chambre avec le jeune Wu Xing, tous les deux ne vivant séparés que par un rideau.
Tandis que lui est un cancre qui ne s'intéresse qu'à ses jeux vidéo et qu'elle est plongée dans ses études, tous les deux vont contre toute attente se rapprocher.

episodes.name: Head To a Place Where Hurricanes Hit
episodes.overview: Qing Ye originally planned to study abroad to honor her late mother's wish. Everything changed after her father was framed by a colleague and wrongfully drawn into an investigation. Entrusted by her father, Sun Hai took her from Beijing to Zhazhating, where she can lie low for a while at her aunt Li Lanfang's place.

episodes.name: Pride and Prejudice
episodes.overview: Qing Ye begins her new life in Zhazhating at Xing Wu's house, but the adjustment is anything but easy. Xing Wu finds her unreasonable, unaware that everything here is a world apart from the life Qing Ye once had.

episodes.name: Just Arrived, and the Downpour
episodes.overview: Having just arrived, Qing Ye is caught in a torrential downpour. At the hotel, she clashes with a gold-chain-wearing tough guy over excessive noise, until Xing Wu shows up just in time to intervene.

episodes.name: You're Actually Pretty Nice
episodes.overview: Xing Wu fixes Qing Ye's laptop. He looks into her drive to check for missing files. Seeing how glamorous Qing Ye's life used to be, he can't help but feel that they are from different worlds.

episodes.name: A Storm is Coming
episodes.overview: Xing Wu takes Qing Ye to Zhao Mazi's pre-wedding banquet. It is Qing Ye's first time to see the lively open-air banquet in Zhazhating. She experiences Zhazhating's local customs and culture and gradually adapts to life there.

episodes.name: My Home is Your Home
episodes.overview: Qing Ye leaves Zhazhating to go back to Beijing. Xing Wu and Qing Ye take a photo together, leaving behind one last warm memory.

episodes.name: Revitalizing Xuandao
episodes.overview: Qing Ye proposes revitalizing Xuandao by using promotional strategies to attract younger customers and drafts a detailed business plan.

episodes.name: Zhazhating's Stars
episodes.overview: Qing Ye successfully persuades "Zhazhating's Three Beauties" to be models for the Xuandao's promotional photos. Li Lanfang gives everyone beautiful styling, while Xing Wu finds Quan Ya to be in charge of photography.

episodes.name: The Legendary "Cousin-in-Law"
episodes.overview: Qing Ye learns that Shu Han and Xing Wu have been business partners for many years and senses that Shu Han has feelings for Xing Wu. Li Lanfang also tries her best to bring Xing Wu and Shu Han together.

episodes.name: Childhood Friend Appears Out of the Blue
episodes.overview: Meng Ruihang makes a special trip from Beijing to Zhazhating to find Qing Ye and even invites her to go abroad together a week later.

episodes.name: Stay or Leave
episodes.overview: Meng Ruihang asks Xing Wu to persuade Qing Ye to go abroad and return to her original path in life. Qing Ye is disappointed but doesn't give a clear answer.

episodes.name: Boss Xing or Student Xing?
episodes.overview: The Academic Director, impressed by Qing Ye's English skills, invites her to sign up to host the visiting foreign guests. Meanwhile, Xing Wu bumps into his former homeroom teacher, Mr. Zhu, who urges him to return to school or risk being expelled.

episodes.name: Dazzling Qing Ye
episodes.overview: Qing Ye and Ye Yingjian go to the school to prepare for the English Corner. During the initial English assessment, they find that the students' English level are extremely poor. Qing Ye gets a flash of inspiration and starts researching innovative English teaching methods at home.

episodes.name: With Expectations Comes Disappointments
episodes.overview: Qing Ye wants to persuade Xing Wu to return to school, but she is disappointed to learn that Xing Wu might give up returning to school and choose to work in the Electronics Street.

episodes.name: Every Cloud Has a Silver Lining
episodes.overview: Xuandao plans to reopen, while Grandma has recovered and been discharged from the hospital. Qing Ye no longer tries to persuade Xing Wu to return to school, believing that no matter which path he chooses, he'll end up where he wants to be.

episodes.name: An Eye for an Eye
episodes.overview: Qing Ye identifies the poster using their profile picture and locks in on Cao Fan. At school, she confronts Cao Fan and proposes a bet using their monthly exam scores. The loser would have to run 20 laps.

episodes.name: I Just Want to Get a High School Diploma
episodes.overview: Xing Wu and Qing Ye go to school together. Shu Han is devastated to learn that Xing Wu is giving up his job to go back to school.

episodes.name: I Want to Stay in School Too
episodes.overview: Shi Min plucks up the courage to tell her father that she's determined to continue her studies and study art. Qing Ye suggests that Shi Min take the arts-track exam, and Mr. Zhu also helps talk her father around.

episodes.name: We Who Strive for the Gaokao
episodes.overview: Xing Wu tells Qing Ye that he's decided to try for college, wanting to see what it's like to be a good student. Qing Ye is both surprised and delighted.

episodes.name: Nemesis
episodes.overview: Xing Wu and Cao Ping meet at the fishing wharf. Cao Ping says he can't let go of their past feud and swears to make Xing Wu and those around him suffer.

episodes.name: Leave the Past Behind, and Welcome the Future
episodes.overview: Qing Ye invites Cao Fan into their study group. Xing Wu joins in too, and they all buckle down to prepare for their final exams.

episodes.name: The Long Night of Chinese New Year
episodes.overview: Xing Wu and Cao Ping meet at the fishing wharf. Cao Ping says he can't let go of their past feud and swears to make Xing Wu and those around him suffer.

episodes.name: Through Every Challenge, One at a Time
episodes.overview: Xing Wu returns to the ruins of Xuandao, where Qing Ye comforts him with a hug. Sitting by the sea together, the two imagine the future and discuss how they might rebuild Xuandao.

episodes.name: We Who Aren't Good at Goodbyes
episodes.overview: Everyone hides the fact that the money is gone from Grandma. Li Lanfang, Xing Wu, and Qing Ye stack their hands together and promise to work hard, starting over from scratch.

episodes.name: Myriad Forms, Impermanence
episodes.overview: Qing Ye and Xing Wu delete each other's contact information, promising to reunite as their best selves. Xing Wu vows to catch up to her, and the two bid each other a final farewell.

episodes.name: Come Rain or Shine
episodes.overview: As the final push for the Gaokao begins, Xing Wu gazes wistfully at Qing Ye's empty seat. Outside of his studies, he helps restore Xuandao. He unexpectedly discovers that the Welwitschia is showing signs of new life and continues to care for it diligently.

episodes.name: Echo
episodes.overview: Qing Ye tells her father that she's decided to stay and study business at Qingbei. Xing Wu often keeps vigil at his grandmother's grave. He even dreams of reuniting with Qing Ye, but it is only a dream.

episodes.name: Reunion
episodes.overview: Xing Wu heads to Beijing for an internship, joining Aofei Group's rocket R&D project. Qing Ye buries herself in work, while Meng Ruihang remains by her side.

episodes.name: Together
episodes.overview: After Xing Wu arrives in Zhazhating, he searches everywhere for Qing Ye but can't find her. When the two finally reunite, there's no need for words. Years of feelings finally come pouring out.

episodes.name: Dazzling
episodes.overview: Qing Hongzhi brings Xing Wu and Qing Ye to a golf course. Xing Wu showcases his impressive golf skills, causing Qing Hongzhi to see him in a new light.

series.name: The First Jasmine
aka: ชายาเคียงหทัย
莫離～初恋のジャスミン～
series.overview: Ye Li, la fille aînée, épouse le prince Mo Xiuyao, un homme infirme, tandis que sa sœur Ye Ying se marie le même jour avec le prince Mo Jinglei. Descendante de Lishan, Ye Li cherche secrètement à se venger de ceux qui ont fait du tort à son clan. Soupçonnée par son mari, qui cache lui aussi un plan de vengeance, le couple finit par s’allier. Pendant ce temps, le prince Jinglei complote pour s'emparer du trône. Finalement, Ye Li et Mo Xiuyao unissent leurs forces pour vaincre leurs ennemis et rétablir la paix dans l'empire.

series.name: Royal Betrothal
aka: ฝ่าบาททรงพระเจริญหมื่นปี
series.overview: Sauvée de la mort il y a dix ans, Meng Ting Hui est passée du statut de survivante anonyme à celui de première femme érudite de la dynastie Daping à intégrer la prestigieuse Académie Hanlin. Réputée pour son esprit vif et sa ruse, elle a passé des années à naviguer dans les eaux troubles de la cour impériale. Alors que ses pairs ne voient en elle qu'une fonctionnaire impitoyable, elle voue un dévouement secret à l'homme qui l'a sauvée : l'empereur Ying Gua. Ting Hui est déterminée à aider Ying Gua à devenir le plus grand souverain de l'histoire, coûte que coûte. Mais au milieu des luttes de pouvoir et des intrigues politiques, Meng Ting Hui reste aveugle à la seule vérité qui pourrait tout changer : le cœur de l'empereur lui appartient depuis le début.

episodes.name: Encounter
episodes.overview: As a young child, Meng Tinghui fell into the hands of human traffickers. In her moment of despair, a youth clad in red enlightened her : only by studying, becoming an official, and having power can she truly exact revenge.

episodes.name: Standoff
episodes.overview: To retrieve the handwritten resume Ying Gua took, Meng Tinghui deliberately leaks his whereabouts on the street to both the Black Tiger Hall and Huo An's faction. That night, Ying Gua returns to Bofeng House with people to confront Meng Tinghui about the betrayal, and the two face off amidst a torrential downpour.

episodes.name: A Deal
episodes.overview: Meng Tinghui seizes the opportunity to escape prison and seeks out Ying Gua to propose a deal. She will guide him into Jiuyou City, and in return, he will restore her status as a law-abiding citizen, reinstating her eligibility for the Imperial Examination.

episodes.name: Childhood Memories
episodes.overview: Ying Gua returns Meng Tinghui's handwritten resume to her and invites her to go horseback riding. As she recounts the story of being abducted and trafficked as a child, Ying Gua realizes she is the same young beggar who stole his jade pendant a decade ago.

episodes.name: Exposing Fraud
episodes.overview: Meng Tinghui's discourse on policy in the Metropolitan Examination is plagiarized, and the perpetrator even attempts to silence her permanently. She decides to blow up the matter, printing and distributing leaflets on Changle Street to expose the fraud surrounding the discourse on policy of the Metropolitan Examination's Top Scholar.

episodes.name: His True Identity
episodes.overview: The Magistrate of the Metropolitan Office, Dong Shoucai, conspires with Jiang Mei'er and has Meng Tinghui thrown into prison. Jiang Mei'er orders the prison guards to set the prison ablaze to silence her. At the critical moment, Ying Gua arrives with the Shenwei Army, and only then does Meng Tinghui learn that He Du is actually the reigning Emperor.

episodes.name: Mass Petition
episodes.overview: Left Chancellor Xu Ting forcibly abolishes the Women's Special Imperial Examination. Meng Tinghui persuades Right Chancellor Gu Qin to help secure land for women's academies across all the provinces. She then gathers all the female tribute scholars to sign a joint petition and kneels in the rain in front of the Xu residence to plead their cause.

episodes.name: Establishing the Censorship Bureau
episodes.overview: Ying Gua announces the establishment of the Censorship Bureau and appoints Meng Tinghui to lead it, but Xu Ting vehemently objects, arguing that it would throw the court into disorder.

episodes.name: Dealing with the Tiger Roar Gang
episodes.overview: Meng Tinghui goes to Changle Street to offer a reward for information on the Tiger Roar Gang but unexpectedly uncovers a horrifying crime...

episodes.name: The Last Straw
episodes.overview: Meng Tinghui commands the Shenwei Army to publicly cane Lyu Er and his accomplices to death, curbing violence with violence.

episodes.name: Luring the Enemy Into a Trap
episodes.overview: Meng Tinghui is ambushed in prison, but the shadow guards arranged by Ying Gua appear just in time to rescue her. That is when she realizes that her imprisonment and the attack on her were all a trap set by Ying Gua to lure out the enemy.

episodes.name: Investigating the Gambling House
episodes.overview: Meng Tinghui and Ying Gua become suspicious of Xingrong Gambling House and go undercover to investigate. They discover it is a den where innocent female students are imprisoned and trafficked.

episodes.name: The Real Culprit
episodes.overview: Vice Minister Zheng of the Court of Judicial Review shields the culprit and falsely accuses Meng Tinghui of taking bribes. When Meng Tinghui unexpectedly notices the red jade thumb ring and bite mark on his hand, she realizes he is the true culprit behind Yue's murder.

episodes.name: Proposal
episodes.overview: Left Chancellor, Xu Ting's son, Xu Runze hears of Meng Tinghui's achievements and falls for her. He shows up with betrothal gifts to propose to her at Bofeng House in front of everyone.

episodes.name: Lifesaver
episodes.overview: Xu Ting, Wen Tao, and other court officials demand that Meng Tinghui be severely punished and the Censorship Bureau be dissolved. Ying Gua then reveals a shocking secret: he was the one who rescued Meng Tinghui in Shazhou 10 years ago.

episodes.name: Scandal
episodes.overview: In order to distance Ying Gua from Meng Tinghui, he sends Wen Tao's daughter, Wen Ruomei, into the palace. He schemes to get Wen Ruomei close to Ying Gua and create a scandal that will mislead the court and the public.

episodes.name: Colluding With the Gang
episodes.overview: The Blood Moon Society's Mr. Shangguan discovers that the Tiger Roar Gang is selling contraband drugs. He decides to join forces with them to distribute the Boundless Pill, a more potent and highly addictive drug, in a scheme to manipulate the powerful and wealthy.

episodes.name: Deepening Conflict
episodes.overview: Influenced by Gu Qin, Shen Zhili begins to question Meng Tinghui's "act first, report later" approach. The two clash repeatedly during discussions, causing a rift in their relationship.

episodes.name: Infiltrating Wanxiang House
episodes.overview: To investigate the source of the Boundless Pills, Meng Tinghui disguises herself as a man and infiltrates Wanxiang House, only to encounter Ying Gua, who is also there incognito to investigate.

episodes.name: Bloodbath in the Capital
episodes.overview: Ling Yunfei's letters of challenge fill the sky at Changle Street. He threatens a bloodbath in the capital using the Boundless Pills if the Imperial Court doesn't hand Meng Tinghui over by nightfall.

episodes.name: Ten-Day Deadline
episodes.overview: The victims surround the Censorship Bureau, crying and cursing. Faced with their fury, Meng Tinghui publicly sets a 10-day deadline for herself. If she fails to eradicate the Boundless Pills and apprehend Ling Yunfei, she will be removed from office and reduced to a commoner.

episodes.name: The Source of the Fuqing Herb
episodes.overview: Luo points out that the "money herb" that has been cultivated by valley dwellers for generations is the fuqing herb and that merchants come to purchase it every month. Ying Gua decides to infiltrate first. He, Meng Tinghui, and Yin Qing disguise themselves as valley dwellers delivering the herb and conduct the transaction with the merchants.

episodes.name: Took the Arrow
episodes.overview: Ling Yunfei forces Meng Tinghui to swallow the Boundless Pill. Huang Bo is stabbed by Ling Yunfei while saving Ying Gua and falls off a cliff.

episodes.name: After Hardship Comes Happiness
episodes.overview: Gu Qin keeps vigil for Yuan Lingyi in the mourning hall, claiming that she died taking a blade for him. Gu Qin acts as if he can't go on living without her.

episodes.name: Restore Order
episodes.overview: Under the guise of fighting corruption, the Censorship Bureau cracks down on the officials.

episodes.name: Nominating an Empress
episodes.overview: At court, the officials formally submit a joint petition recommending Shen Zhili as empress. Shen Wuchen uses his Imperial Mandate Tally to urge Ying Gua to issue the decree within seven days.

episodes.name: Punishing Gu Qin
episodes.overview: Chen Zhili barges into Gu Qin's birthday banquet and publicly exposes his hypocrisy. Ying Gua immediately produces a golden book that lists Gu Qin's crimes.

episodes.name: Edict of Self-reproach
episodes.overview: During the grand ancestral worship ceremony, the Phoenix Pendant's chain around Meng Tinghui's neck suddenly breaks and falls to the ground. All the officials are in an uproar and accuse her of coveting the position of empress. Xu Ting furiously denounces her as an enchantress who will bring ruin to the state. All the officials kneel to pressure Ying Gua to retract his edict of self-reproach and execute Meng Ting Hui.

episodes.name: Childhood Memories
episodes.overview: Ying Gua suspects that Shangguan is lurking close by his side. The Blood Moon Society holds a memorial ceremony for Mo Yuhan, Si Qin, and Si Hua. Mr. Shangguan vows to avenge them, welcome the princess, and reclaim their lost territory.

episodes.name: The Day of the Grand Wedding
episodes.overview: Ying Gua and Meng Tinghui hold their wedding at the Imperial Ancestral Hall. Assassins from the Blood Moon Society descend upon them and hold all the high-ranking officials hostage. Mr. Shangguan appears and declares that he will use the blood of Great Ning's emperor as an offering to the lost souls of Zhongwan.

episodes.name: Seeking a Way to Survive
episodes.overview: Meng Tinghui is brought back to the Zhongwan itinerant palace. The old clan leader performs a blood sacrifice, imploring her to restore the nation.

episodes.name: The Final Battle
episodes.overview: Ying Gua confronts Shangguan Zhao. Meng Tinghui arrives on horseback and reveals the edict announcing the new policies.

series.name: Final Table
aka: สงครามนักปรุง
series.overview:
Après la mort soudaine de son père, Choi Song I se retrouve à la tête du restaurant familial. Déterminée à préserver l'établissement, elle décide de participer à un prestigieux concours culinaire qui pourrait bien sceller son avenir.

Elle y retrouve Kang Han, alias « Chris K », un chef de renommée internationale, ainsi que Cha U Jin, son plus grand rival, un perfectionniste redoutable prêt à tout pour remporter la compétition. Sous la direction de Seon Jeong Won, productrice exécutive de l'émission The Table: K Chef 2026, les candidats s'affrontent à travers des épreuves culinaires toujours plus exigeantes, avec un seul objectif : décrocher le titre de meilleur chef de Corée.

Entre rivalités, ambitions et défis personnels, Song I devra faire ses preuves. Mais pour elle, l'enjeu dépasse largement la compétition : il s'agit avant tout de faire vivre le restaurant de son père et de préserver son héritage.

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: Free-spirited Chef Kang Han returns to Korea and visits Famiglia, where an encounter with its manager, Song-yi, leads to an unexpected commotion.

series.name: Oh! My Guard
aka: นี่ฉันอยากมีบอดี้การ์ดหรือนี่
理由もなく、君だ ～彼女は自称ボディーガード！？～
Anh Là Nam Chính Đời Em
It's You, Out of the Blue
series.overview: Une riche héritière solitaire se réveille après un accident, persuadée d’être l’héroïne de son drama coréen préféré. Pour l’aider à retrouver la mémoire, le véritable acteur principal de la série est engagé afin de jouer le jeu et de se faire passer pour son partenaire. Mais lorsque leur fausse relation commence à faire naître de véritables sentiments, la situation se complique…

cast.name: 임정민
cast.character: Man who moves out of the house

episodes.name: Hae-ra Steps Outside
episodes.overview: Oh Hae Ra, a wealthy heiress who has spent 20 years hiding from the outside world, escapes her lonely life through TV dramas and her obsession with star Um Tae Bong. When news of Tae Bong's accident draws her out of the safety of her home, Hae Ra takes her first steps into a world she has long feared. But what begins as a desperate trip to see her favourite star soon threatens her well-being.

series.name: Memories of Murder

series.name: My Loong
aka: คำสาปรักมังกร
series.overview:
Dans un monde déchiré par le conflit entre les humains et les démons, Gu Qing Yao, une jeune femme issue de la famille Gu, voit son destin basculer lorsqu’elle est choisie pour devenir l’Épouse du Dragon, un titre qui la condamne à être offerte en sacrifice au légendaire Dragon Azur.

Depuis la mort de leurs parents, elle et sa sœur aînée, Gu Qing Ya, n’ont pu compter que l’une sur l’autre pour survivre. Mais lorsque Gu Qing Yao est désignée pour ce sacrifice, sa vie prend un tournant inattendu. Elle fait alors la rencontre de Li Zhi, le mystérieux Dragon Azur maintenu sous scellés.

Liés par un destin qu’ils n’ont pas choisi, tous deux se retrouvent entraînés dans une lutte contre les forces qui cherchent à contrôler leur avenir. Entre secrets enfouis, sacrifices et volonté de liberté, Gu Qing Yao et Li Zhi devront affronter un destin qui pourrait bien bouleverser l’équilibre entre les deux mondes.

series.name: Born Again
series.overview: Après avoir été assassinée le jour de son mariage par ceux en qui elle avait confiance, une influenceuse se retrouve piégée dans une boucle temporelle, revivant sans cesse les heures précédant sa mort. Avec l’aide d’un mystérieux médecin qui se souvient lui aussi des précédentes boucles, elle tente de découvrir la vérité, démasquer le responsable et briser ce cycle mortel avant qu’il ne soit trop tard.

series.name: Summer Vacation
aka: ซัมเมอร์ วาเคชั่น
series.overview: Kim Ha Yeon (Cho Yi Hyun) est une jeune fille ordinaire de 18 ans qui rêve d'une vie aussi palpitante que celles qu'elle voit à l'écran. Son existence prend un tournant mystique et inattendu lorsqu'elle se rend dans le paisible village rural d'Upo-ri pour ses vacances d'été. Sur place, elle croise la route de Jo Yu Gyeom (Jin Young), l'héritier d'une illustre famille noble traditionnelle, et de sa petite amie, Sae Ryeong (Hong Ye Ji). Doté d'une beauté saisissante et d'un don exceptionnel pour la natation, il mène pourtant une existence terne, bridée par des règles désuètes et un quotidien répétitif. Alors que ces deux êtres aux antipodes se rencontrent au cœur de la beauté paisible d'Upo-ri, leurs univers s'entrechoquent, amorçant une métamorphose de leur quotidien et le début d'un été unique dans une vie.

series.name: Pandora: Beneath the Paradise
aka: パンドラ 偽りの楽園
Pandora: Al di là del Paradiso
series.overview: Avec un mari parfait et une fille adorable, Hong Tae-ra mène une vie enviée de tous. Cependant, ses souvenirs refoulés refont surface, et elle se retrouve piégée dans un destin semblable à celui de Pandore, dans la mythologie grecque. Au lieu d’une élégante robe de soirée et d’un bouquet de fleurs parfumées, elle se voit contrainte de porter une veste en cuir tachée de sang et de brandir un revolver de calibre 28. Tae-ra doit alors se venger et protéger sa famille bienaimée.

series.name: Payback
series.original_name: เพย์แบค เดอะซีรีส์
aka: เพย์แบค เดอะซีรีส์
series.overview:
Sun, ancien collecteur de dettes, voit sa vie basculer après la mort tragique de son petit frère, tué par un débiteur. Comme si cela ne suffisait pas, son petit ami Bank le trahit en disparaissant avec tout son argent. Endetté et obligé de payer les soins médicaux de sa mère, Sun tente de survivre tant bien que mal.

Cinq ans plus tard, il travaille comme livreur lorsqu'il recroise Bank, devenu une célébrité sous l'agence Dream Entertainment. En découvrant que celui-ci pourrait être lié à la mort de son frère, Sun décide d'intégrer le monde du divertissement afin de se rapprocher de lui et préparer sa vengeance.

Au sein de l'agence, il fait la rencontre de Jay, un homme froid et provocateur qui cache en réalité son rôle de directeur exécutif de Dream Entertainment. Malgré leurs disputes incessantes, une attirance de plus en plus forte naît entre eux. Sun finit également par comprendre que Jay est l'homme mystérieux qu'il avait rencontré cinq ans auparavant, alors qu'il portait un costume de mascotte en forme de lapin.

Shen Mo perd la mémoire à la suite d'un accident. Il prend soudainement que Ji Ming Xuan est son petit ami, alors qu'il ne l'est pas réellement.

Ils vont finalement vivre ensemble et, au cours de ces six mois, leurs sentiments deviennent réellement réciproques. Mais lorsque Shen Mo retrouve la mémoire, il oublie complètement les six mois qu'ils ont passés ensemble.

Ji Ming Xuan ne veut pas le perdre et lui propose alors un contrat de trois ans. Officiellement, Shen Mo devient son « amant sous contrat », mais derrière cette relation contractuelle, les deux hommes sont déjà profondément attachés l'un à l'autre.

L'étudiant Lin Zai paye un lourd tribut en perdant ses parents et son frère aîné. De manière inattendue, il découvre qu'il est immunisé contre les morsures, devenant une cible inestimable pour les factions au pouvoir.

Lorsque Lin Zai sauve A Lie, un agent spécial censé le traquer, un lien inattendu se tisse rapidement entre eux, évoluant vers une profonde intimité. Confrontés à un monde impitoyable et à des loyautés contradictoires, Lin Zai et A Lie devront faire des choix déchirants qui pousseront leur amour dans ses derniers retranchements.

episodes.overview: Lin Zai suffers another allergic reaction and collapses, prompting A-Leh to risk entering a zombie-infested town in search of medicine. Left alone, Lin Zai unexpectedly finds himself caught in a deadly plot against him.

episodes.name: What Mom Owes You
episodes.overview: After narrowly escaping death, Lin Zai tells A-Leh that all he wants is to return to the camp that feels like home, but A-Leh refuses to let him go.

episodes.name: Mobility & Fuel
episodes.overview: Lin Zai and A-Leh encounter a mysterious man named He Yao, only to discover that he is a genetics expert once highly sought after by two major pharmaceutical corporations.

episodes.name: Last Message
episodes.overview: With armed forces hunting them down, He Yao admits that he once took part in research on the zombie virus and barely managed to escape from the research facility.

episodes.name: Casia
episodes.overview: A-Leh collapses after being poisoned, giving Lin Zai the perfect chance to escape. But when he hears A-Leh calling out to him, Lin Zai decides to stay and save him.

episodes.name: Post-Outbreak Infection Research
episodes.overview: A-Leh’s wound worsens, but his time with Lin Zai feels almost like an ordinary date from before the apocalypse.

episodes.name: The Final Performance
episodes.overview: A mysterious survivor suddenly appears and leads A-Leh and Lin Zai to a new camp, where they unexpectedly reunite with an old acquaintance.

episodes.name: Dao Camp
episodes.overview: Lin Zai faces a new choice: stay at the safe camp, or continue the journey with A-Leh?

episodes.name: Treatment Log
episodes.overview: Lin Zai clashes with A-Leh again, and in He Yao’s laboratory, he discovers a familiar zombie.

episodes.name: The Unfinished Film
episodes.overview: To save his zombified brother, Lin Zai decides to undergo immune-subject experiments in secret, keeping it from A-Leh.

episodes.name: Camp Duty Assignments
episodes.overview: The experiments begin taking a toll on Lin Zai’s body. Faced with A-Leh’s heartfelt confession, can he finally make a decision?

episodes.name: Whole Blood Donation Guidelines
episodes.overview: To save his brother, Lin Zai insists on drawing even more of his blood despite the risks.

episodes.name: File 020
episodes.overview: Lin Zai is left in critical condition after losing too much blood. A-Leh personally gives him a blood transfusion and stays by his bedside all night.

episodes.name: Self-experiment Record
episodes.overview: Unwilling to give up on saving his brother, Lin Zai decides to undergo bone marrow collection, while A-Leh chooses to stay by his side and face it with him.

episodes.name: My Little Brother
episodes.overview: Lin Zai loses another important family member and gradually falls deeper into He Yao’s scheme.

episodes.name: Communication After The Fall
episodes.overview: After his brother’s death, Lin Zai loses his reason to keep living, while A-Leh officially turns against his organization for him.

episodes.name: Herin
episodes.overview: With all of He Yao’s lies exposed, A-Leh and Lin Zai decide to face the organization’s forces together.

series.name: Affinity
aka: โอบรักแรงเสน่หา
series.overview: Un mystérieux virus s'est répandu dans le monde et s'est divisé deux variants, "A" et "B". Ceux ayant contracté la variante A, comme Wu Nong Yu (Fang Jin) ne remarquent généralement aucun effet secondaire. En revanche, celles atteintes de la variante B peuvent développer des tendances antisociales et violentes ainsi que des pulsions possessives à l'égard des porteurs de A. Lorsque Nong Yu accompagne son frère agent de police sur une scène de crime, elle rencontre par hasard le suspect, Xie Xin Xu (Cui Yu Xin), qui s'avère être porteur de B. Cinq ans après leur première rencontre, Nong Yu est devenue étudiante en biotechnologie et Xin Xu décide de profiter de l'occasion pour la revoir en se faisant passer pour un professeur, espérant la faire tomber amoureuse de lui. Cependant, Nong Yu ne se laisse pas berner, ce qui donne naissance à des sentiments inattendus entre eux.

aka: Fool in Love: Yêu Một Kẻ Ngốc
คนโง่รักเข(ล)า
series.overview:
Bangkok, capitale commerciale en plein essor où l'argent, le pouvoir, la célébrité et les ressources s'entremêlent sur la scène de l'élite. Ing, le fils aîné de la famille Jian, est un prodige des affaires fier, indiscipliné et d'une beauté époustouflante. Ses exploits alimentent la jalousie quasi pathologique de son frère.

Yok est le deuxième fils de la famille Sukonsiri, sur lequel pèsent de lourdes attentes. D'apparence douce et d'une intelligence exceptionnelle, c'est un ancien boxeur professionnel de réserve, accablé par la pression familiale. Après sa rencontre avec Ing, la personnalité refoulée de Yok s'éveille discrètement.

Les deux hommes sont alors entraînés dans une intense valse entre amour et haine.

series.name: Embrace in the Dark Night
aka: เราโอบกอดกันในคืนอันมืดมิด
series.overview: Lors d'un voyage à l'étranger, , Wen Xi se retrouve piégée dans un club de combat illégal dirigé par. Elle devient malgré elle la récompense d'un duel qui finit par être remporté par un certain Xu Zhe Qing. Sous couvert d'anonymat, Xu Zhe Qing va tant bien que mal protéger Wen Xi et l'aider à s'évader, avant de finir par se séparer. Trois ans plus tard, une nouvelle tragédie frappe Wen Xi lorsque sa sœur jumelle, Wen Hao, décède subitement. Déterminée à faire éclater au grand jour la vérité, Wen Xi va prendre l'identité de sa sœur et va commencer à travailler chez G.E. Son enquête la conduit à recroiser Xu Zhe Qing.

series.name: Sinful Marriage
series.overview:
Connaissez-vous le proverbe, la haine est mauvaise conseillère ? 

Deux émotions distinctes vont changer la vie de deux personnes. Fan Xingxu, sous le coup de la colère, souhaite se venger de Shen Yuanzhi, qui par amour, va se dénoncer pour un crime qu'elle n'a pas commis. Leurs choix auront pour conséquence : l’union de Xingxu et Yuanzhi. Yuanzhi devra affronter de grands périls, et malheureusement pour elle, l’homme qu’elle a épousé et qui devrait la soutenir, pourrait bien s’avérer être son pire ennemi.

series.name: Dead-End Job
aka: クルアルバ －おいしいバイト－
งานสนุก จะตาย
series.overview: Un jeune homme criblé de dettes se voit proposer un job par un mystérieuse agence d'intérim qui propose 50 fois le taux horaire. Sautant sur l'occasion, il va rapidement déchanter. En effet, ce travail va virer rapidement au cauchemar lorsqu'il est confronté à des phénomènes étranges et terrifiants.

series.name: The Perfect Lie
aka: รักซ่อนลวง
series.overview:
À la suite d’un premier rendez-vous qui semblait idéal, quatre adultes voient leur quotidien bouleversé lorsque des secrets enfouis et des mensonges soigneusement dissimulés commencent à refaire surface.

Professeure de danse dans un collège artistique, Kang Ji Seon a grandi dans une famille autrefois aisée, dont la fortune s’est progressivement effondrée. Marquée par cette période difficile, elle a appris à se méfier des apparences et à garder ses distances pour ne pas être dupée.

Sa rencontre avec Min Jun Ho, un éminent chirurgien cardiaque et père célibataire, vient peu à peu ébranler ses certitudes. Veuf depuis plusieurs années, celui-ci a consacré toute son existence à élever son fils, renonçant à toute vie sentimentale. Mais sa rencontre avec Ji Seon ravive des sentiments qu’il croyait oubliés.

Alors que leur relation prend un nouveau tournant, des révélations inattendues menacent de compromettre la confiance qu’ils commencent à construire. Entre vérités dissimulées et sentiments naissants, sauront-ils surmonter les épreuves qui se dressent sur leur chemin ?

episodes.name: Date
episodes.overview: Joonho and Jisun share a special night after their first date. The next day, everything changes.

series.name: Dearest
series.overview: La vie de l’actrice Wen Jia Nan bascule lorsqu’elle découvre son père en plein meurtre. Victime d’un accident orchestré, elle est accusée à tort et internée, perdant ainsi sa carrière et sa liberté. Elle croise alors Jiang Yu, propriétaire mystérieux du club Yunhai, qui cherche lui aussi à se venger de sa famille. D’abord méfiants, ils s’allient pour dévoiler les secrets, les trahisons et les crimes qui se cachent derrière cette puissante famille.

series.name: Humint
aka: เกมจารชนคนในเงา
series.overview:
Cho, agent du service national de renseignement sud-coréen, se rend à Vladivostok afin d'enquêter sur un réseau criminel international après la mort d'une informatrice. Son enquête croise celle de Park Geon, agent nord-coréen venu enquêter sur la disparition de ressortissants de son pays dans la région, tandis que le consul Hwang Chi Seong interfère dans son enquête.
Au centre de cette lutte d'influence, Chae Seon Hwa, employée d'un restaurant nord-coréen, devient une cible convoitée.

series.overview:
Han Seo Yun est une jeune fille pleine d'énergie et positive souffrant d'amnésie. Sa condition l'oblige à tenir rigoureusement un carnet relatant les faits de la veille.

Certaines circonstances à l'école vont la pousser dans les bras d'un de ses camarades : Kim Jae Won. Ce garçon, à l'opposé de Seo Yun, souffre lui aussi à sa façon.

Ces deux âmes vont-elles réussir à trouver du réconfort dans la compagnie de l'autre ?

series.name: Once We Were Us
aka: ครั้งหนึ่งที่เราเคยมีกันและกัน
series.overview: En 2008, Lee Eun Ho (Koo Kyo Hwan) et Han Jeong Won (Mun Ka Young) s’assoient par hasard côte à côte dans un car express qui les ramène dans leur ville natale. De cette coïncidence naît une amitié improbable qui se transforme peu à peu en premier amour, tandis qu’ils partagent le poids des inquiétudes, des désillusions et des débuts de l’âge adulte. Malgré les promesses qu’ils se font, la réalité finit par les éloigner. Plus de dix ans plus tard, le destin les réunit de nouveau : Eun Ho et Jeong Won montent à bord du même vol pour la Corée. L’occasion de se souvenir, de se dire enfin ce qu’ils ont longtemps tu… et de mesurer tout ce que le temps a changé. Adaptation coréenne du film chinois de 2018 Us and Them.

series.name: Parasite
aka: パラサイト 半地下の家族
ชนชั้นปรสิต
パラサイト 半地下の家族：2019
series.overview: Toute la famille de Ki-taek est au chômage. Elle s’intéresse particulièrement au train de vie de la richissime famille Park. Mais un incident se produit et les deux familles se retrouvent mêlées, sans le savoir, à une bien étrange histoire…

series.name: Fatal Proximity to Him
aka: หวนกาลเคียงรัก
series.overview:
Issus de familles brisées, Luo Xi Yu et He Lan trouvent l’un auprès de l’autre le réconfort qui leur manque. Mais pour la protéger, He Lan est contraint de disparaître de sa vie. Pendant douze ans, il veille sur elle dans l’ombre, la regardant devenir une danseuse accomplie.

Leurs chemins finissent pourtant par se croiser à nouveau. Mais leurs retrouvailles sont marquées par une succession de drames qui les entraînent dans un cycle sans fin. Cette fois, He Lan décide de ne plus fuir et choisit d’affronter l’avenir aux côtés de Luo Xi Yu…

series.name: The Shadow Sovereign
aka: องค์หญิงเจาหยาง
series.overview: La princesse Zhao Yang (Kong Xue Er), fille d’une concubine du Palais Froid, a toujours été considérée comme une pièce sur l'échiquier de la cour impériale. Après la réforme qui permet à des érudits de familles modestes de changer de statut, Shen Xiao (Li Hong Yi), roturier à la langue acérée, accède aux plus hauts rangs de la cour et devient l’adversaire politique de Zhao Yang en la critiquant publiquement. Tandis que cette dernière tente de démanteler la faction du prince héritier corrompu, les deux rivaux vont finir par s’allier grâce à leur estime mutuelle et à leurs convictions partagées. Pour garantir la paix et la prospérité dans le royaume, la princesse et l'érudit doivent tout risquer, jusqu'à leur propre vie, afin de changer leur destin et celui de leur peuple. Cette série est adaptée du roman en ligne "Ping Yang Gong Zhu" de Qing Wei.

episodes.name: The Beautiful Man turns into the Top Scholar
episodes.overview: Princess Zhaoyang, acting on the Crown Prince's orders, destroys the examination papers of humble scholars, cutting off their path to official office. Left with no other choice, the humble scholar Shen Xiao disguises himself as a courtesan to approach Zhaoyang in the hope of securing her recommendation.

episodes.name: Impeachment in Court
episodes.overview: At the Scholar's Banquet, the new Top Scholar, Shen Xiao, impeaches Zhaoyang for being extravagant and suggests the Crown Prince take charge of repairing the Yongtong Canal for disaster relief. The suggestion is accepted by His Majesty.

episodes.name: Kill Three Birds with One Stone
episodes.overview: The Crown Prince is furious at Zhaoyang because of the Yontong Canal. To ease the Crown Prince's suspicions, Zhaoyang proposes a plan for him to replace money with grains. Not only can she use this chance to drive a wedge between the Crown Prince and the Second Prince, but she can also use this chance to eliminate Qing Luo, the mistress who set her up.

episodes.name: Princess from the Cold Palace
episodes.overview: Shen Xiao learns from the Recluse Le Sheng that Zhaoyang once struggled to survive in the Cold Palace, leaving him even more intrigued by her. As he honors his promise to spend every night with Zhaoyang, he finds himself relentlessly pursued by Princess An Le.

episodes.name: Your Highness, Will You Protect Me?
episodes.overview: Shen Xiao mourns his father. Zhaoyang hints that his father's death is suspicious. Shen Xiao decides to investigate the truth.

episodes.name: Private Treasury Break-Ins
episodes.overview: Shen Xiao notices that the Crown Prince is pocketing the grains given for the canal repair. He decides to investigate the Crown Prince's private treasury.

episodes.name: More than a Male Companion
episodes.overview: When Shen Xiao finds out about the past between Zhaoyang and Cui Jinzhi, he understands that the marriage is out of self-preservation. The Seventh Prince returns to the capital and gains favor from the Emperor with three gifts. It sends the Crown Prince's faction on alert.

episodes.name: Blade and Trap
episodes.overview: Ordered by the Emperor to lead the grain donation effort, Zhaoyang finds herself caught between a rock and a hard place. To get out of the predicament, she devises a scheme that provokes Shen Xiao into seizing the grain.

episodes.name: If I Die, Will You Mourn Me?
episodes.overview: Shen Xiao is thrown into prison, and the Second Prince shifts the blame onto him to protect himself. To clear her own name, Zhaoyang is ordered by the Eastern Palace to enter the prison and silence Shen Xiao forever.

episodes.name: The Princess Is Imprisoned
episodes.overview: Shen Xiao knows that Le Sheng is the Seventh Prince. He also finds out that Zhaoyang is the person who's secretly funding those from humble families. Zhaoyang admits it and gives Shen Xiao a hint about where the Crown Prince's granary is.

episodes.name: Before Falling Off the Cliff
episodes.overview: Cui Jinzhi finds out that the Crown Prince is planning to silence Zhaoyang. He then intervenes to save her and take the blame for the crime. The Yongtong Canal is finally completed. Zhaoyang, Shen Xiao, and the Seventh Prince have officially formed an alliance.

episodes.name: Letting You Use Me Was My Own Choice
episodes.overview: Zhaoyang and Shen Xiao survive a fall from a cliff. On a rainy night, they finally confess their feelings to each other. After learning of Zhaoyang's fall, Cui Jinzhi realizes his feelings for her. After nearly losing her, he tries to repair their marriage.

episodes.name: No Dignity Left
episodes.overview: Shen Xiao and Le Sheng trespass into the Princess Residence to rescue Zhaoyang. Realizing she can't just sit back and await her fate, Zhaoyang decides to enter the palace at night to meet the emperor.

episodes.name: Shen Xiao, I Found You a Good Marriage
episodes.overview: To maintain the Cui family's support, the Crown Prince forces his younger sister, Princess An Le to marry Cui Jinzhi.

episodes.name: Levee Breach
episodes.overview: The levee repaired by the Crown Prince is breached. Zhaoyang sees it as an opportunity to get rid of him. Shen Xiao prioritizes the flood victims. Both of them argue over this.

episodes.name: Refusing the Marriage
episodes.overview: Shen Xiao defies the imperial decree by refusing the marriage and requests a demotion, volunteering to accompany the Seventh Prince to the Yellow River to tackle the flood crisis.

episodes.name: Faking His Death
episodes.overview: An Le poisons Emperor Zheng Yuan to help the Crown Prince take over the throne. Cui Jinzhi confines Zhaoyang and tells her that Shen Xiao is dead. Zhaoyang tries to escape but is surrounded by the Crown Prince's troops.

episodes.name: The Dust Hasn't Settled
episodes.overview: Emperor Zheng Yuan appoints the Seventh Prince as the Crown Prince. The noble families try to kill Shen Xiao by accusing him of forging an edict.

series.name: Against the Current
aka: หอมรักมิรู้เลือน
蘭香如故～流れに逆らって～
series.overview: Faussement accusée de trahison, la famille de Shen Jia Lan (Tan Song Yun) est brutalement exécutée, la dépouillant de son statut de noble. Pour se protéger, son fiancé Lin Jin Qi (Liu Xue Yi) et sa famille rompent leurs fiançailles. Recueillie par une famille de serviteurs de la maison Lin, Jia Lan adopte l'identité de leur fille défunte, « Xu Lan Xiang ». Débutant comme une humble servante de troisième rang, elle affronte les intrigues de la demeure. Grâce à son esprit et sa résilience, elle surmonte les barrières sociales et les injustices. En gravissant les échelons, saura-t-elle gagner le respect de la famille, reconquérir le cœur de Jin Qi et blanchir les siens tout en restant fidèle à elle-même ? Adapté du roman « Lan Xiang Yuan » de He Yan Shan.

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: Shen Jia Lan’s family is destroyed after a political dispute, and she is sent to the state brothel with the other women. Xu Lan Xiang’s parents secretly save Jia Lan by taking her place, allowing her to escape. Jia Lan survives, but is devastated by the loss of her family.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: Jia Lan begins a new life with Lan Xiang’s parents in Jin Ling, hiding her true identity. Her cleverness helps her adoptive father avoid a major debt and earn a promotion. Meanwhile, Lin Jin Qi returns to Jin Ling after years of military service.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: Lin Jin Qi returns home and discovers how much his household has changed during his absence. Jia Lan is unexpectedly recruited as a maid for the Lin family despite her parents’ attempts to stop it. She enters the household alongside several other young maids.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: Jia Lan begins working in the Lin household and quietly hides her intelligence. She discovers that a Buddhist scripture is actually connected to false accounts and realizes there may be trouble behind the household’s finances. Meanwhile, Lv Jie’er becomes increasingly eager to attract Lin Jin Qi’s attention.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: Lin Jin Qi uncovers evidence of Zhao Xing Tang’s illegal lending, while tensions between the household women and servants increase. After Qing Xiang is sent away and Lv Jie’er is severely punished, Jialan intervenes to save her. Zhao Xing Tang also secretly maintains a relationship with Qian Shao Ze, who helps her manage her accounts.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: Jia Lan and Xiao Lian are promoted to second-class maids, but the change brings new concerns rather than happiness. Jia Lan begins suspecting that Zhao Xing Tang has someone outside the household and notices that Lin Jin Qi is investigating her affairs. Lin Jin Qi then asks Jia Lan to secretly become his eyes and ears.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: Jia Lan realizes that Qian Shao Ze is disguising himself as a woman and carefully creates an alibi to avoid being implicated. Lin Jin Qi also begins watching the situation around Jin Xiu Fang, while Jia Lan tries to protect herself and Xiao Lian. Afterward, Lin Jin Qi confirms that Jia Lan can read and asks her to help him investigate.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: At Zhao Xing Tang’s mother’s birthday celebration, Jialan notices that something is wrong and tries to keep Xiao Lian safe. Lin Jinqi eventually catches Zhao Xing Tang and Qian Shao Ze together, exposing their relationship. He then demands a separation, forcing the Zhao family to agree to a formal divorce.

episodes.name: Épisode 9
episodes.overview: Jia Lan and Xiao Lian narrowly avoid being implicated in Zhao Xing Tang’s scandal, helped by Shou Yi’s intervention. After the divorce, the Lin household undergoes major changes, and Yu Chan returns after separating from her husband. With Zhao Xing Tang gone, Jia Lan and the other maids finally have the chance to begin a more peaceful life.

episodes.name: Épisode 10
episodes.overview: Lin Jin Qi struggles to obtain supplies for his soldiers and relies on Du Zheng, who once saved his life, for help. Du Zheng and his younger sister Du Cui Que become connected to the Lin household, while Jia Lan earns a position in the inner study because of her literacy. As the new year arrives, Jialan finally feels that the danger surrounding Zhao Xing Tang has passed.

episodes.name: Épisode 11
episodes.overview: The Lin family arranges a gathering for eligible young men as they begin considering a marriage for Second Miss. Jia Lan discovers that a delphinium flower ornament given to Lin Jin Qi could cause damaging rumors about his relationship with Du Cui Que. Using her quick thinking, she finds a way to prevent the misunderstanding from spreading.

episodes.name: Épisode 12
episodes.overview: As a reward for her actions, Jia Lan asks for a day off to visit her parents and medicine for her mother’s frostbite. Meanwhile, Lin Jin Qi is suspended after soldiers die from poor-quality winter uniforms, putting his investigation and Second Miss’s marriage prospects in jeopardy. Jia Lan then suggests a way to track down the merchant responsible.

episodes.name: Épisode 13
episodes.overview: Jia Lan disguises herself as a woman looking for sewing work and successfully enters a suspicious household connected to the investigation. When her identity is discovered, she is placed in danger, but Lin Jin Qi and his men arrive in time. After examining the evidence, Lin Jin Qi suspects that the merchant Lu Da Lang was actually a Japanese pirate and that someone in the court may be helping them.

episodes.name: Épisode 14
episodes.overview: Second Miss is devastated when the Xie family cancels her engagement, while Lin Jin Qi is arrested over the military supplies case. Jia Lan and Yu Chan manage to get crucial information to Yongchang Marquis, allowing him and Lin Jin Qi’s men to intercept Lu Da Lang’s group. Lin Jin Qi is released, and he becomes increasingly drawn to Jialan after seeing how confidently she speaks to the soldiers.

episodes.name: Épisode 15
episodes.overview: Yongchang Marquis praises Jialan and even asks Lin Jin Qi to give her to him, but Lin Jinqi refuses. As Jia Lan begins noticing suspicious details surrounding Du Zheng and his sister, she also worries about Yu Chan, who has developed a serious rash. Meanwhile, Lin Jin Qi and Yongchang Marquis investigate the poisoning of a Japanese pirate in custody, while Jia Lan secretly seeks medical help for Yu Chan.

episodes.name: Épisode 16
episodes.overview: Lin Xiu Ru witnesses Lin Xiu Wan and Du Zheng in an embrace. In a panic, she manages to disrupt their tryst and looks for her brother to seek his advice. Unfortunately, Jin Qi was urgently called away before she could tell him. Marquis Yong Chang and Jin Qi have their hands full with dead prisoners and being assassination targets. An epidemic gets Lin Manor sealed after Jin Qi had left, but his enemies think he's trapped inside.

episodes.name: Épisode 17
episodes.overview: Once Lin Manor is sealed, First Madam divides up which courtyard will house the sick and which will house those who have no symptoms. Lin Xiu Ru confides in Lan Xiang that she had Du Cui Que's maid, Ling Dang, follow; Ling Dang only spoke to two maids carrying bath water, then returned to Cui Que's courtyard. Lan Xiang's roommate also mentions that Lady Du said it was too bad Jin Qi had to leave after his bath. No matter how tired she was, Lan Xiang's mind was working overtime and couldn't let go of all the talk about bath water. She started to wonder whether the epidemic was not contagious but was brought on by poison instead. In the meantime, Lin Jin Qi and the Marquis have their own traps to set to catch those trying to kill them.

episodes.name: Épisode 18
episodes.overview: During the altercation between the Wo pirates and Commander Yuan, Du Zheng makes an unexpected move, eventually resulting in a grave injury. In the meantime, time is running out for those who remained ill at the Lin Manor. In an attempt to obtain an antidote to the poison, Lan Xiang takes a huge gamble, one Lady Du had not foreseen.

episodes.name: Épisode 19
episodes.overview: Lin Jin Qi wraps up his military duties at the garrison. Du Zheng's barely coherent mumblings are an answer enough to why Zheng attacked him and to the recent events at Lin Manor. Jin Qi, along with Jiu Gao and Nan Ke, return near the end of the maids' celebratory banquet at Lin Manor. Jin Qi offers a toast to a drunk Lan Xiang.

episodes.name: Épisode 20
episodes.overview: Lin San agrees to marry Marquis Yongchang and begins taking control of her own future. Lan Xiang and her parents find a new home and work at a calligraphy shop. The investigation into the Japanese pirates is officially stopped, while the Crown Prince secretly continues looking into it. Lin Jin Qi visits Lan Xiang and becomes jealous after seeing her growing connection with Han Liang.

episodes.name: Épisode 21
episodes.overview: Han Liang brings his widowed sister home, and Lan Xiang helps protect her from her late husband's family. Meanwhile, Lin San's marriage is settled, and Lin Er begins to change after reading the books Lin Jin Qi gives her. Lin Jin Qi visits Lan Xiang and sees her growing closeness with Han Liang. Han Liang realizes he loves Lan Xiang and asks his mother to arrange a proposal.

episodes.name: Épisode 22
episodes.overview: Zheng Man Yi visits the Lin family, and Lin Jin Qi makes it clear he does not want to align himself with her family. After discovering Lan Xiang’s relationship with him, Zheng Man Yi plots to destroy her. Lan Xiang is kidnapped and framed with Han Liang, but she escapes the trap. Lin Jin Qi begins searching for her and learns that the authorities are also secretly looking for the deposed Crown Prince.

episodes.name: Épisode 23
episodes.overview: Lin Jin Qi discovers that Zheng Man Yi’s family is behind Lan Xiang’s kidnapping and learns she has been taken to Yangzhou. He sets out to find her while also helping the Crown Prince escape. Meanwhile, Lan Xiang is sold to a brothel, where she meets Lv Jie'er, who helps her escape. Lin Jin Qi arrives too late and misses her.

episodes.name: Épisode 24
episodes.overview: Lan Xiang is rescued by Fu Rong and Han Liang and returns home safely. She realizes Zheng Man Yi was behind everything and decides to confront her. During Marquis Yongchang's wedding, Lan Xiang disguises herself as a ghost in a theatrical performance, deliberately provoking Zheng Man Yi. Meanwhile, Lin Jin Qi and his allies secretly help the Crown Prince escape.

episodes.name: Épisode 25
episodes.overview: Zheng Bai Chuan’s assassination plot fails, and the Crown Prince safely escapes Jinling with Lin Jin Qi. Zheng Bai Chuan and his followers are forced to surrender, while Zheng Man Yi is captured. Lan Xiang's family rescues A Zhi but cannot find Lv Jie Er. The Crown Prince returns to the capital and ascends the throne after the Emperor's death. Just as Han Liang's family comes to propose to Lan Xiang, an imperial decree arrives ordering Lan Xiang to marry Lin Jin Qi.

episodes.name: Épisode 26
episodes.overview: Lan Xiang struggles with the forced marriage, while Han Liang accepts that he has lost his chance. Lin Jin Qi is punished by his family for requesting the imperial marriage decree, but his siblings stand by him. Meanwhile, the Zheng family is sentenced, and Lan Xiang’s parents prepare for her wedding.

episodes.name: Épisode 27
episodes.overview: The Lin-Wu bridal party is blocked by a group celebrating Scholar Han getting an award as First Place Scholar. Lin Jin Qi appeals to Scholar Han to make way, as a smooth bridal procession makes for a smooth marriage. The wedding goes on as expected until the bride has reluctance to bow to her groom. In the bridal chamber, as soon as the veil is lifted, Lan Xiang slaps her new husband, who commands the crowd to leave and keep the incident quiet.

episodes.name: Épisode 28
episodes.overview: Lan Xiang has made it very clear that she's unhappy in her marriage, so Lin Jin Qi appeases her as much as he can. He is giddily happy to finally be married to the woman he loves; he is determined to let her know how much he loves her and to shield her from his family's disapproval. Jin Qi is preparing for his transfer to the Capital and has sought permission from his Grandfather to have his cousin and his brother join him. In addition, Lin Xiu Wan was allowed to join the group to go to the Capital.

episodes.name: Épisode 29
episodes.overview: Jin Qi and Lan Xiang visit her parents, and Jin Qi makes them feel comfortable around him and tells them about his sudden move to the Capital. They try to convince Lan Xiang to join Jin Qi in the Capital, esp. since they're newlyweds. Jiu Gao, who had previously avoided his mother's marital arrangements, is trying to let Yu Chan know how he feels, but she treats him like an annoying younger brother. A Zhi, who was rescued by Master Lu and Lan Xiang's father from the Qingyan brothel, reappears and claims to have information on Ji Er's whereabouts.

episodes.name: Épisode 30
episodes.overview: Lan Xiang and Lin Jin Qi arrive in the capital, where they are given the Shen family’s former residence. Lan Xiang is overwhelmed by memories of her childhood. She finds Lv Jie Er being mistreated and learns that her contract belongs to Zhao Jin Tang, forcing her to confront her former rival. Lan Xiang also discovers that Qing Cang has returned to Zhao Jin Tang’s side and decides to investigate them.

episodes.name: Épisode 31
episodes.overview: Lan Xiang goes against Zhao Xing Tang to get Lu Ji Er and Xiao Pu's indenture papers. Xing Tang wanted 30,000 taels of silver, but Lan Xiang offered her something better: a way for a woman in her position to keep the money she earns, so that it doesn't end up in her family's coffers or her husband's hands. Once free, Lu Ji Er and Xiao Pu decide they want to start new lives in a new city. They chose Quanzhou, and A Zhi decides to join them. Lan Xiang gives Lu Ji Er gold, equivalent to 500 taels of silver, only revealed right before they boarded their caravan. Lin Jin Qi finds out Lan Xiang pawned her jewelry for three months to get the money for Lu Ji Er, so he redeemed it immediately. Three months later, he and Lan Xiang had the awkward conversation about how Lan Xiang could earn 500 taels of silver in just three months.

episodes.name: Épisode 32
episodes.overview: Lin Xiu Lai seeks help from her aunt Wang Ling Xiao to separate from her husband Lu Jian, but Ling Xiao is more worried about the family reputation and how the younger cousins will be able to find marriage prospects. Even with proof of severe abuse, Ling Xiao counsels Xiu Lai to stay in the marriage. If not for Lin Xiu Wan's interference, Lan Xiang would not have known about the abuse and would not have known to act swiftly to get Xiu Lai out of the Lu household.

episodes.name: Épisode 33
episodes.overview: Lan Xiang uses evidence of the Lu family stealing the elder sister’s dowry to force Lu Ji An to agree to the divorce. Lin Jin Qi takes his sister’s punishment upon himself and is severely beaten. Lan Xiang worries about him and protects him from further harm, while Lin Jin Qi realizes how carefully she considers his family.

episodes.name: Épisode 34
episodes.overview: Lan Xiang notices several suspicious signs suggesting the Prince of Han is preparing a rebellion. She warns Lin Jin Qi just in time, preventing him from walking into an ambush. Lin Jin Qi heads to the Divine Machine Camp, where the commander sides with Han Wang. After a fierce confrontation, Lin Jin Qi destroys the weapons depot and is seriously injured.

episodes.name: Épisode 35
episodes.overview: Badly wounded, Lin Jin Qi send Nan Ke to seek help while the rebellion spreads through the capital. Lan Xiang refuses to abandon him and finds him before the rebels can capture him, disguising herself as a servant and helping him escape. Meanwhile, Lin Jin Qi’s family hides in a theater, while Lan Xiang takes the injured Lin Jin Qi to a remote hut, where he teaches her how to use a firearm.

episodes.name: Épisode 36
episodes.overview: Lan Xiang saves Zhao Xing Tang from rebel soldiers and takes her to safety. Before dying, Zhao gives Lan Xiang evidence that could destroy the Lin family. Lan Xiang burns it without hesitation, earning Lin Jin Qi’s trust. As rebel forces close in, Lin Jin Qi tries to persuade Wei Bao to surrender.

episodes.name: Épisode 37
episodes.overview: Lin Jin Qi convinces Wei Bao to surrender, while Han Liang joins the search for him and Lan Xiang. After they are rescued, Lan Xiang learns about the chaos in the Lin household and discovers the truth about Zhao Xing Tang’s marriage. She begins planning a new arrangement for the family.

episodes.name: Épisode 38
episodes.overview: Lan Xiang asks the eldest sister to manage the household and earn her own income. Lin Jin Qi is promoted to Marquis, while Jiu Gao and Nan Ke gain official positions. Later, Lin Jin Qi takes Lan Xiang to pay respects to the Shen family and reveals that he secretly helped save their servants. Lan Xiang finally shares the truth about her past and her connection to the Shen family.

episodes.name: Épisode 39
episodes.overview: Lan Xiang warns Lin Jin Qi about the dangers of blindly serving the emperor and urges him to consider the Lin family’s future. After Second Master’s death and news of the Old Madam’s passing, Lin Jin Qi decides to resign and return to Jinling. Back home, Lan Xiang grows closer to Lin Jin Qi and helps prepare for Fourth Miss’s upcoming marriage.

episodes.name: Épisode 40
episodes.overview: As the Lin family’s fortunes decline, Lan Xiang helps resolve tensions caused by Third Master’s thoughtless gift. Meanwhile, Lin Xiu Ru faces pressure from the Yuan family to let her husband take a concubine to produce a male heir. With Lan Xiang’s help, Lin Jin Qi and the Lin family matriarch negotiate with the Yuan family to protect Lin Xiu Ru and her daughters’ interests.

episodes.name: Épisode 41
episodes.overview: Rong Jie Er and her sisters thank Lan Xiang and the Lin family for protecting them, while the family deals with tensions over choosing a concubine for Yuan Shao Hui. Lan Xiang reassures the maids that no one will be forced into marriage, and Xiao Lian and Nan Ke eventually marry, alongside Gan Tang and Da Song. Yu Chan also confesses her feelings for Jiu Gao, and they agree to marry. Meanwhile, Lan Xiang gives birth to a daughter, and Lin Jin Qi begins questioning her true identity after discovering inconsistencies in her past.

episodes.name: Épisode 42
episodes.overview: Lin Jin Qi investigates Lan Xiang’s identity but ultimately decides to protect her secrets and accept her as his wife. When Lin Mu becomes critically ill, she entrusts the household management authority to Lan Xiang before passing away. Lan Xiang handles the funeral arrangements despite resistance from Cheng Shi and the Second Madam. Later, she discovers that Cheng Shi plans to frame two children for stealing a ceremonial jade artifact and refuses to let them seek revenge.

episodes.name: Épisode 43
episodes.overview: Lan Xiang teaches the two children to face their circumstances with dignity, and the Old Master allows them to take the Lin surname and join the family genealogy. He also formally recognizes Lan Xiang’s authority over the household, leaving Cheng Shi to face punishment for her actions. After the emperor dies and a new ruler takes the throne, Lin Jin Qi is appointed to a difficult military post overseeing the troubled Longjiang Guard. Meanwhile, Lin Xiu Wan begins working at Gan Tang’s textile workshop but is kidnapped by bandits along with a weaver.

episodes.name: Épisode 44
episodes.overview: Xie Zhao rescues Lin Xiu Wan and the weaver from the bandits and secretly helps them return home. His drawing of the criminals allows Lin Jin Qi to identify one of the suspects as Du Cui Que, who has joined forces with pirates. Seeking revenge against Lin Jin Qi, Du Cui Que sends Zhang Shui Zai to attack Yuan Shao Hui’s forces, and Yuan Shao Hui dies while trying to protect his men. As the political situation worsens, Lin Jin Qi prepares to transport military supplies, unaware of the full extent of Du Cui Que’s plans.

episodes.name: Épisode 45
episodes.overview: After learning of Yuan Shao Hui’s death, Lin Jin Qi wants revenge, but Lan Xiang persuades him to follow a more strategic plan to stop Du Cui Que. Du Cui Que plans to burn the military supplies and seize control of Jinling, while Lan Xiang prepares the Lin household for an attack. When the pirates storm the city, Lan Xiang and the women defend the family home, while Lin Jin Qi confronts Zhang Shui Zai at the supply ships. Their coordinated efforts defeat the pirates and bring Du Cui Que’s plans to an end, allowing Lin Jin Qi to continue transporting the military supplies to the capital.

episodes.name: Épisode 46
episodes.overview: After the pirates’ attack on the Lin residence fails, Lan Xiang explains how she and Lin Jin Qi anticipated their plans. Xie Zhao proposes marriage to Lin Xiu Wan, and the two finally confess their feelings for each other. Meanwhile, Lin Xiu Ru resolves a dispute with the Yuan family, and Lin Jin Qi asks the new emperor for permission to return to Jinling. As the political situation shifts, Lan Xiang spends New Year’s Eve caring for the children while Lin Jin Qi remains away.

episodes.name: Épisode 47
episodes.overview: After political turmoil returns to the capital, Lin Jin Qi eventually comes back to Jinling and reunites with Lan Xiang and their children. Together, they focus on raising their family, with Lin Jin Qi teaching their daughter to value wisdom and courage. Meanwhile, Lan Xiang continues writing stories about women and the Shen family, hoping to preserve their history and seek justice for the past.

series.name: Spring of the Blade
aka: คมวสันต์ซ่อนรัก
series.overview: Adapté du roman Yi Ou Chun, le drama historique Spring of the Blade suit l'histoire de Xie Qingyuan, une jeune femme devenue orpheline après l'assassinat injuste de sa mère. Après des années d'errance dans la rue, elle décide d'intégrer la puissante demeure familiale des Xie pour mener son enquête et assouvir sa vengeance.  Sur son chemin, elle retrouve Shen Run, un ami d'enfance avec qui elle s'était promis de survivre après une tragédie partagée. Devenu un haut fonctionnaire influent au gouvernement, ce dernier est justement dépêché pour enquêter sur une affaire de corruption frappant le clan Xie. Ensemble, ils décident de faire alliance pour déjouer les complots politiques de la cour et faire toute la lumière sur la mort de sa mère. Au fil de leurs périlleuses investigations et des luttes de pouvoir aristocratiques, leur promesse passée se transforme progressivement en une profonde romance.

series.name: The Road to Splendor
aka: พราวพร่างบุปผาตระการ
series.overview: Après avoir été faussement accusée d'un scandale qui a ruiné sa réputation, la noble Fu Tingyun s'enfuit avec l'aide de Zhao Ling, un contrebandier de sel qui l'accompagnera pour l'aider à retourner auprès de sa famille et l'aidera à prouver son innocence. Ensemble, ils dénoncent la corruption du gouvernement et évoluent dans le monde périlleux de la politique de cour, leur lien se renforce, les menant vers un nouveau départ.
