series.name: Road to Success
aka: ดาวประกายพร่างพรายฝัน
Tỏa Sáng Như Những Vì Sao
series.overview: Lorsque Lin Wanxing retourne dans sa ville natale et accepte un poste dans un lycée local, elle se voit confier de manière inattendue la mission de faire renaître l’équipe de football de l’établissement, dissoute depuis longtemps. Avec l’aide de son mystérieux locataire, Wang Fa, un ancien entraîneur, ils s’efforcent de reconstruire l’équipe, d’aider les élèves à réaliser leurs rêves et, chemin faisant, de faire face aux blessures de leur propre passé.

videos.name: Trailer:Believe In Light!🕯️Narrow Paths Will Lead To Glory| Road to success 灿如繁

episodes.name: Rebuilding the Soccer Team
episodes.overview: Lin Wanxing comes out on top in the teacher recruitment process. However, she chooses the easy position of sports equipment manager, seeking a quiet and simple life. This is when the school decides to rebuild the soccer team to compete in the Youth Super League. Lin Wanxing is selected to serve as the team's supervising teacher.

episodes.name: The First Match
episodes.overview: Among the students in the soccer team, only the captain, Fu Xinshu, still wants to keep playing. Lin Wanxing and Fu Xinshu manage to gather enough players to take the field, only to be demolished by their opponent.

episodes.name: Turning the Tide
episodes.overview: Lin Wanxing introduces Wang Fa to the team and bluntly states that he can help them win the match. However, they have doubts about this "former Nanton coach" who appeared out of nowhere.

episodes.name: Winning Wang Fa Over
episodes.overview: Lin Wanxing racks her brains to persuade Wang Fa to become the soccer team's coach, using all sorts of psychological tactics. However, Wang Fa easily deflects them all.

episodes.name: Swapping Lives
episodes.overview: Their 'life swap' begins. Wang Fa agrees to coaching the soccer team if his insomnia can be alleviated.

episodes.name: Catfish Effect
episodes.overview: The students are deeply discouraged when substitute player Chen Weidong drops out of the team. To ignite the team's fighting spirit, Lin Wanxing gets Wen Chengye to challenge them, using the 'catfish effect' to restore the players' passion and drive.

episodes.name: Secret
episodes.overview: Fu Xinshu once again sincerely invites Wen Chengye to join the soccer team. Wen Chengye proposes that if Fu Xinshu can beat his English score in the next monthly exam, he will agree to join the team.

episodes.name: Honoring a Promise
episodes.overview: Through his tireless efforts, Fu Xinshu achieves excellent scores in the monthly exam. Wen Chengye acknowledges that he lost the competition and joins the soccer team.

episodes.name: Independent Thinking
episodes.overview: On the day of the game, Wang Fa doesn't show up. The students and Lin Wanxing are anxious but determined to give their all. Meanwhile, Wang Fa purposely didn't show up in order to foster the students' ability to think independently.

episodes.name: Original Aspiration
episodes.overview: Accompanied by Lin Wanxing and Wang Fa, Fu Xinshu pours his heart out to his mother and finally feels at peace. After dinner, Lin Wanxing and Wang Fa discuss their original aspirations to safeguard the students' growth, deeply resonating with one other.

episodes.name: Mysterious Gift Box
episodes.overview: Fu Xinshu receives a mysterious gift box. Lin Wanxing successfully solves the riddle, and the answer leads her to a photo studio. She and Wang Fa pretend to be a couple and go to the photo studio for a photoshoot, using the opportunity to solve the mystery.

episodes.name: Poaching
episodes.overview: The manager of the Hengjiu Soccer Club extends an invitation to Wang Fa to join them. Lin Wanxing wants to ask Wang Fa to stay but can't bring herself to say it.

episodes.name: The Reason for Playing Soccer
episodes.overview: Lin Wanxing notices the students' reluctance and can't help but ask them why they play soccer. Their answers vary, but at the core, they all have a passion for soccer.

episodes.name: Flirty Vibes
episodes.overview: Wang Fa has already banished all suspicions about Lin Wanxing. His initial intention for staying at Hongjing No. 8 High School has turned into an attachment to Lin Wanxing and the students. Wang Fa patiently teaches Lin Wanxing how to ride a bike, and something more starts to build between them.

episodes.name: Father and Son Reconcile
episodes.overview: Together, Lin Wanxing and Wang Fa patiently counsel Qin Ao's father, and his attitude towards Qin Ao gradually softens. The Qin father and son mend their relationship.

episodes.name: Leaving Hongjing No. 8 High School
episodes.overview: Jason's mother shows up out of the blue to see Wang Fa and airs her grievances to him. Overwhelmed by guilt, Wang Fa ultimately decides to leave Hongjing No. 8 High School.

episodes.name: Past Regrets
episodes.overview: Lin Wanxing realizes that Wang Fa lied about leaving to join Hengjiu and that he must have another reason. She rushes over to stop Wang Fa and successfully catches him before he leaves.

episodes.name: Heading to the UK
episodes.overview: Wang Fa learns from Yu Bo that there is a new lead in Jason's case in the UK. He departs for the UK right away.

episodes.name: Opening Up About the Past
episodes.overview: Wang Fa returns from the UK. He senses that Lin Wanxing's attitude towards him has gone cold and guesses that she has learned the truth.

episodes.name: Facing It Together
episodes.overview: Ju Li goes to Lin Wanxing's house but can't reach her. She discovers a note the Lin Wanxing left and worries that something happened to her. She and Wang Fa anxiously search for her.

episodes.name: Making Up
episodes.overview: With a sudden change to the matchup, Hongjing's team has to face the strongest contender in the group stage...

episodes.name: Misunderstanding
episodes.overview: The kids are feeling lost and anxious, unsure of what the team's future holds. Lin Wanxing is worried that the team will disband.

episodes.name: Voting
episodes.overview: Lin Wanxing proposes a vote to let the children decide for themselves whether they want to continue competing. If even one person votes no, they will forfeit the next match.

episodes.name: A Child's Dream
episodes.overview: Wen Chengye's father orders him to quit the team. Lin Wanxing and Wang Fa persuade Mr. Wen to respect his son's dream. He ultimately agrees to let Wen Chengye continue to play soccer.

episodes.name: Wish
episodes.overview: Wang Fa confesses his feelings to Lin Wanxing and gives her an origami frog containing a list of 100 wishes that he had written down. The last wish on the list is to be with Ms. Xiao Lin.

episodes.name: A Buried Past
episodes.overview: The school principal receives an anonymous letter accusing Lin Wanxing of being the culprit who induced her mentor's suicide. The buried past is suddenly unearthed, but Lin Wanxing offers no explanation.

episodes.name: Unconditional Trust
episodes.overview: Wang Fa books out a theater in Hanling and makes posters to guide Lin Wanxing there. On the screen, she watches a video of the kids expressing their longing and encouragement.

episodes.name: Gathering Evidence
episodes.overview: Lin Wanxing and the kids watch the video that Grandpa Lin and Coach Jiang left for them. Lin Wanxing finally musters up the courage to face the shadows of the past and begins investigating.

episodes.name: Seeking Justice
episodes.overview: Lin Wanxing decides to take Xiang Zi to court. In the courtroom, she stands up for herself, detailing the injustices she had endured and appealing to the law for justice.

episodes.name: Meeting the Parents
episodes.overview: Lin Wanxing visits the Wang residence and "meets the parents". Wang Genfa personally prepares the meal. After dinner, Wang Fa's mother, Kang Qiao, takes Lin Wanxing aside to gaze at the stars.

episodes.name: All-Out Preparations
episodes.overview: With the championship match fast approaching, Wang Fa takes the kids to a professional training facility for intensive training. To their surprise, during training, they catch Fang Sulun, the captain of the Yongchuan Hengjiu team, sneaking out of the Hongjing team's quarters.

episodes.name: A Tough Call
episodes.overview: Fang Sulun admits to stealing, leaving the team facing a dilemma. Reporting him to the police would likely result in Fang Sulun's disqualification from the competition, and while Hongjing would win, it would affect Fang Sulun's future. This time, Lin Wanxing lets the kids decide for themselves.

series.name: Love For You
aka: รักสำหรับคุณ
series.overview:
Chen Yi et Miao Jing se sont connus à l'adolescence quand leurs parents ont décidé de se marier. Alors que Chen Yi était au départ hostile, lui et Miao Jing se rapprochent très vite, si bien que quand le père de Chen Yi meurt et que la mère de Miao Jing disparaît, les deux jeunes gens ont néanmoins décidé de rester ensemble, bien que plus rien ne les relie, pour se soutenir mutuellement.
Mais ils doivent se séparer quand Chen Yi devient un témoin clé dans une affaire d'incendie. Ils se revoient des années plus tard...

series.name: Visage and Soul
aka: ลิขิตรักสลับโฉม
series.overview: Après avoir perdu la mémoire, Qiao Xiao Mi traverse une période difficile à la mort de son père, tandis que son frère Qiao Zhi Wei la place dans une situation délicate. Alors qu’elle se retrouve sans soutien, son fiancé Qin Yu, disparu depuis trois ans, réapparaît soudainement pour lui venir en aide. Avec son soutien, Xiao Mi tente de retrouver les fragments de son passé et de comprendre les mystères entourant un incendie survenu des années plus tôt. Mais entre souvenirs oubliés, secrets enfouis et sentiments incertains, leur relation est mise à l’épreuve par les mystères qui menacent de bouleverser leurs vies.

series.name: Live Forever
aka: สัญญารักเกินกาล
series.overview: Liés depuis trois mille ans, Ning Chang Yue et Song Yi Qiu traversent les époques sans jamais se quitter. Au fil des siècles, leur lien se renforce, entre souvenirs oubliés, sacrifices et sentiments inexprimés. À l’aube de l’ère moderne, ils s’interrogent sur le sens de l’éternité et doivent affronter les vérités de leur passé pour faire un choix décisif entre amour et destin.

series.name: Her Straight Punch Rule
aka: Quy Tắc Đấm Thẳng Của Cô Ấy
series.overview: Trahie et piégée, Shen Zhi Xia, championne de boxe, se réveille mystérieusement dans le corps d’une riche héritière. Pour retrouver sa vie, elle doit accomplir la vengeance inachevée de celle dont elle a pris la place. Grâce à ses talents de combattante et à sa détermination, elle affronte une puissante famille responsable de son malheur. Mais sa rencontre avec Lu Jing Heng, un PDG aussi froid que charismatique, pourrait bien bouleverser ses plans et changer son destin.

Ai Ni Shi Wo Zuo Guo Zui Hao De Shi
爱你，是我做过最好的事

Loving You is the Best Thing I Have Ever Done
Loving You is the Best Thing I Have Done
series.overview:
Shen Xi Fan est une manager en hôtellerie particulièrement accro à son travail et dont le surmenage lui cause des insomnies et migraines.
C'est comme cela qu'elle rencontre le docteur He Su Ye quand elle va le consulter pour se soigner.

episodes.name: Suye
episodes.overview: Struggling with insomnia due to work and relationship stress, Shen Xi Fan seeks help from a TCM doctor, He Su Ye. She's instantly attracted to him, but her attempts at flirting fail. He Su Ye, however, is clearly interested in her. Their paths continue to cross, and a potential romance begins to blossom, all while Xi Fan deals with a neglectful boyfriend and He Su Ye navigates his medical career and family expectations.

episodes.name: Apple
episodes.overview: He Su Ye hesitates to pursue a relationship with Shen Xi Fan due to past experiences. Xi Fan's sleep improves, but her relationship with Yan Heng deteriorates. Su Ye comforts Xi Fan and offers advice, and their connection grows during her treatment. Yan Heng breaks up with Xi Fan via text.

episodes.name: Licorice Root
episodes.overview: Shen Xi Fan deals with a sudden breakup with Yan Heng while preparing for a major IT summit at her hotel. He Su Ye, concerned about Xi Fan, gets her contact information and sends her medicine and licorice. Xi Fan learns that He Su Ye is an oncology doctor, and they meet at the hospital's herbal garden, where he provides her with a new prescription and health advice. Xi Fan is dealing with her breakup privately.

episodes.name: Mint
episodes.overview: Shen Xi Fan and He Su Ye's relationship develops through playful online interactions and thoughtful gestures, like him buying her mints to counter the bitter medicine. Su Ye's estranged father, a famous surgeon, tries to reconnect, but Su Ye refuses. A matchmaking frenzy erupts at the clinic after Su Ye is seen with Xi Fan, leading Xi Fan to suggest he pretend to be married. Su Ye uses this as an opportunity to keep a ring Xi Fan gave him, hinting at his growing feelings.

episodes.name: Chinese Yam
episodes.overview: Shen Xi Fan deals with her parents' reaction to her breakup and study abroad plans, finding solace and advice from He Su Ye, who shares his own past struggles. Their bond deepens as they support each other, culminating in a shared sunrise viewing. Xi Fan later endures a difficult day at work, compounded by menstrual cramps.

episodes.name: Artemisia Argyi
episodes.overview: Shen Xi Fan suffers from severe menstrual cramps, and He Su Ye provides comfort and care through traditional Chinese medicine. Their interactions lead to unspoken feelings and awkward online encounters. A subplot involves a terminally ill patient, mirroring Su Ye's past trauma. The episode ends with a near-accident and an embrace, leaving both Xi Fan and Su Ye questioning their relationship.

episodes.name: Osmanthus
episodes.overview: Shen Xi Fan is pressured into a blind date by her parents, while He Su Ye mistakenly believes she's engaged. After learning Xi Fan is single, He Su Ye decides to pursue her. Li Jie and Xi Fan have an awkward blind date, unknowingly discussing He Su Ye. Meanwhile, romantic tensions simmer between other characters, and Xi Fan proposes incorporating Traditional Chinese Medicine into the hotel's services for an upcoming tour group. He Su Ye prepares a special TCM meal for Xi Fan.

episodes.name: Five-flavor Fruit
episodes.overview: Shen Xi Fan is invited to He Su Ye's home for a medicinal meal, where she proposes a TCM consultant role for him at her hotel. He agrees. Their relationship deepens, with professional collaboration and personal moments intertwining. Meanwhile, young patient Zhao Ze's attachment to Su Ye, calling him "Dad," creates complications, especially when Xi Fan witnesses it, leaving her shocked at the end of the episode. Fang Ke Xin also shows that she might be interested in He Su Ye.

episodes.name: Honey
episodes.overview: Shen Xi Fan believes He Su Ye has a secret child after seeing a young patient call him "Dad." This leads to awkwardness, drunken outbursts, and Xi Fan avoiding Su Ye. The misunderstanding is eventually cleared up, revealing that the child is simply a patient attached to Su Ye. Relieved, both Xi Fan and Su Ye realize their true feelings.

episodes.name: Agarwood
episodes.overview: Shen Xi Fan tricks Xu Xiang Ya and Lin Yi Shen into tasting a bitter herb. Xu Xiang Ya flirts with Li Jie, making Lin Yi Shen jealous. He Su Ye gives Shen Xi Fan a sachet and invites her for acupuncture and a medicinal meal. A senior tour group arrives, praising the hotel's services. Zhao Ze receives a gift from He Su Ye and blesses his relationship with Shen Xi Fan. Lin Yi Shen contemplates leaving his job. He Su Ye invites Shen Xi Fan to dinner, and she notices he kept a ring she gave him.

episodes.name: Dragon Bones
episodes.overview: Shen Xi Fan's feelings for He Su Ye grow stronger, leading to several close moments, including a near-kiss interrupted by Li Jie. Shen Xi Fan also seeks He Su Ye's help with her study abroad application, focusing on Traditional Chinese Medicine. Meanwhile, Xu Xiang Ya clarifies her feelings about Li Jie and Lin Yi Shen. Shen Xi Fan deals with a stiff neck, an elderly tourist, and her growing attraction to He Su Ye.

episodes.name: Semen Cassiae
episodes.overview: He Su Ye and Shen Xi Fan's relationship progresses rapidly. After Shen Xi Fan is stood up on a blind date arranged by her parents, she ends up at a gathering with He Su Ye and his colleagues. After some teasing and drinking games, Shen Xi Fan gets drunk and kisses He Su Ye. He Su Ye reciprocates, and they share a passionate moment. The next day, He Su Ye confirms his feelings for her, and they officially become a couple, despite Shen Xi Fan's impending departure to study abroad.

episodes.name: Ginger
episodes.overview: He Su Ye confesses his feelings to Shen Xi Fan, but she rejects him due to her upcoming studies abroad. He Su Ye faces professional setbacks as his research funding is threatened. Shen Xi Fan struggles with her decision, and Fang Ke Xin confronts her about her mixed signals to He Su Ye. Ultimately, He Su Ye learns about Shen Xi Fan's fears, understanding her better.

episodes.name: Citrus Peel
episodes.overview: He Su Ye returns to his hometown for Chinese New Year, facing tension with his father, He Sheng, and feeling out of place. He connects with Shen Xi Fan, who makes his birthday special despite their distance. Su Ye provides medical care to villagers and prepares a gift for Xi Fan. The episode highlights strained family relationships, budding romance, and cultural traditions.

episodes.name: Red Beans
episodes.overview: He Su Ye returns to Hang City and gives Shen Xi Fan red beans and recipes, encouraging her to heal. He informs his grandfather about his father's new relationship. Shen Xi Fan delays her studies in Switzerland to stay longer with He Su Ye, but struggles to tell him. A medical emergency with Grandma Liu brings them closer, and He Su Ye is slightly upset when he learns about the delay from her directly. Zhao Ze is discharged, and He Su Ye relays his goodbye to Shen Xi Fan.

episodes.name: Cinnabar
episodes.overview: Relationships are tested and revealed. Lin Yi Shen and Xu Xiang Ya become a couple, while Fang Ke Xin breaks things off with He Su Ye. Su Ye pretends to be drunk to get Xi Fan's attention, stirring up her emotions. Xi Fan's ex, Yan Heng, arrives at the hotel, causing drama and forcing Xi Fan to confront her past. The episode ends with Xi Fan being reprimanded for her unprofessional behavior towards Yan Heng.

episodes.name: Artemisia Capillaris
episodes.overview: Yan Heng's reappearance causes Shen Xi Fan severe anxiety and distress. He attempts to win her back with public gestures and talks of marriage, but she rejects him. He Su Ye provides Xi Fan with emotional and medical support, helping her escape Yan Heng's advances. Xi Fan is urged by her manager to resolve the situation, while Su Ye learns of Yan Heng's disturbing influence on Xi Fan. The episode ends with Su Ye's research group receiving good news and him sharing a comforting message with Xi Fan.

episodes.name: Acorus Calamus
episodes.overview: Yan Heng tries to win Shen Xi Fan back, but she rejects him, revealing the truth about their breakup. He Su Ye supports Xi Fan, and she finally admits her feelings for him. They become a couple. Yan Heng is left heartbroken and blacklisted from a hotel. Xi Fan realizes she never liked Yan Heng's custom perfume, symbolizing her changed affections.

episodes.name: Magnolia Buds
episodes.overview: Shen Xi Fan and He Su Ye begin their romantic relationship, delighting in each other's company and sharing their happiness with friends and family. He Su Ye shows his affection through small gestures, like cooking and buying flowers. They navigate the initial stages of their relationship with open communication and consideration for each other's feelings. A humorous subplot involves He Su Ye's struggle with origami. Shen Xi Fan also confronts her ex, Yan Heng, firmly establishing her happiness with He Su Ye.

episodes.name: Paeonia Lactiflora
episodes.overview: Xi Fan officially breaks up with her ex and introduces Su Ye to her parents. A double date with friends highlights He Su Ye's terrible photography skills but strengthens his bond with Lin Yi Shen. Grandma Liu gives them a parting gift before moving abroad. Xi Fan confronts He Su Ye about his early feelings for her, and the episode ends with Xi Fan giving He Su Ye a ring, signifying her commitment.

episodes.name: Tulips
episodes.overview: It's the Qingming Festival, and He Su Ye visits his mother's grave with Yu Li Ren. Shen Xi Fan's arrival brightens his mood. The two families spend a pleasant day at the herbal garden, where secrets about He Su Ye's past and the garden's ownership are revealed. He Su Ye's playful deception of Shen Xi Fan is exposed. He Su Ye is later given an opportunity to present his project at a TCM forum.

episodes.name: Kudzu Flower
episodes.overview: He Su Ye and Shen Xi Fan's relationship progresses amidst their busy schedules. Su Ye's research gets accepted into a summit, leading to a celebratory date with Xi Fan. Li Jie faces relationship insecurities with Fang Ke Xin. The episode culminates with the Medical Summit, where Xi Fan discovers that He Sheng is Su Ye's father, hinting at potential future conflicts or connections.

episodes.name: Fox Nuts
episodes.overview: This episode focuses on the deepening relationship between He Su Ye and Shen Xi Fan, and the reconciliation between He Su Ye and his father, He Sheng. He Su Ye's professional success and Shen Xi Fan's support play key roles. The episode also features a significant gift (a bracelet), career changes, and discussions about the future, including traditional Chinese medicine.

episodes.name: Albizia Bark
episodes.overview: Shen Xi Fan and He Su Ye spend a passionate night together after Xi Fan gets locked out. They encounter Xi Fan's parents, leading to an awkward dinner invitation. He Su Ye's good mood is noticed at the hospital, while Xi Fan is teased by friends. Li Jie confesses to Fang Ke Xin, who rejects him. He Su Ye is invited to teach. Yu Li Ren checks Shen's mother's pulse with concern. Xi Fan resigns from her job, and she and He Su Ye walk home together.

episodes.name: Pinellia
episodes.overview: A famous actor's hotel visit excites staff and triggers jealousy among boyfriends. Shen Xi Fan prepares for studies abroad, discovering her mother's financial support. Shen's mother receives a breast cancer diagnosis, hiding it from Xi Fan with He Su Ye's help. Surgery is performed, and the tumor is malignant but hasn't spread, leading to a difficult decision about the extent of the surgery. Su Ye struggles with whether to tell Xi Fan the truth, as Li Jie believes she has a right to know.

episodes.name: Poria
episodes.overview: Shen Xi Fan discovers that He Su Ye has been hiding her mother's cancer diagnosis. After an emotional confrontation and reconciliation, Xi Fan learns her mother's prognosis is good, but she grapples with the decision of studying abroad while her mother undergoes treatment. She receives her passport but is filled with conflict, realizing the weight of her choice.

episodes.name: Angelica Sinensis
episodes.overview: Shen Xi Fan decides to pursue her study abroad dream after encouragement from He Su Ye and her mother. Her mother's health improves significantly after completing chemotherapy. He Su Ye supports Xi Fan's decision and helps her prepare, while also focusing on his work and missing her deeply. Xi Fan sends letters and videos to He Su Ye, updating him on her life and her mother's health. He Su Ye later understands a hidden meaning in a drawing from Xi Fan. At the end, Xi Fan gets a prestigious internship opportunity, delaying her return home.

episodes.name: Honeysuckle Flowers
episodes.overview: Shen Xi Fan returns from her two-month internship, reuniting passionately with He Su Ye. They navigate playful teasing and heartfelt moments. Xi Fan decides to start a tea shop with Xu Xiang Ya. As winter arrives, Xi Fan proposes, and Su Ye accepts. Their spring wedding is a joyous celebration with friends, family, and reconciled relationships. The episode concludes with a message of enduring love and self-love.

Au contraire, elle déploie ses propres manœuvres politiques et forge une alliance avec un prince mystérieux du royaume occidental. Alors qu'elle navigue dans les eaux troubles de la politique et de l'amour, Navier est prête à tout pour reconquérir son trône et surpasser son ex-mari à chaque tournant.

series.name: Small Town Remedy
aka: วอร์ดรักฮีลใจ
Liu Yi Sheng Fan Xiang Ji
series.overview: Liu Zheng Liang est un talentueux médecin, qui, après un incident se retrouve à devoir retourner dans sa ville natale et rejoint alors les médecins urgentistes de l'hôpital local de sa ville. Imprégné du quotidien des patients, de leurs sentiments humains et de la passion des différents médecins, il va y trouver sa propre voie ainsi qu'un moyen de guérir ses maux.

episodes.name: Missing Mother
episodes.overview: At the hospital, Liu Zhengliang reunites with his younger brother, Liu Zhengguang, who resents him for being away for so many years. Liu Zhengliang, with composure that borders on cold-bloodedness, concludes that their missing mother is dead. With hardly any words exchanged, the two brothers give each other the cold shoulder.

episodes.name: Wide Open
episodes.overview: Long Dongdong sees Liu Zhengliang's capabilities and offers to help him change his registered practice location to Xiaoximen Hospital, enabling him to operate legally. However, the condition is that he must stay and work at the rundown Xiaoximen Hospital.

episodes.name: Real Brothers
episodes.overview: Liu Zhengliang returns to the hospital ward to visit his brother, Liu Zhengguang, and discovers that he doesn't actually work for a foreign enterprise like he thought all along. Liu Zhengliang is then set on finding a different job for him.

episodes.name: The Meaning of Existence
episodes.overview: Jia Xin brings his mother, Duan, to see a doctor. She insists on having an IV drip without undergoing any tests, and she's so stubborn that no one can talk her out of it. Liu Zhengliang claims he's staying out of this, but puts on his white coat and takes over anyway.

episodes.name: Survive
episodes.overview: Che Mingming examines a young girl and determines that she has multiple fractures to her left skull and is on the verge of death. There is no time to transfer her to another hospital. Given the high risks associated with the surgery, everyone pins their hopes on Liu Zhengliang.

episodes.name: Caring About Patients
episodes.overview: Liu Zhengliang still says that he wants to return to the south, but he has already been tied down by Zhang Jiao.

episodes.name: Mother's Body Found
episodes.overview: They finally find Li Zhongling's body. Liu Zhengliang suggests, "No funeral. Just cremate her". Liu Zhengguang accuses his brother of being heartless, and the two argue again over their mother's funeral arrangements.

episodes.name: The Key in His Hand
episodes.overview: Liu Zhengliang uses work to numb himself. As Long Dongdong puts it, Liu Zhengliang is the one holding the key. No one else can help.

episodes.name: Avoidance
episodes.overview: Liu Zhengguang sees his mother's presence in every corner of his home. He decides to leave Fucheng for Beijing without discussing it with Liu Zhengliang.

episodes.name: Deputy Chief Liu
episodes.overview: Long Dongdong drags Liu Zhengliang to have his professional portrait taken, then turns around and uses it for a flashy poster that hangs high on the side of the building. He also promotes Liu Zhengliang to deputy chief of both the Emergency Department and the Neurosurgery Department.

episodes.name: A Patient Dies
episodes.overview: Liu Zhengliang sees a patient named Shao Nan, who suffers from abdominal pain. Her husband, Jiang Chao, refuses a blood test, so Liu Zhengliang can only prescribe her anti-diarrheal medication and request that she stay for observation. Soon after, Shao Nan goes into shock and passes away.

episodes.name: A Tricky Patient
episodes.overview: Just when Liu Zhengliang is about to leave Xiaoximen Hospital, he gets held up by a patient named Wang Zongqi, who is difficult to diagnose.

episodes.name: Heading to Fuzhou
episodes.overview: Long Dongdong refers Liu Zhengliang to a hospital in Fuzhou. Before leaving, Liu Zhengliang says a final goodbye to Ai Chen.

episodes.name: A Streak of Bad Luck
episodes.overview: Liu Zhengliang helps a pregnant woman on the train deliver her baby. After seeing that mother and child are safe, he realizes that he had left all his belongings on the train.

episodes.name: Stranded in Bengbu
episodes.overview: Liu Guangliang is stranded in Bengbu. He goes to an internet cafe to send out resumes online and meets a young man named Zhou Zheng. Seeing that Liu Zhengliang has nowhere to go, Zhou Zheng takes him to his family's Dream Garden Theme Hotel.

episodes.name: Have No Regrets
episodes.overview: Mr. Li is a patient who faked his illness to get attention from his son. His words resonate with Ai Chen. Determined not to have any regrets, she immediately sets out for Fuzhou.

episodes.name: Revealing Her Feelings
episodes.overview: Ai Chen reaches Bengbu and quickly hits it off with Zhou Zheng. She checks into the Dream Garden Theme Hotel. While she is in Bengbu, Ai Chen reveals her feelings to Liu Zhengliang.

episodes.name: Giving Up on Treatment
episodes.overview: Zhou Zheng reveals his secret. He has glioblastoma and has given up on treatment. He asks Liu Zhengliang to keep it a secret and not tell his mother.

episodes.name: Returning to Xiaoximen
episodes.overview: Director Yan formally announces that Xiaoximen Hospital will soon be shut down. Liu Zhengliang still decides to sign a new contract and return to Xiaoximen.

episodes.name: One Last Goodbye
episodes.overview: After surgery, Du Fang suffers a sudden, severe heart attack. He briefly sees Su Jing and their child one last time before passing away.

episodes.name: A Public Statement
episodes.overview: A television crew arrives to conduct interviews, and Long Dongdong speaks his mind on camera, insisting that Xiaoximen shouldn't be shut down. Many locals who have been treated at Xiaoximen before show up in force to speak up for this hospital that is often looked down on.

episodes.name: Exposure Therapy
episodes.overview: Liu Zhengliang comes up with the idea of using ice for exposure therapy to treat his "chionophobia". Che Changhai suggests visiting the newly opened aquarium to see the ice in the penguin exhibit.

episodes.name: Taking the Initiative
episodes.overview: Liu Zhengliang enters a cold storage facility for exposure therapy. Seeing the room covered in ice, memories from his childhood come flooding back. In a daze, he sees his mother and his younger self before losing consciousness.

episodes.name: A Child with a Family
episodes.overview: Liu Zhengliang visits his parents' graves. The caretaker tells him that Li Zhongling used to visit every year during the 12th lunar month and on Qingming. Liu Zhengliang gains a deeper understanding of his mother's loneliness and love. When he leaves the cemetery, he cheerfully tells the caretaker that he is a child with a family.

series.name: Fated Hearts
aka: อริรักลิขิตใจ
series.overview:
Alors que le royaume de Jinxiu est sur le point de perdre la bataille de Pingling, Fu Yi Xiao, une archère vêtue de rouge, tire une flèche sur Feng Sui Ge, le prince héritier de Susha, renversant ainsi le cours de la bataille. Mais peu après, elle chute accidentellement d’une falaise et perd la mémoire.

Recueillie par la famille Ling, des médecins réputés de la Villa de la Vertu, elle retrouve contre toute attente son ancien ennemi, Feng Sui Ge. Ce dernier comprend que les mésaventures de la jeune femme pourraient être liées aux événements de Pingling. Il décide alors de se servir d’elle pour découvrir la vérité, tandis que Yi Xiao compte sur lui pour échapper à ceux qui la traquent.

Contraints de s’allier malgré leur haine passée, les deux ennemis doivent désormais compter l’un sur l’autre pour survivre dans la ville agitée de Yujing. Au fil des épreuves et des dangers, leurs sentiments évoluent peu à peu. Mais entre trahisons, mensonges, rancunes et complots, chacun avance sur un échiquier où il est à la fois joueur et pion. Pour déjouer les machinations qui les menacent et reprendre leur destin en main, Yi Xiao et Sui Ge devront unir leurs forces, sans se trahir ni se perdre.Adapté du roman Yi Xiao de Chi Yi Qian Yu.

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: During the battle in Pingling City, Jinxiu’s military commander, Fu Yi Xiao, severely injures Susha’s eldest Prince, Feng Sui Ge, who quickly flees for safety. Meanwhile, Fu Yi Xiao becomes the target of assassins and is also severely injured, trying to escape. Both survive with the help of the physicians from Zhengnian Villa. As they try to speed recovery using the hidden medicine pool, they meet again, but Fu Yi Xiao has lost her memory, and Feng Sui Ge takes advantage of this.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: Feng Sui Ge tortures Fu Yi Xiao to gain information about the battle at Pingling and, in so doing, helps her remember some of her past memories. He decides to keep her alive, hoping to figure out who tried to assassinate them. They head back to the palace, but are stopped at the city gates while Sui Ge’s brother completes his coming-of-age ceremony. Meanwhile, Jinxiu’s Prince Xia Jing Shi is forced to marry Susha’s princess for diplomatic peace.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: Before striking a deal to cooperate with each other, Yi Xiao and Sui Ge get even with each other. Yi Xiao lures the assassins following her, but they hold back for some reason. The Prime Minister pressures his daughter, Empress Zhang, to prepare Princess Feng Xi Yang, Sui Ge’s sister, for marriage with the Prince of Jinxiu. Three little kids end up in Zhengnian Villa looking for their missing master.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: Sui Ge comes up with a plan to not only confirm his cooperation with Yi Xiao, but also to surface the assassins after her. Xue Ying arrives at the capital, bringing Yi Xiao’s three little disciples. However, Yi Xiao is wary of them since she is unable to remember her past with them. News from Jinxiu arrives, and the imperial court ministers debate the marriage proposal between the Princess of Sasha and the Prince of Jinxiu for peace.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: Sui Ge tells his sister Jinxiu’s plan to have her marry the Prince of Jinxiu, Xia Jing Shi, who is in love with Yi Xiao. Sui Ge vows to protect her and prevent her marriage. Yi Xiao entrusts her little disciples to Xue Ying, but things go awry when the disciples run away and A’Fang goes missing. Yi Xiao looks for him and falls into her assassin’s trap. Jing Shi receives news that Yi Xiao is alive and heads for Yujing to save her from Sui Ge.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: Sui Ge discovers that his sister has fallen in love with the Prince of Jinxiu and therefore wants to marry him. Shocked and angry that she could marry his sworn enemy, Sui Ge blames himself for her naïveté because he shielded her from treacherous people while growing up. Concerned by his sudden change in behavior, Yi Xiao accompanies Sui Ge as he tries to drown away his sorrows. Meanwhile, the Prince of Jinxiu makes haste for Yujing.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: Sui Ge calls upon Yi Xiao to help him find his most skilled archer, who has gone rogue, thinking to relieve Sui Ge of his burdens by killing Xia Jing Shi, the Prince of Jinxiu. Yi Xiao agrees on the condition that Sui Ge concedes to five of her terms and conditions. She accompanies Sui Ge to watch Jing Shi’s arrival, and past memories resurface upon seeing him. Meanwhile, Princess Xi Yang meets with Jing Shi and recounts how they first met during battle, years before.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: Princess Xi Yang is melancholy after learning that Jing Shi’s heart belongs to another woman. The Empress meets with Jing Shi to confirm his feelings for Yi Xiao, fearing Xi Yang will withdraw from the betrothal. Ning Fei and Wei Ran plead with Xue Ying to help them meet with Yi Xiao. Fearing for her safety, Sui Ge restrains Yi Xiao from meeting her Jinxiu comrades, but Yi Xiao finds a way to meet face-to-face with Jing Shi.

episodes.name: Épisode 9
episodes.overview: Despite remembering past events with Jing Shi, Yi Xiao makes it clear to him that she does not harbor the same affections for him as he does for her, which distresses him. Jing Shi tries to bring her back to Jinxiu as part of the marriage alliance negotiations, while Sui Ge prepares a surprise for him. To ascertain which of her close friends tried to kill her, she gets Ning Fei and Wei Ran drunk. Xi Yang meets with Yi Xiao, and together they run into both Jing Shi and Sui Ge while walking the city streets.

episodes.name: Épisode 10
episodes.overview: Yi Xiao catches a glimpse of Jing Shi’s pendant, prompting memories of her falling off the cliff. She decides to stay close to him, secretly asking Sui Ge for help. She discovers Jing Shi suffers from poisoning, but he keeps the details of this hidden, as it relates to his grand plan. Sui Ge awaits a response from the Emperor of Jinxiu as he, too, has grand plans of his own. Upset that Jing Shi shows a preference for Yi Xiao, the Empress enacts her own plan to ensure Jing Shi remains true to Xi Yang.

episodes.name: Épisode 11
episodes.overview: The Emperor of Jinxiu happily accepts Sui Ge’s proposal to keep Jing Shi in Susha after the wedding with his sister, as it allows him to take control of Jing Shi’s army. Yi Xiao continues to probe Ning Fei, Wei Ran, and Jing Shi about what happened after the battle in Pingling, and their differing responses make her more suspicious of Wei Ran and Jing Shi. She trades intel with Sui Ge so that she can pursue her other leads, while Prime Minister Zhuang Shen makes his move against Sui Ge.

episodes.name: Épisode 12
episodes.overview: Prime Minister Zhuang’s plan fails when the Emperor receives word from the Emperor of Jinxiu accepting Jing Shi’s matrilocal marriage with Xi Yang. Upon hearing the news, Jing Shi sets out to meet with his Susha contact while Sui Ge’s men lie in wait. Assassins target Yi Xia,o and though she is able to fight them off, she is unexpectedly forced to confront her true enemy. Xi Yang confronts Sui Ge, accusing him of using her marriage to Jing Shi to trap him in Susha.

episodes.name: Épisode 13
episodes.overview: Sui Ge’s plan falls into place when Ning Fei realizes the truth and confronts Wei Ran. Yi Xiao hears everything, vowing they are no longer sworn siblings, but strangers henceforth. Ning Fei collapses after being shot by a poisoned arrow during his scuffle with Yi Xiao’s assassins. Sui Ge finds Xue Ying’s father, who figures out a way to help Ning Fei. Meanwhile, Jing Shi uses his contact in Susha to set Wei Ran free.

episodes.name: Épisode 14
episodes.overview: Yi Xiao confronts Jing Shi and learns the truth behind her fall after the Pingling battle, and declares he will be her enemy henceforth. Sui Ge takes Yi Xiao to his mother’s residence in the woods and acknowledges his promise to Yi Xiao, granting her freedom now that she’s uncovered who tried to kill her. He then heads to meet with the Emperor to get justice for Yi Xiao, who was targeted by the Empress.

episodes.name: Épisode 15
episodes.overview: Sui Ge angers his father when he accuses him of turning a blind eye to the Empress’ actions in trying to kill Yi Xiao. Sui Ge is removed as the secondary officiant in the Ancestral Ceremony and replaced by his younger brother, indicating Sui Ge is no longer favored by the Emperor. Knowing he’s upset, Yi Xiao takes Sui Ge to a place to help calm him and, in so doing, learns the story behind his mother’s death. Murong Yao and his father arrive to attend Xi Yang’s wedding, and though Murong Yao is to keep tabs on Jing Shi, Jing Shi suddenly disappears.

episodes.name: Épisode 16
episodes.overview: While following a lead to the masked man working with Jing Shi, Yi Xiao spots a familiar face and unexpectedly falls into a trap in a death camp. She learns who the mastermind behind it all is, while Sui Ge discovers another lead to Manager Luo. Sui Ge and his sister mend their relationship before her royal wedding, with Sui Ge promising to attend. All the while, Sui Ge and Yi Xiao slowly grow closer together.

episodes.name: Épisode 17
episodes.overview: Sui Ge begins to share his true feelings for Yi Xiao. Despite Jing Shi’s apathy towards Xi Yang on their wedding night, Xi Yang pledges to be by his side and gives him the gift of freedom. Sui Ge pursues them, intending to bring them back to the capital, and Yi Xiao follows, knowing Jing Shi has other motives. During the confrontation, Jing Shi targets Sui Ge, while Yi Xiao targets Jing Shi, putting her injured left arm at risk of permanent damage.

episodes.name: Épisode 18
episodes.overview: Not believing that Ning Fei is dead, Jing Shi commands Wei Ran to look for him. Xue Ying’s father performs surgery on Yi Xiao’s injured left arm. Sui Ge defies his father’s summons to attend the imperial court to ensure Yi Xiao’s surgery goes well, then meets with his father alone to seek punishment. However, his father suddenly falls ill soon after meeting him, and a confrontation between him and the Empress ensues. Yi Xiao catches a glimpse of the masked man’s carriage.

episodes.name: Épisode 19
episodes.overview: Sui Ge convinces Yi Xiao to leave the capital, knowing she will be targeted by the imperial ministers. Yi Xiao sets an elaborate trap to capture Ru Yan and use her as the bait for the masked man. However, she is caught off guard when she finds out the identity of the masked man, and he intercepts her before she can warn Sui Ge. Meanwhile, Sui Ge’s investigation leads him to Jing Shi’s death warriors and their attempt to assassinate the imperial minister of war.

episodes.name: Épisode 20
episodes.overview: While Yi Xiao tries to convince Ru Yan to move on with her life, Sui Ge focuses on getting the identity of the masked man by interrogating the death warriors. The Empress Dowager of Jinxiu and her son, the Emperor, scheme to keep control of Jing Shi now that he’s back. Prime Minister Zhuang takes control of the imperial court, planning to replace Sui Ge’s only supporter with his own. Things come to a head when the Prime Minister insinuates the Emperor’s current state is caused by Sui Ge.

episodes.name: Épisode 21
episodes.overview: Yi Xiao thinks of a way to control Murong Yao since she’s not able to tell Sui Ge the truth about him. Back in Jinxiu, the Emperor finds ways to ridicule and exert his dominance over Jing Shi, while Jing Shi slowly bides his time. Lord Ling makes it known that the Emperor has a terminal illness he’s been keeping secret for the past 15 years. Prime Minister Zhuang begins influencing the ministers to make Sui Ge’s brother the next emperor, but surprisingly wants to keep the Emperor alive.

episodes.name: Épisode 22
episodes.overview: The Empress and Prime Minister Zhuang sow discord between Sui Ge and his brother, forcing his brother to accept becoming the next emperor when his father dies. Yi Xiao makes the difficult decision to tell Sui Ge the truth about the masked man’s identity, wondering if Sui Ge would believe her…

episodes.name: Épisode 23
episodes.overview: With Murong Yao’s father held captive by Yi Xiao, Murong Yao and Prime Minister Zhuang are at odds over how to deal with the Emperor. With the help of his nephew, Prime Minister Zhuang obtains what he needs to enact revenge against the Emperor. Realizing his father is at the mercy of Murong Yao, Sui Ge summons his Qionqi Unit and Feng Battalion to seize control of his father’s protection.

episodes.name: Épisode 24
episodes.overview: Intent on keeping his father alive, Sui Ge storms the palace and confronts Prime Minister Zhuang, who has assembled the imperial guards to thwart Sui Ge. Meanwhile, Jing Shi entrusts his plans to overthrow his brother to Xi Yang, but his brother’s interest in Xi Yang sows a seed of doubt in Jing Shi. In his attempt to find his father, Sui Ge comes face-to-face with the reality of his mother’s death.

episodes.name: Épisode 25
episodes.overview: The Emperor continues to justify his actions, but both Sui Ge and Yi Xiao don’t agree with his principles, with Sui Ge refusing to be his successor. Murong Yao finds his father, but his father is disappointed in what his son has become. Prime Minister Zhuang continues with his plans for revenge, enlisting his nephew, Zhuang Ming. Meanwhile, Xi Yang becomes embittered by her loveless marriage to Jing Shi.

episodes.name: Épisode 26
episodes.overview: The Emperor of Jinxiu spares no effort in helping Xi Yang realize how cruel Jing Shi really is. He makes it known to her that her father is deathly ill, but try as she might, she is not able to leave and visit him. Prime Minister Zhuang’s plan goes into effect, even sacrificing innocent people in the process. Things culminate to the point of finally exposing the truth behind Sui Ge’s mother’s death.

episodes.name: Épisode 27
episodes.overview: Sui Ge finally avenges his mother’s wrongful death and then bids farewell to his father, not wanting to do anything more with him. As he and his men celebrate, the Empress confronts the Emperor with devastating consequences. Murong Zhong lies in wait, looking for someone who can help protect his son from his treasonous crimes.

episodes.name: Épisode 28
episodes.overview: The Empress colludes with Murong Zhong to pin the Emperor’s death on Sui Ge. Though Murong Yao heeds his father’s commands, he still holds brotherly love for Sui Ge. Yi Xiao, along with Sui Ge’s men, fights with all their might to save Sui Ge, but it comes at a high cost. Meanwhile, Xi Yang regrets marrying Jing Shi, proclaiming she has divorced him. As news of the Emperor’s and Sui Ge’s deaths circulates, Jing Yan is anxious to be rid of Jing Shi.

episodes.name: Épisode 29
episodes.overview: Upon arriving at the Storm Alliance, Yi Xiao faces obstacles in getting treatment for Sui Ge. Despite the Storm Alliance’s grim history with the Fengs, Yi Xiao makes a case for Sui Ge using the basic principles upon which the Storm Alliance was founded. Xi Yang vows not only to rely on herself moving forward, but also to take revenge on those who murdered her father and brother.

episodes.name: Épisode 30
episodes.overview: Cheng Yang ascends the throne but is already cautioned to be wary of the Murong family, while the Murong family plots to stay in power. Jing Shi gathers his men and makes his move, while Xi Yang makes a sacrifice to learn who was behind the deaths of her father and brother. Although Sui Ge is saved, he’s not completely in the clear, health-wise. He and Yi Xiao weigh the costs and benefits of further treatment.

episodes.name: Épisode 31
episodes.overview: Xi Yang is incredulous after hearing the reports of what happened in Susha. Disbelieving, she asks Jing Yan to continue investigating and slowly aligns herself with him. Realizing Jing Yan is infatuated with Xi Yang, the Empress of Jinxiu looks to Jing Shi to attack Susha. Yi Xiao discovers that the man who had lost his memories still remembers his wife, so she takes a gamble with her life and confronts Sui Ge.

episodes.name: Épisode 32
episodes.overview: Yi Xiao’s gamble pays off, but now they must find a way to leave the premises of Storm Alliance. Elders Zhou and Zhang have plans of their own, counter to Elder Lei. Xi Yang makes a bet with Jing Yan and wins after exposing Jing Shi’s planted spy. Meanwhile, back at Susha, Emperor Cheng Yang learns more about the death of his father.

episodes.name: Épisode 33
episodes.overview: Sui Ge and Yi Xiao deduce what Elders Zhou and Zhang are planning and make their own plans. Elder Lei realizes how stifling the rules are, while Sui Ge vows to find who was behind the Storm Alliance massacre. Emperor Cheng Yang confronts his mother and learns the truth. Xi Yang makes another wager with Jing Yan. Sui Ge finally reunites with his brothers in arms.

episodes.name: Épisode 34
episodes.overview: Sui Ge’s men give him updates on the happenings at the palace. Sui Ge decides to schedule a meeting with his brother, Cheng Yang. The Empress Dowager can no longer stand Xi Yang and does everything in her power to get rid of her. Xi Yang tries to persuade Jing Yan to help kill the Murongs, while Jing Shi plans on dealing with Xi Yang.

episodes.name: Épisode 35
episodes.overview: Sui Ge and his team are suddenly ambushed by Murong Yao. Sui Ge decides to seek out his Feng battalion to see if they will still stand with him. The Empress Dowager leans more and more heavily on Jing Shi, who decides to finally make his move. Cheng Yang’s suspicions are validated when his mother decides to wrest control from him and place him under house arrest.

episodes.name: Épisode 36
episodes.overview: With his powers stripped by Cheng Yang, Murong Yao heads back to his residence, finding Sui Ge and his battalion waiting for him. Xi Yang receives a letter from Sui Ge and pleads with Jing Yan to allow her to see him. Worried for Xi Yang’s safety, Sui Ge immediately heads off to Jinxiu. Xi Yang receives alarming news that changes Jing Shi’s plans for attack.

episodes.name: Épisode 37
episodes.overview: Xi Yang promises Jing Yan that if he allows her to see her brother, she will stay with him on his birthday. Knowing Sui Ge will take his sister away, Jing Yan heartbrokenly agrees. Yi Xiao and Ning Fei confront Wei Ran and realize Jing Shi will make his move soon. Worried, Sui Ge chases after Xi Yang, who has left to spend time with Jing Yan on his birthday.

episodes.name: Épisode 38
episodes.overview: Jing Shi finally gets the revenge he’s been planning and waiting for, but is dismayed when Yi Xiao makes it clear she only sees him as her enemy. Sui Ge gathers his men for a showdown with Jing Shi, who has prepared an ambush. Unwilling to accompany the dead Emperor in the mausoleum, the Empress Zhuang makes her own plans for her future. In the aftermath, Sui Ge leaves the governmental affairs to Xi Yang, while Cheng Yang lives in seclusion in Youqi temple, and Sui Ge mourns for 3 years before deciding what to do next.

series.name: The Wanted Detective
aka: คลื่นลมปมปริศนา
定風波～神捕、冥き真実を暴く～
series.overview:
Le jour de son mariage, un jour de tempête, Xiao Bei Ming, connu comme le meilleur détective du royaume de Qi, est accusé à tort d'avoir assassiné son maître et n'a d'autre choix que de fuir.
Il revient trois ans plus tard et avec le soutien de sa sœur d'armes, Zhong Xue Man, va enquêter pour découvrir la vérité avec un groupe de jeunes gens.

episodes.name: Épisode 1
episodes.overview: A series of murders targeting the top prime ministers is being carried out by an organization called Yesha. Xiao Bei Ming, a rising investigator, proclaims to solve the mystery in 3 days, but things go awry when something happens that he did not anticipate.

episodes.name: Épisode 2
episodes.overview: After narrowing down the possible suspects, Xiao Bei Ming convinces his father-in-law to use his wedding day with Xue Man to find the true culprit… leading to unimaginable consequences.

episodes.name: Épisode 3
episodes.overview: Three years later, Xiao Bei Ming resurfaces, just as new murders involving the sewing of brides begin. After searching for clues for the past couple of years, Xiao Bei Ming reaches out to Xue Man for help in finding the real culprit who murdered her father and the 3 other men on the boat on their wedding day.

episodes.name: Épisode 4
episodes.overview: Xue Man realizes that there is another culprit, whom they have named as “Tailor”, responsible for the deaths of the brides. As she moves forward with the investigation, she, Bei Ming, and Qing Zhuo are targeted by multiple people.

episodes.name: Épisode 5
episodes.overview: Bei Ming, Xue Man, and Qing Zhuo follow leads to Hu Shisan and Sada, but it results in dead ends. Bei Ming begins to suffer the ill effects of the poison pill that was accidentally given to him. Zhuge Kong Yun continues to keep an eye on them, hoping to expose Bei Ming.

episodes.name: Épisode 6
episodes.overview: Bei Ming, Xue Man, and Qing Zhuo head to Marquis Jingshan’s manor, where they hope to find Ajia, who they believe is impersonating Sada. Ajia is suddenly kidnapped, and the whole constabulary is in a mad dash to find him and his kidnapper, not realizing who the real target is.

episodes.name: Épisode 7
episodes.overview: Though Bei Ming and Xue Man find out who the Tailor is, sewing up bride corpses, they discover that the Tailor is one of many in the Yesha organization, born of the blood bath in Haiya, being kept secret by the government. Yesha strikes again, claiming the lone remaining prime minister.

episodes.name: Épisode 8
episodes.overview: Another life is claimed, and though Bei Ming, Xue Man, and Kong Yun believe it is the work of Yesha, they must find evidence to confirm. General Huo’s wife and disciples prevent the constabulary from investigating, but they find ways around it and encounter Huo Dai Rong, General Huo’s daughter, who also wants to know the truth about his death.

episodes.name: Épisode 9
episodes.overview: The case for General Huo’s death goes in a completely different direction when a more detailed autopsy reveals the true cause of his death. Bei Ming, Xue Man, and Kong Yun continue their investigation at General Huo’s mansion.

episodes.name: Épisode 10
episodes.overview: During the team’s investigation at General Huo’s mansion, Huo Dai Rong calls out Xiao Bei Ming, and the team realizes there is more to Dai Rong than meets the eye with Dai Rong. There is yet another death at the mansion; however, the suspect this time is a shock to everyone.

episodes.name: Épisode 11
episodes.overview: Xue Man and Kong Yun go after Madam Huo and Li Xiao, learning the truth about their relationship and interaction with General Huo. Bei Ming goes back to General Huo’s mansion to search for more clues, which ultimately leads him to Madam Feng and Dai Rong.

episodes.name: Épisode 12
episodes.overview: The team solves the mystery behind General Huo’s death, but Bei Ming can’t shake the feeling that there’s something more than meets the eye. Bei Ming’s illness resurfaces again and is worse than before. Qing Zhuo scrambles to find an antidote.

episodes.name: Épisode 13
episodes.overview: Dai Rong finds a new lead that the team traces to Guangsha Villa, owned by General Huo’s personal guard. She follows them on their investigation to learn more about her true identity. However, they are one step late as their lead unexpectedly perishes.

episodes.name: Épisode 14
episodes.overview: The team arrests the Immortal’s disciple when they notice inconsistencies in his behavior and what he told them. Their investigation leads them to a new suspect who is related to Haiya and Yesha. Kong Yun is not far behind in his investigation.

episodes.name: Épisode 15
episodes.overview: Xue Man gives an update on the Chu Gang Sha case to Kong Yun and his father. Qing Zhuo’s identity comes into question when Xue Man finds Old Bug to obtain the Fire Cicada herb for Bei Ming.

episodes.name: Épisode 16
episodes.overview: Qing Zhuo gains a lot of information from Old Bug, good and bad, leading the team to head to Weizhou, where the rare red crystal can be found. With all of her family gone, Dai Rong joins them in their investigation, while Ton Shuang wrestles with his past.

episodes.name: Épisode 17
episodes.overview: After arriving at the Pingyuan Agency, Tong Shuang’s home, the townsfolk accuse them of taking corpses and haunting the cemetery. The team investigates the sick horses, the missing corpses, and the red crystal mine. Tormented by the murder of his family and unable to control his anger, Tong Shuang puts his friends at risk.

episodes.name: Épisode 18
episodes.overview: Kong Yun begins to piece things together, then heads to Weizhou, looking for Bei Ming. As the team continues the investigation, Bei Ming takes some time to address Tong Shuang’s anger and pain. Bei Ming and Qing Zhuo continue to keep their secret from the rest of the team.

episodes.name: Épisode 19
episodes.overview: After realizing Bei Ming is still poisoned, the team bands together to help solve the Yesha case. Qing Zhuo volunteers to go undercover to find out how and where the Yellow Heaven is harvesting blood for the immortality pill that killed Chu Guang Sha. Despite their efforts to keep tabs on Qing Zhou, he suddenly goes missing.

episodes.name: Épisode 20
episodes.overview: The team trace Qing Zhuo’s blood to the cave where Yellow Heaven is harvesting blood. Though they capture the Master of Yellow Heaven, Kong Yun intercepts them and takes their prisoner before they reach the capital. Kong Yun is caught in an ambush, and the prisoner escapes.

episodes.name: Épisode 21
episodes.overview: Old Bug abducts Bei Ming and lures Xue Man to his hideout in an effort to surpass his nemesis, Qing Zhuo’s master. Kong Yun vows to find the escaped prisoner in three days to delay the Emperor’s punishment. Xue Man is tricked by Old Bug.

episodes.name: Épisode 22
episodes.overview: Bei Ming and team scramble to find evidence that will exculpate Xue Man, while the Elite Constabulary rally to support her. However, time is running out for Kong Yun and his father, so they decide to take a gamble on Xue Man’s life.

episodes.name: Épisode 23
episodes.overview: Though Bei Ming clears Xue Man of the charges against her, he is taken into custody on suspicion of being Yesha. Kong Yun does the unthinkable, proposing that Bei Ming be sent back to the Elite Constabulary for questioning. Bei Ming understands Kong Yun’s intentions.

episodes.name: Épisode 24
episodes.overview: As their first order of priority, the team set out to find Huang Wu Chang, the Holy Master of Yellow Heaven, who had escaped. They investigate who had knowledge of the secret route Kong Yun took while escorting Wu Chang back to the capital. Needing Kong Yun’s help, Tong Shuang, Qing Zhuo, and Dai Rong attempt to reach out to Li Long, Kong Yun’s personal guard.

episodes.name: Épisode 25
episodes.overview: After figuring out who decoded the secret message indicating Kong Yun’s path back to the capital with Wu Chang, new clues lead them to a mysterious substance that attracts lightning. The team heads to Mount Lightning to not only capture Wu Chang, but also to find Tong Shuang, who has gone missing.

episodes.name: Épisode 26
episodes.overview: Bei Ming and Kong Yun make a deal, working together to unravel the mysteries of Yesha and Haiya. Kong Yun’s investigations led Bei Ming to Wu Zhui, who was likely present in the Haiya massacre. Bei Ming takes a gamble and stakes his life for truth and justice.

episodes.name: Épisode 27
episodes.overview: Although the team gains new information after obtaining the book of Haiya orphans, it leads them to a dead end, as anyone related to Haiya has been eliminated by Yesha except for a select few. A final clue left by Wu Zhui leads them to the darkest place in the Qi Kingdom, the Infernal Dungeon.

episodes.name: Épisode 28
episodes.overview: Using the map from Wu Lie, the team heads to Haiya, where they find a mysterious group of women and children within a barricaded camp. The team must earn the trust of the Haiya people to understand what caused the massacre many years ago. They discover it all started at the center of Haiya, called Lonely Town, where people become monsters.

episodes.name: Épisode 29
episodes.overview: The team captures Luo Shu’s brother, who tells them to go to the Bei Hai residence in Lonely Town. They discover a passageway that leads them to different levels underneath the mansion. They must survive and complete the task of each level to proceed to the next. Qing Zhuo finds clues relating to Poison Valley.

episodes.name: Épisode 30
episodes.overview: When the team reach the final level, they discover a room that contains the historical events leading to the massacre at Haiya and information about Bei Ming’s parents.

episodes.name: Épisode 31
episodes.overview: Time is running out as Chief Fang has been arrested by Chief Zhuge for releasing Bei Ming. Though Bei Ming has deduced the identity of Yesha, he and his team scramble to find him before Chief Fang is executed. Kong Yun confronts his father, trying to understand his enmity toward the Elite Constabulary.

episodes.name: Épisode 32
episodes.overview: They search for Miao Jie’s adopted son, who they think became the next Yesha after Miao Jie’s death. Upon finding him, they realize he was subjected to Miao Jie’s tortures and ran away from him because he didn’t hold the same beliefs. Bei Ming locks himself up to study all the cases related to Yesha. He emerges, shaken, asking Kong Yun to accompany him somewhere…

episodes.name: Épisode 33
episodes.overview: Kong Yun returns with shocking news that confirms Bei Ming’s suspicions about the identity of Yesha. Bei Ming seeks an audience with the Emperor to determine the next steps. Meanwhile, Yesha returns, claiming yet another life.

episodes.name: Épisode 34
episodes.overview: Bei Ming comes face-to-face with his brother, Bei Kun, who has voluntarily turned himself in. Unbeknownst to Bei Ming, this was all part of Bei Kun’s larger plan. Time is running out for the team as they hurriedly unravel Bei Kun’s deceptions.

episodes.name: Épisode 35
episodes.overview: By tracing down the small clues left behind, Bei Ming meticulously unravels Bei Kun’s illusions. To quell the unrest spreading across the capital, the Emperor decides to have a Heaven Worship Ceremony. Realizing this is the next opportune moment for Bei Kun, Bei Ming and team prepare to take him on.

episodes.name: Épisode 36
episodes.overview: Unbeknownst to the team, their plan to capture Bei Kun was yet again a part of his master plan. Bei Kun traps Bei Ming, Xue Man, Kong Yun, Qing Zhuo, and Dai Rong, while he carries out his plan to destroy Qi. Out of desperation, one of them makes the biggest sacrifice, so they can all escape and stop Bei Kun, and in so doing, unwittingly discovers how to save the people of Qi.

series.name: Twelve Letters
aka: จดหมายสิบสองฉบับ
series.overview:
En 1991, Ye Hai Tang est une jeune lycéenne qui vit avec son père violent, accros aux jeux d'argent et criblé de dettes. Elle fait la rencontre de Tan Yi Xun un jeune camarade de classe qui survit en collectant les dettes.
Lorsqu'un jour, une lettre d'amour signée de Tang Yi Xun datant de 2026 vient semer le trouble. Elle provient d'une étrange boîte aux lettres rouge apparue récemment.

Lassée, fatiguée de sa vie faite de souffrance et de solitude, Ye Hai Tang écrit une lettre de suicide un soir de septembre 1991 et la glisse dans la mystérieuse boîte aux lettres rouge. Plus tard sa lettre disparaît.

En 2026, Yu Nian recherche son père porté disparu. Elle découvre dans une boîte aux lettres rouge la lettre de suicide de Ye Hai Tang. Ses recherches finissent par la conduire à Shen Cheng qui essaie de retrouver sa mère dont il n'a plus aucune nouvelle.

Face à ces événements mystérieux, tous se questionnent et commencent à enquêter.
Débute alors une correspondance entre 1991 et 2026 qui liera à jamais le destin de Ye Hai Tang, Tang Yi Xun, Yu Nian et Shen Cheng.

episodes.name: I Want to Give You Sunny Day, But I Only Have An Umbrella Woven from Storm Clouds
The Spring is Bright, But Gone Forever

series.name: A Vow in the Dark
aka: ลิขิตรักเทพมาร
series.overview: Des siècles après qu’un immortel légendaire a mis fin à une ère de ténèbres, une jeune créature céleste bouleverse malgré elle l’équilibre entre les mondes, permettant à un ancien seigneur démoniaque de revenir. Propulsée dans un univers bien plus dangereux qu’elle ne l’imaginait, elle se retrouve liée à cet être par un destin qui les oppose. D’abord ennemis, rongés par les rancœurs du passé et leurs allégeances contraires, ils voient peu à peu leur hostilité s’atténuer au fil de leurs rencontres, laissant naître des sentiments inattendus. Mais lorsque les secrets entourant les origines de la jeune femme commencent à se dévoiler, leur lien est mis à l’épreuve et tous deux doivent faire des choix susceptibles de bouleverser le destin de plusieurs mondes.

series.name: When I Meet the Moon
aka: เอื้อมรักคว้าจันทร์
折月亮～月に出会ったとき～
series.overview:
Pour gagner en indépendance, Yun Li, qui est d'une timidité extrême et souffre d'angoisse sociale, décide de poursuivre ses études et de faire un doctorat. C'est ainsi qu'elle retrouve son premier amour, Fu Shi Ze, à qui elle n'avait jamais osé se déclarer au lycée. Décidée cette fois à gagner son coeur, tous les deux finissent par tomber amoureux mais finissent par rompre à cause de leurs blessures personnelles.
Des années plus tard, Fu Shi Ze est maintenant un grand chercheur et Yun Li revient de l'étranger. Cette fois, c'est au tour de Fu Shi Ze de tenter de la conquérir.

series.name: Mystery Forest
series.overview: Seize ans après l’explosion qui a détruit la scierie de Zhao Zhiguo et décimé sa famille, Zhao Long, unique survivant du drame, réapparaît dans sa ville natale sous le nom de Wang Hong. Derrière une apparente activité de négoce de pin de Corée, il mène une enquête discrète pour découvrir les véritables circonstances de la tragédie. Mais alors qu’une série de meurtres plonge la ville dans le chaos et ravive les rivalités entre les figures influentes du secteur forestier, il fait la rencontre de Li Xuefei, une jeune femme à la recherche de sa mère disparue. Ensemble, ils vont peu à peu mettre au jour un réseau de contrebande de bois et déterrer les secrets enfouis depuis seize ans.

series.name: One Year to Live, Buy a Man

Една година живот, купи си мъж
series.overview: Yui Katakura,40 ans, est une célibataire qui passe son temps à faire des économies. Elle se constitue patiemment un pécule pour sa retraite, jusqu'au jour où un dépistage gratuit du cancer bouleverse sa vie bien rangée. Il révèle qu'il ne lui resterait qu'un an à vivre. Encore sous le choc, elle voit surgir Yoshitaka Sena, alias Ryuma, un hôte séduisant aux cheveux roses, qui lui demande si elle pourrait lui prêter de l'argent. Puisqu'elle va mourir, à quoi bon continuer d'économiser ? Yui accepte cette demande osée et "achète" Sena pour 720 000 yens. Leur étrange relation prend alors une tournure inattendue.

series.name: Possible Love
aka: รักเป็นไปได้
series.overview: Un employé licencié et son épouse, qui croisent la route d'une documentariste et de son conjoint, affrontent leurs désirs cachés.

series.name: Sunshine Through the Rain
aka: แดดใสในวันฝนพรำ
series.overview:
Zheng Yu, une jeune fille au caractère bien trempé, a dû mûrir trop vite face aux difficultés financières de sa famille. Habituée à assumer de lourdes responsabilités, elle affronte les épreuves avec courage et détermination.

De son côté, Chen Yan Zhou s'est renfermé sur lui-même depuis la mort de son frère aîné. Accablé par le chagrin, il peine à renouer avec les autres et préfère garder ses émotions enfouies.

Lorsqu'ils se rencontrent au lycée, leurs personnalités opposées les conduisent à devenir rivaux. Mais au fil du temps, les conflits laissent place à une compréhension mutuelle, puis à une complicité grandissante.

Confrontés aux épreuves familiales, au deuil et aux difficultés de l'adolescence, ils apprennent peu à peu à s'épauler et à trouver l'un auprès de l'autre la force d'avancer.

episodes.overview: Overworked Zheng Yu fights to stay afloat financially, while an awkward rainy-day encounter leaves her wary of returning student Chen Yanzhou.

episodes.name: The Driven

series.overview: Li Xun, développeur de génie, voit la vie comme la programmation d'un ordinateur. Il vit dans un monde à part et ne comprend pas cette émotion qu'on appelle "amour". Son existence change du tout au tout quand il rencontre Zhu Yun, une jeune femme à l'esprit cartésien qui ne voit en Li Xun qu'un fauteur de troubles. Malgré leurs différences, ils sont attirés l'un l'autre et une douce romance naît entre eux, jusqu'à ce qu'un incident bouleverse leur vie et menace de les séparer pour toujours. Adapté du roman de Twentine qui a déjà été porté sur le petit écran dans une série animée, ce drama chinois a été réalisé en 2022 par Liu Chun Chieh et Ma Wei Wei.

series.name: Francesca Next Door
series.overview:
Na Yeong, une jeune vampire originaire de Roumanie, intègre un lycée humain sans rien connaître aux codes sociaux ni aux habitudes du quotidien. Bien qu’elle suive sa propre logique et ne cherche jamais à faire de mal, son manque de familiarité avec le monde des humains la plonge souvent dans des situations embarrassantes.

Tout bascule lorsqu’elle rencontre U Ju. Pour la première fois, elle ressent son cœur s’emballer et découvre des émotions jusqu’alors inconnues.

Mais son attirance grandissante pour un humain se complique lorsqu’un autre vampire éveille en elle des instincts qu’elle s’efforce de maîtriser. Partagée entre sentiments naissants et pulsions incontrôlables, Na Yeong doit trouver sa place entre amour, désir et nature vampirique.

Au cœur de sa vie lycéenne, elle s’apprête à vivre une romance aussi douce que dangereuse.

episodes.name: Let’s Stay Out of Each Other’s Business
episodes.overview: Model student and class president U Ju lives strictly by the book until Na Young arrives to his class. Clueless about human life and hiding an impossible secret, the eccentric new transfer student turns U Ju's picture-perfect routine into utter chaos.

episodes.name: Not a Butler, But a Guide
episodes.overview: To protect her secret identity, Na Young strikes a private tutoring deal with U Ju. But just as their awkward study sessions begin to stir strange, brand-new feelings neither expected, another vampire, Yoo Hyeol, appears to disrupt their delicate new bond.

series.overview: Dans la Corée des années 1950, sur l'île de Jeju, Oh Ae Sun et Yang Gwan Sik grandissent ensemble entre rêves et épreuves. Ae Sun, rebelle dans l'âme et passionnée de littérature, aspire à devenir poétesse malgré la pauvreté qui l'empêche d'aller à l'école. Libre et expressive, elle ne cache jamais ses émotions. Gwan Sik, quant à lui, est un jeune homme discret et inflexible, qui n'aime qu'Ae Sun et la soutient avec sincérité.

episodes.name: Épisode 1 : La fugacité du printemps
episodes.overview: Élevée par une mère déterminée, la jeune et créative Ae-sun nourrit des rêves qui dépassent les frontières de son village... jusqu'à ce qu'une tragédie vienne tout bouleverser.

episodes.name: Épisode 2 : L'audace du premier amour
episodes.overview: Alors que l'amour s'épanouit entre eux, Ae-sun et Gwan-sik prennent ensemble une première décision osée. Mais leur aventure romantique se heurte à un obstacle.

episodes.name: Épisode 3 : Ton printemps était hier
episodes.overview: Après un sauvetage spectaculaire, Ae-sun et Gwan-sik retournent à Jeju. Gwan-sik est dévasté de voir qu'Ae-sun pense se résigner à son triste sort.

episodes.name: Épisode 4 : Le soleil écrasant de l'été
episodes.overview: L'été emplit de joie les jeunes mariés, qui commencent leur vie ensemble. Mais la famille de Gwan-sik met leur bonheur à l'épreuve... Sauront-ils trouver le chemin de la paix ?

episodes.name: Épisode 5 : La pêche miraculeuse d'une nuit d'été
episodes.overview: Gwan-sik peine à trouver du travail et Ae-sun s'inquiète pour sa famille quand soudain, l'horizon se dégage. Peu après, Ae-sun laisse parler ses ambitions.

episodes.name: Épisode 6 : La vie continue
episodes.overview: Alors qu'Ae-sun et Gwan-sik goûtent enfin aux joies de leur nouvelle vie, une tempête estivale vient tout bouleverser. Trouveront-ils la force de persévérer ?

episodes.name: Épisode 7 : Les fruits de l'automne
episodes.overview: L'élection du chef du village approche. Ae-sun est confrontée à une opposition corrompue et Geum-myeong reçoit une demande inhabituelle qui teste son intégrité.

episodes.name: Épisode 8 : La lune croît et décroît, mais le cœur refuse de vieillir
episodes.overview: Lorsque Geum-myeong obtient une chance d'étudier au Japon, elle touche ses rêves du doigt. Ae-sun et Gwan-sik doivent alors prendre une décision difficile.

series.name: Walking on Thin Ice
series.overview:
Kang Eun Su n'a jamais aspiré à une vie de luxe, se contentant du bonheur simple auprès de son mari, Park Do Jin, et sa fille. Mais quand le diagnostic de cancer de son mari tombe, Eun Su peine à joindre les deux bouts avec son emploi à temps partiel de caissière dans un supermarché. Et sa vie bascule dans l'absurde et le tragique lorsqu'elle découvre par hasard des millions de dollars de drogue et décide de la vendre plutôt que de la rapporter à la police.
Elle s'associe à Lee Gyeong, le professeur d'art de sa fille qui, en secret, trafique de la drogue dans les clubs de Gangnam pour arrondir ses fins de mois.

series.name: One of a Kind Romance
series.overview:
Ong Yu Il, une jeune femme optimiste malgré ses difficultés professionnelles et sentimentales, voit sa vie basculer lorsqu'elle devient la manager de Tak Mu I, l'une des plus grandes stars du pays. Elle découvre alors que l'acteur est le plus grand admirateur d'un roman qu'elle a écrit des années plus tôt et qui l'a aidé à surmonter une période difficile de sa vie.

Au fil de leurs rencontres, une complicité inattendue laisse place à des sentiments amoureux. Mais leur rapprochement est mis à l'épreuve par l'arrivée de Kang Hui Su, un chef cuisinier mystérieux, et de Ju Da Hong, une actrice qui nourrit depuis longtemps des sentiments pour Mu I.

Adapté du webtoon « One-Of-A-Kind Romance » (유일무이 로맨스) de Du Bu (두부).

When her rooftop home is chosen as a filming location for a TV drama, her life takes an unexpected turn. Meanwhile, Tak Mu I, a top star and former child actor, is on edge ahead of his upcoming film release. When a stalker starts following him, he begins to suspect Yu Il, whom he keeps running into. Can these two clear up the misunderstanding?

episodes.name: The Stalker’s Identity
episodes.overview: Realizing that Yu Il holds the key to overcoming his career slump, Mu I desperately tries to win her cooperation. But Yu Il, already fed up with him, has no intention of making things easy. As Mu I anxiously struggles to win her over, a stalker who has misunderstood their relationship reveals a sinister side, putting them both in danger.

series.overview:
Park Dong Hun, quadragénaire marié et père de famille, semble mener une vie idéale. Pourtant, derrière cette apparente stabilité se cache un homme profondément solitaire, qui subit son existence en silence pour ne pas inquiéter ses proches.

À 20 ans, Lee Ji An mène une existence difficile. Endettée et contrainte de travailler sans relâche pour subvenir aux besoins de sa grand-mère, elle a perdu toute confiance en l'être humain.

Leurs chemins se croisent lorsque Ji An intègre l'entreprise de Dong Hun. Chargée par le PDG, qui nourrit une rancune envers ce dernier, de découvrir son point faible en échange d'une importante somme d'argent, elle se rapproche peu à peu de lui. Mais au fil de leurs rencontres, une relation inattendue se noue : pour la première fois, Ji An trouve en Dong Hun une personne en qui elle peut véritablement avoir confiance.

episodes.overview: Dong-hoon confronte Jun-yeong dans un lieu de campement isolé pour mettre fin à ses manigances. Pendant un certain temps, Jun-yeong semble faire ce qu'on lui demande.

episodes.name: 30,000 Years Old
episodes.overview: Lee Gwang-il observe de loin Ji-an se rapprocher de Dong-hoon. Dong-hoon se voit offrir un siège au conseil d'administration, ce qui lui donne l'occasion de se venger.

episodes.name: The Envelope
episodes.overview: Jun-yeong réalise que Ji-an pourrait être son arme la plus sûre. La famille de Dong-hoon s'emballe lorsqu'elle apprend qu'il pourrait être promu.

episodes.name: The Slippers
episodes.overview: Dong-hoon refuse de révéler à qui que ce soit la véritable cause de ses blessures. Ji-an s'acquitte entièrement de sa dette pour éviter que Gwang-il ne blesse quelqu'un d'autre.

episodes.name: Out Of All, Why?
episodes.overview: Avant l'entretien, quelques directeurs tentent de monter un dossier solide pour Dong-hoon, sachant que son lien avec Ji-an sera remis en question.

episodes.name: I Wanted You To Be Happy
episodes.overview: En entendant la version de Yun-hui, Dong-hoon revoit ses priorités. Ji-an continue de faire des avances embarrassantes à Dong-hoon.

episodes.name: Can I Hug You?
episodes.overview: Le témoignage de Ji-an prend au dépourvu les adversaires de Dong-hoon. Dong-hoon est sur le point d'attraper les responsables de son malheur.

episodes.name: Would You Be Happy To See Me?
episodes.overview: Lorsque le passé de Ji-an est révélé, elle se cache. Pendant ce temps, ses enregistrements tombent entre les mains de ceux qui cherchent à gagner de l'argent.

episodes.name: I’m Sorry
episodes.overview: Même après avoir réalisé ce que Ji-an leur a fait, Dong-hoon et Yun-hui cherchent à la protéger. Mais il semble que tout le monde veuille que justice soit faite.

episodes.name: Ji. An.
episodes.overview: Jun-yeong pourrait être libéré en raison d'un manque flagrant de preuves. Lorsque Ji-an perd un être cher, les frères de Dong-hoon s'assurent qu'elle ne reste pas seule.

series.name: Single in Seoul
series.overview:
Park Young Ho, célèbre conférencier et influenceur suivi par 300 000 abonnés, profite pleinement de son célibat, oscillant entre sensibilité et prétention. À l'opposé, Joo Hyun Jin, jeune éditrice talentueuse et rédactrice en chef d'une série d'essais intitulée « Célibataire en ville », supporte difficilement la solitude.

Leur rencontre autour de ce projet les amène à confronter leurs visions opposées du célibat, mais aussi à rouvrir les blessures laissées par leurs anciennes histoires d'amour.
